strings.t: Kou Lower School
TK – Grad 5

strings.text: Four core curriculum areas plus 11 Special Area Classes — Singapore Math and structured literacy from TK.
strings.t: Kat domèn kourikoulòm debaz plis 11 Special Area Classes — Singapore Math ak alfabetizasyon estriktire apati TK.

strings.text: Providence Day publishes four core curriculum areas and a Special Area Class list for TK–5, not named courses. There is no Lower School course-of-study guide.
strings.t: Providence Day pibliye kat domèn kourikoulòm debaz ak yon lis Special Area Class pou TK–5, se pa kou ki gen non. Pa gen okenn gid pwogram etid Lower School.
Kourikoulòm Debaz
Matematik
TK–Gr 5

strings.text: Uses the concepts of Singapore Math, teaching the why and how behind concepts with bar modeling emphasized in Grades 2–5.
strings.t: Sèvi ak konsèp Singapore Math, ki anseye poukisa ak kijan ki dèyè konsèp yo ak aksan sou modèl ba nan Grad 2–5.
Atizay Lang

strings.text: A structured-literacy program beginning in TK, systematically fostering phonological awareness, phonics, fluency, vocabulary, and comprehension.
strings.t: Yon pwogram alfabetizasyon estriktire ki kòmanse nan TK, ki devlope sistematikman konsyans fonolojik, fonik, fasilite, vokabilè, ak konpreyansyon.
Syans

strings.text: Uses inquiry-based methodology with open-ended challenges, empowering students to rely on their own reasoning rather than seeking teacher answers.
strings.t: Sèvi ak metodoloji ki baze sou envestigasyon ak defi ki louvri, ki bay elèv yo pouvwa pou yo konte sou pwòp rezònman yo olye ke chèche repons pwofesè a.
Syans Sosyal

strings.text: Students explore identity and community from the TK Goes Global unit outward to Charlotte and the world, with each grade level having its own focus.
strings.t: Elèv yo eksplore idantite ak kominote depi nan inite TK Goes Global la rive nan Charlotte ak mond lan, ak chak nivo ki gen pwòp konsantrasyon pa l.
Lang Etranje
Ekspozisyon nan Franse, Panyòl ak Mandaren
TK–Gr 1

strings.text: Students are exposed to French, Spanish, and Mandarin Chinese during their earliest years at Providence Day.
strings.t: Yo ekspoze elèv yo a Franse, Panyòl, ak Chinwa Mandaren pandan premye ane yo nan Providence Day.
Lang Etid yo Chwazi a
Gr 2–5

strings.text: By second grade one language is selected for the remaining four years of Lower School — the start of an 11-year journey toward proficiency.
strings.t: Nan dezyèm ane yo chwazi yon sèl lang pou rès kat ane Lower School yo — kòmansman yon vwayaj 11 ane vè metriz.
Special Area Classes
Atizay

strings.text: A Lower School special area class in visual art.
strings.t: Yon Lower School special area class nan atizay vizyèl.
Mizik

strings.text: A Lower School special area class in music.
strings.t: Yon Lower School special area class nan mizik.
Band, Orchestra ak Chorus

strings.text: Performing ensembles offered as Lower School special area classes.
strings.t: Ansanm ki fè pèfòmans yo ofri kòm Lower School special area classes.
Teyat

strings.text: A Lower School special area class in theatre.
strings.t: Yon Lower School special area class nan teyat.
Edikasyon Fizik

strings.text: A Lower School special area class in physical education.
strings.t: Yon Lower School special area class nan edikasyon fizik.
Laboratwa Syans

strings.text: A dedicated Lower School science lab special area class.
strings.t: Yon special area class laboratwa syans Lower School dedye.
Tech Tank

strings.text: Providence Day's Lower School technology special area class.
strings.t: Special area class teknoloji Lower School Providence Day.
IDEAS

strings.text: The Lower School strand of IDEAS@PDS, the school’s TK–12 innovation initiative.
strings.t: Branch Lower School IDEAS@PDS la, inisyativ inovasyon TK–12 lekòl la.
Learning Loft

strings.text: A Lower School special area class supporting individualized learning.
strings.t: Yon Lower School special area class ki sipòte aprantisaj endividyalize.
Bibliyotèk

strings.text: A Lower School library special area class.
strings.t: Yon Lower School special area class nan bibliyotèk.
Kou Middle School
Grad 6 – 8

strings.text: ~75 courses across 7 departments — where math placement paths and the five-language world-language sequence begin.
strings.t: ~75 kou atravè 7 depatman — kote wout plasman matematik yo ak sekans senk lang etranje a kòmanse.
Angle
English 6
Gr 6

strings.text: Lays a foundation for effective communication through novels, poetry, short stories, and nonfiction, with paragraph structure and vocabulary in context.
strings.t: Mete yon fondasyon pou kominikasyon efikas atravè woman, pwezi, istwa kout, ak tèks ki pa fiksyon, ak estrikti paragraf ak vokabilè nan kontèks.
English 7
Gr 7

strings.text: Emphasizes written and verbal expression through literature, composition, and mechanics, introducing thesis statements and the formal research paper.
strings.t: Mete aksan sou ekspresyon alekri ak oral atravè literati, konpozisyon, ak mekanik, epi li entwodui deklarasyon tèz ak papye rechèch fòmèl la.
English 8
Gr 8

strings.text: Students synthesize skills from English 6 and 7, writing analytical essays across genres and analyzing texts independently.
strings.t: Elèv yo rasanble konpetans English 6 ak 7, yo ekri redaksyon analitik atravè jan diferan epi yo analize tèks poukont yo.
Creative Writing 6
Semès

strings.text: Students write a personal narrative, short story, and poems as a community of writers.
strings.t: Elèv yo ekri yon naratif pèsonèl, yon istwa kout, ak powèm kòm yon kominote ekriven.
World Myths and Legends
Gr 6–7

strings.text: Myths and legends from six continents featuring King Arthur, Loki, Mulan, Beowulf, and Anansi.
strings.t: Mit ak lejand ki soti nan sis kontinan ki prezante King Arthur, Loki, Mulan, Beowulf, ak Anansi.

strings.text: Lights, Camera, Action: Literature through Movies
strings.t: Lights, Camera, Action: Literature through Movies
Gr 7–8

strings.text: A writing-focused course using film to understand tone, imagery, and symbolism.
strings.t: Yon kou ki konsantre sou ekri ki sèvi ak fim pou konprann ton, imaj, ak senbolis.
Matematik
Mathematics 6

strings.text: Built on seven foundational elements — number skills, measurement, geometry, patterns and functions, statistics and probability, logic, and algebra.
strings.t: Bati sou sèt eleman fondasyonèl — konpetans nan nonb, mezi, jeyometri, modèl ak fonksyon, estatistik ak pwobabilite, lojik, ak aljèb.
Math 7

strings.text: Recurring practice on whole numbers, fractions, decimals, percent, ratios, proportions, powers and roots, equations, integers, and rational numbers.
strings.t: Pratik ki repete sou nonb antye, fraksyon, desimal, pousantaj, rapò, pwopòsyon, pisans ak rasin, ekwasyon, antye relatif, ak nonb rasyonèl.
Pre-Algebra 7 – Accelerated
Akselere

strings.text: Reinforces basic concepts as an introduction to algebra covering the number system, percents, and linear equations and inequalities.
strings.t: Ranfòse konsèp debaz kòm yon entwodiksyon nan aljèb ki kouvri sistèm nonb nan, pousantaj, ak ekwasyon ak inegalite lineyè.
Advanced Pre-Algebra
Avanse

strings.text: Extends Pre-Algebra with rational number computation, equations and inequalities, linear functions, polynomials, and factoring.
strings.t: Pwolonje Pre-Algebra ak kalkil nonb rasyonèl, ekwasyon ak inegalite, fonksyon lineyè, polinòm, ak faktorizasyon.
Pre-Algebra 8

strings.text: The traditional eighth-grade Pre-Algebra course covering the number system, percents, and linear equations and inequalities.
strings.t: Kou Pre-Algebra tradisyonèl uityèm ane a ki kouvri sistèm nonb nan, pousantaj, ak ekwasyon ak inegalite lineyè.
Algebra I-8 Accelerated

strings.text: Foundation for the Upper School math sequence covering algebraic expressions, linear and quadratic equations, systems, factoring, and radicals.
strings.t: Fondasyon pou sekans matematik Upper School la ki kouvri ekspresyon aljebrik, ekwasyon lineyè ak kadratik, sistèm, faktorizasyon, ak radikal.
Advanced Algebra I

strings.text: Similar to Algebra I Accelerated with more emphasis on proofs, applications, and mathematical reasoning, plus strong word-problem focus.
strings.t: Sanble ak Algebra I Accelerated ak plis aksan sou prèv, aplikasyon, ak rezònman matematik, plis yon gwo konsantrasyon sou pwoblèm ak mo.
Science 6

strings.text: The first part of an integrated, inquiry-based sequence, with major units on properties of matter and organisms.
strings.t: Premye pati yon sekans entegre ki baze sou envestigasyon, ak gwo inite sou pwopriyete matyè ak òganis.
Science 7

strings.text: The second part of the integrated sequence, with major units on catastrophic events — weather, earthquakes, volcanoes — and light and optics.
strings.t: Dezyèm pati sekans entegre a, ak gwo inite sou evènman katastwofik — tan, tranblemanntè, vòlkan — ak limyè ak optik.
Science 8

strings.text: The final part of the integrated sequence, with units on human body systems and electricity, energy, and alternative resources.
strings.t: Dènye pati sekans entegre a, ak inite sou sistèm kò moun ak elektrisite, enèji, ak resous altènatif.
The Amazing Human Body

strings.text: The main human body systems with lab specimens, models, microscopes, first aid, and CPR.
strings.t: Prensipal sistèm kò moun ak espesimèn laboratwa, modèl, mikwoskòp, premye swen, ak CPR.
Istwa
History 6

strings.text: Focuses on selected cultures of the ancient and medieval world, stressing note taking, research, map reading, and cooperative learning.
strings.t: Konsantre sou kèk kilti chwazi nan mond ansyen ak medyeval la, ak aksan sou pran nòt, rechèch, li kat, ak aprantisaj an kolaborasyon.
U.S. History 7

strings.text: An in-depth study of the formation and development of the United States from the Constitution to civil rights, relating past to present via current events.
strings.t: Yon etid apwofondi sou fòmasyon ak devlopman Etazini soti nan Konstitisyon an rive nan dwa sivil, ki makonnen tan lontan ak jodi a atravè aktyalite.
Global Perspectives 8

strings.text: Examines countries, landforms, resources, climates, peoples, cultures, religions, and governmental systems to build global awareness.
strings.t: Egzamine peyi, fòm tè, resous, klima, pèp, kilti, relijyon, ak sistèm gouvènman pou bati konsyans mondyal.
History in Action: Collaborative Research

strings.text: In-depth historical inquiry on a student-chosen topic presented as a website, documentary, exhibit, performance, or paper.
strings.t: Envestigasyon istorik apwofondi sou yon sijè elèv la chwazi, prezante kòm yon sit entènèt, dokimantè, egzibisyon, pèfòmans, oswa papye.
Contemporary Global Issues

strings.text: In-depth investigation of selected current events and their historical context.
strings.t: Envestigasyon apwofondi sou kèk aktyalite chwazi ak kontèks istorik yo.
IDEAS@PDS
Computer Applications

strings.text: Digital and media literacy using the SIFT framework, keyboarding, and Google Sites portfolios.
strings.t: Alfabetizasyon dijital ak medya ak kad SIFT la, klavye, ak pòtfèy Google Sites.
Computer Programming

strings.text: Interactive programming in MIT's Scratch to build animations, narratives, and games.
strings.t: Pwogramasyon entèaktif nan Scratch MIT la pou bati animasyon, naratif, ak jwèt.
Robotics

strings.text: Robot development and design using Lego Spike Prime and block-based programming.
strings.t: Devlopman ak konsepsyon robo ak Lego Spike Prime ak pwogramasyon ak blòk.
Web Design

strings.text: HTML projects using a variety of publishing tools; requires Computer Applications.
strings.t: Pwojè HTML ak yon varyete zouti piblikasyon; li egzije Computer Applications.
Introduction to Engineering 6

strings.text: A hands-on STEM introduction for the budding scientist.
strings.t: Yon entwodiksyon STEM pratik pou jèn syantifik k ap devlope a.

strings.text: SPARK: Environmental Problem Solving by Design
strings.t: SPARK: Environmental Problem Solving by Design
Gr 6–8

strings.text: Design thinking applied to environmental issues via the UN Sustainable Development Goals.
strings.t: Panse konsepsyon aplike a pwoblèm anviwònmantal atravè Objektif Devlopman Dirab Nasyonzini yo.
Broadcast Media

strings.text: Television production across pre-production, production, and post-production.
strings.t: Pwodiksyon televizyon atravè pre-pwodiksyon, pwodiksyon, ak pòs-pwodiksyon.
Social Entrepreneurship: Incubation & Acceleration

strings.text: Interdisciplinary innovation work through entrepreneurial sprints.
strings.t: Travay inovasyon ant disiplin atravè espren antreprenaryal.
Engineering the Future

strings.text: Labs and hands-on STEM activities benefiting the local and global community.
strings.t: Laboratwa ak aktivite STEM pratik ki benefisye kominote lokal ak mondyal la.
Introduction to Personal Finance

strings.text: Taxes, accounts, credit, investing, insurance, and budgeting.
strings.t: Taks, kont, kredi, envestisman, asirans, ak bidjè.
Exploring Latin through Mythology

strings.text: A semester introduction to Latin through the myths of the classical world.
strings.t: Yon entwodiksyon yon semès nan Laten atravè mit mond klasik la.
Latin 1

strings.text: The Upper School Latin I course, open from Grade 7.
strings.t: Kou Latin I Upper School la, louvri apati Grad 7.
Latin 2

strings.text: The Upper School Latin II course, open from Grade 8.
strings.t: Kou Latin II Upper School la, louvri apati Grad 8.
Spanish 1–4

strings.text: A four-level Middle School Spanish sequence; levels 2+ require prerequisite approval.
strings.t: Yon sekans Panyòl Middle School kat nivo; nivo 2+ egzije apwobasyon kondisyon anvan.
French 1–4

strings.text: A four-level Middle School French sequence; levels 2+ require prerequisite approval.
strings.t: Yon sekans Franse Middle School kat nivo; nivo 2+ egzije apwobasyon kondisyon anvan.
Mandarin Chinese 1–4

strings.text: A four-level Middle School Mandarin sequence; levels 2+ require prerequisite approval.
strings.t: Yon sekans Mandaren Middle School kat nivo; nivo 2+ egzije apwobasyon kondisyon anvan.
German 1–3

strings.text: A three-level Middle School German sequence.
strings.t: Yon sekans Alman Middle School twa nivo.
Bozar ak PE
Band 6 / Band 7–8
Ane

strings.text: The Middle School band ensembles, split by grade band.
strings.t: Ansanm fanfa Middle School yo, divize pa bann nivo.
Chorus 6 / Chorus 7–8

strings.text: The Middle School choral ensembles, split by grade band.
strings.t: Ansanm koral Middle School yo, divize pa bann nivo.
Orchestra 6 / Orchestra 7–8

strings.text: The Middle School string ensembles, split by grade band.
strings.t: Ansanm kòd Middle School yo, divize pa bann nivo.
Art 6 & Art Foundations

strings.text: Introductory Middle School visual art courses.
strings.t: Kou atizay vizyèl Middle School entwodiksyon.
Introduction to Art and Design

strings.text: An introduction to the elements and principles of art and design.
strings.t: Yon entwodiksyon nan eleman ak prensip atizay ak konsepsyon.
Introduction to Painting

strings.text: An introductory Middle School painting course.
strings.t: Yon kou penti Middle School entwodiksyon.
Introduction to Printmaking

strings.text: An introductory Middle School printmaking course.
strings.t: Yon kou gravi Middle School entwodiksyon.
Introduction to 3D Design

strings.text: An introductory Middle School three-dimensional design course.
strings.t: Yon kou konsepsyon an twa dimansyon Middle School entwodiksyon.
Theatre Arts 6

strings.text: The sixth-grade introduction to theatre arts.
strings.t: Entwodiksyon sizyèm ane a nan atizay teyat.
Acting 1, 2 & 3

strings.text: A three-level Middle School acting sequence.
strings.t: Yon sekans aktyaj Middle School twa nivo.
Middle School Stagecraft

strings.text: Technical theatre and stagecraft for Middle School students.
strings.t: Teyat teknik ak teknik sèn pou elèv Middle School.
Communication Arts

strings.text: A Middle School course in communication and presentation.
strings.t: Yon kou Middle School nan kominikasyon ak prezantasyon.
Physical Education/Health 6, 7 & 8
Obligatwa

strings.text: Weekly fitness-based exercise and sport skills plus health units on nutrition, substances, media influence, and human development.
strings.t: Egzèsis ki baze sou fòm fizik ak konpetans espò chak semèn plis inite sante sou nitrisyon, sibstans, enfliyans medya, ak devlopman moun.
Movement & Yoga

strings.text: Dance, yoga, and mindfulness; does not replace the Grade 8 PE requirement.
strings.t: Dans, yoga, ak atansyon konsyan; li pa ranplase kondisyon PE Grad 8 la.
Kou Upper School
Grad 9 – 12

strings.text: 149 catalogued courses across 11 departments — foundations through 28 AP courses and post-AP mathematics.
strings.t: 149 kou nan katalòg atravè 11 depatman — fondasyon rive nan 28 kou AP ak matematik pòs-AP.
English I
Gr 9

strings.text: Ninth-graders read novels, short stories, and plays including Macbeth and The House on Mango Street, building analytical skills through essays, journals, and a research-based podcast project.
strings.t: Elèv nevyèm ane li woman, istwa kout, ak pyès teyat ki enkli Macbeth ak The House on Mango Street, epi yo bati konpetans analitik atravè redaksyon, jounal, ak yon pwojè podcast ki baze sou rechèch.
English II
Gr 10

strings.text: Sophomore English focuses writing skills on American literature such as The Great Gatsby and Their Eyes Were Watching God.
strings.t: Angle dezyèm ane a konsantre konpetans ekri sou literati ameriken tankou The Great Gatsby ak Their Eyes Were Watching God.
Writing Seminar

strings.text: A junior course in which student writing constitutes the text, emphasizing style, voice, and rhetorical organization.
strings.t: Yon kou twazyèm ane kote ekriti elèv yo se tèks la, ak aksan sou style, vwa, ak òganizasyon retorik.
Creative Writing

strings.text: Students write original prose fiction and poetry in a workshop setting, inventing characters and plots while critiquing classmates’ work.
strings.t: Elèv yo ekri pwoz fiksyon ak pwezi orijinal nan yon anviwònman atelye, yo envante pèsonaj ak entrig pandan y ap kritike travay kanmarad yo.
New Media Storytelling

strings.text: Students examine storytelling strategies from news articles to Instagram reels and apply narrative methods across communication formats.
strings.t: Elèv yo egzamine estrateji pou rakonte istwa soti nan atik nouvèl rive nan Instagram reels epi yo aplike metòd naratif atravè fòma kominikasyon.

strings.text: English Studies in Film: Philosophy in Film
strings.t: English Studies in Film: Philosophy in Film

strings.text: Students pair film with classical philosophical texts to investigate good and evil, self, existence, and reality.
strings.t: Elèv yo makonnen fim ak tèks filozofik klasik pou envestige byen ak mal, tèt, egzistans, ak reyalite.
Detective and Crime Fiction

strings.text: Students explore the detective and crime fiction genre from the 1800s to the present across short stories, drama, novels, film, and TV.
strings.t: Elèv yo eksplore jan fiksyon detektif ak krim depi ane 1800 yo rive jodi a atravè istwa kout, teyat, woman, fim, ak televizyon.
Global Literature Topics

strings.text: Students engage genres spanning Asia, the Caribbean, Africa, and Latin America around a rotating common topic such as gender or justice.
strings.t: Elèv yo angaje ak jan ki kouvri Azi, Karayib la, Afrik, ak Amerik Latin otou yon sijè komen ki fè wotasyon tankou sèks oswa jistis.
Graphic Novels

strings.text: Students scrutinize long-form comics as global literature and design a multimedia work of literary analysis culminating in a student-organized comic-con.
strings.t: Elèv yo egzamine komik long fòm kòm literati mondyal epi yo konsevwa yon travay analiz literè miltimedya ki fini nan yon comic-con elèv yo òganize.
Modern Dramatic Literature

strings.text: A survey of modern drama from Ibsen to Ionesco exploring individualism, empathy, and meaningful communication through reader’s theater.
strings.t: Yon survey teyat modèn soti Ibsen rive Ionesco k ap eksplore endividyalis, anpati, ak kominikasyon ki gen sans atravè teyat lekti.
Shakespeare

strings.text: Students study The Merchant of Venice, Othello, The Tempest, Measure for Measure, and Richard III, reading plays aloud and analyzing film versions.
strings.t: Elèv yo etidye The Merchant of Venice, Othello, The Tempest, Measure for Measure, ak Richard III, yo li pyès yo awotvwa epi yo analize vèsyon fim yo.
War Literature

strings.text: Students read poetry, songs, plays, novels, and non-fiction spanning the Thirty Years’ War through Afghanistan and Iraq.
strings.t: Elèv yo li pwezi, chante, pyès teyat, woman, ak tèks ki pa fiksyon ki kouvri Gè Trant Ane a rive nan Afganistan ak Irak.
Latino American Literature

strings.text: An introduction to Latino American literature and cultures in the U.S. from 1960 to the present, analyzing diaspora and border identities.
strings.t: Yon entwodiksyon nan literati ak kilti Latino Ameriken nan Etazini soti 1960 rive jodi a, k ap analize dyaspora ak idantite fwontyè.
AP African American Studies
AP

strings.text: An interdisciplinary AP course reaching into literature, arts, political science, geography, and science to explore African American experience.
strings.t: Yon kou AP ant disiplin ki rive nan literati, atizay, syans politik, jeyografi, ak syans pou eksplore eksperyans Afriken Ameriken an.
AP English Language and Composition

strings.text: College-level expository, analytical, and argumentative writing drawn from non-fiction genres, with focus on rhetorical technique and logic.
strings.t: Ekri ekspozitif, analitik, ak agimantatif nan nivo inivèsite ki soti nan jan ki pa fiksyon, ak konsantrasyon sou teknik retorik ak lojik.
AP English Literature and Composition

strings.text: Refines literary analysis via Moby-Dick, Invisible Man, and Mrs. Dalloway, plus Dickinson, Frost, and Shakespeare, with an outside-reading list.
strings.t: Rafine analiz literè atravè Moby-Dick, Invisible Man, ak Mrs. Dalloway, plis Dickinson, Frost, ak Shakespeare, ak yon lis lekti deyò.

strings.text: Global Civics: Government Structures and Economic Systems
strings.t: Global Civics: Government Structures and Economic Systems

strings.text: Focuses on the roles and responsibilities of citizens from local to global perspectives, comparing American government and economic systems to others worldwide.
strings.t: Konsantre sou wòl ak responsablite sitwayen soti nan pèspektiv lokal rive nan mondyal, ki konpare gouvènman ak sistèm ekonomik ameriken ak lòt atravè mond lan.
World History

strings.text: Fosters appreciation for cultural diversity through the geographical and thematic development of events from 1000 CE to the Age of Globalization.
strings.t: Devlope apresyasyon pou divèsite kiltirèl atravè devlopman jeyografik ak tematik evènman soti 1000 EK rive nan Epòk Mondyalizasyon an.
AP World History: Modern

strings.text: Surveys Afro-Eurasian and American societies from 1200 CE to the present around governance, innovation, culture, and human-environment interaction.
strings.t: Fè yon survey sou sosyete Afwo-Ewazyen ak Ameriken soti 1200 EK rive jodi a otou gouvènans, inovasyon, kilti, ak entèraksyon moun-anviwònman.
United States History

strings.text: A general survey from the European encounter of the Americas to the present, using role-playing simulations and primary-source analysis.
strings.t: Yon survey jeneral soti nan rankont Ewopeyen ak Amerik yo rive jodi a, ak similasyon jwe wòl ak analiz sous prensipal.
AP United States History

strings.text: A college-level course stressing historical thinking skills — causation, comparison, continuity and change — through critical national trends.
strings.t: Yon kou nivo inivèsite ki mete aksan sou konpetans panse istorik — koz, konparezon, kontinwite ak chanjman — atravè gwo tandans nasyonal.
AP European History

strings.text: Investigates major events and ideas from the Renaissance to the present, developing history as an interpretive discipline through original sources.
strings.t: Envestige gwo evènman ak lide soti nan Renesans lan rive jodi a, ki devlope istwa kòm yon disiplin entèpretatif atravè sous orijinal.
AP U.S. Government and Politics

strings.text: Gives a critical perspective on American government via constitutional underpinnings, parties, institutions, and civil liberties, plus civic-engagement projects.
strings.t: Bay yon pèspektiv kritik sou gouvènman ameriken an atravè fondasyon konstitisyonèl, pati, enstitisyon, ak libète sivil, plis pwojè angajman sivik.
AP Human Geography

strings.text: Promotes global literacy through geographic study of population, political organization of space, land use, economic development, and urbanization.
strings.t: Ankouraje alfabetizasyon mondyal atravè etid jeyografik sou popilasyon, òganizasyon politik espas, itilizasyon tè, devlopman ekonomik, ak ibanizasyon.
AP Microeconomics

strings.text: Students gain thorough understanding of principles relating to consumers and producers, including supply/demand models and factor markets.
strings.t: Elèv yo jwenn yon konpreyansyon konplè sou prensip ki gen rapò ak konsomatè ak pwodiktè, ki enkli modèl òf/demann ak mache faktè.
AP Macroeconomics

strings.text: Covers economic principles for the system as a whole — GDP, unemployment, inflation, aggregate demand and supply, and fiscal and monetary policy.
strings.t: Kouvri prensip ekonomik pou sistèm nan an antye — PIB, chomaj, enflasyon, demann ak òf total, ak politik fiskal ak monetè.
AP Psychology

strings.text: Covers research methods, neuroscience, development, sensation and perception, learning, memory, cognition, personality, and mental health.
strings.t: Kouvri metòd rechèch, nerosyans, devlopman, sansasyon ak pèsepsyon, aprantisaj, memwa, koyisyon, pèsonalite, ak sante mantal.
Introduction to Psychology

strings.text: A broad overview of psychology emphasizing everyday application, covering perspectives, research methods, identity, and positive psychology.
strings.t: Yon gade jeneral sou sikoloji ak aksan sou aplikasyon chak jou, ki kouvri pèspektiv, metòd rechèch, idantite, ak sikoloji pozitif.
Comparative Government and Politics

strings.text: Students study the governmental systems of the United Kingdom, Nigeria, China, Russia, Iran, and Mexico as case studies in diverse political structures.
strings.t: Elèv yo etidye sistèm gouvènman Wayòm Ini, Nijerya, Lachin, Larisi, Iran, ak Meksik kòm etid ka nan estrikti politik divès.
Herstory: Women in Global History

strings.text: Introduces the progression of gender roles and the history of women and gender worldwide over the last 1500 years using primary documents.
strings.t: Entwodui pwogresyon wòl sèks ak istwa fanm ak sèks atravè mond lan sou 1500 dènye ane yo ak dokiman prensipal.
Legal Issues

strings.text: Students explore what it means to think like a lawyer, applying legal case studies to real court cases and arguing as both lawyer and judge.
strings.t: Elèv yo eksplore sa sa vle di panse tankou yon avoka, yo aplike etid ka legal a vrè ka tribinal epi yo diskite kòm avoka ak jij tou de.
Economics of Development

strings.text: Explores international trade, foreign exchange, foreign direct investment, and growth with focus on economic dependencies in Latin America.
strings.t: Eksplore komès entènasyonal, chanj etranje, envestisman dirèk etranje, ak kwasans ak konsantrasyon sou depandans ekonomik nan Amerik Latin.
Global Studies: Genocide

strings.text: Introduces the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and investigates past and current genocides and human rights violations through case studies.
strings.t: Entwodui Deklarasyon Inivèsèl Dwa Moun nan epi li envestige jenosid ak vyolasyon dwa moun pase ak aktyèl atravè etid ka.

strings.text: Global Studies: Europe and Latin America
strings.t: Global Studies: Europe and Latin America

strings.text: A multi-disciplinary examination of regional trends and cultures, generating research-driven policy recommendations.
strings.t: Yon egzamen ant disiplin sou tandans ak kilti rejyonal, ki jenere rekòmandasyon politik ki baze sou rechèch.
Global Studies: Comparative Religions

strings.text: Enhances understanding of Christianity, Judaism, Islam, Hinduism, and Buddhism through primary and secondary readings and philosophical discussion.
strings.t: Amelyore konpreyansyon Krisyanis, Jidayis, Islam, Endouyis, ak Boudis atravè lekti prensipal ak segondè ak diskisyon filozofik.
Global Studies: Africa

strings.text: A multi-disciplinary exploration of Sub-Saharan Africa with in-depth study of South Africa, the DRC, Rwanda, and Nigeria.
strings.t: Yon eksplorasyon ant disiplin sou Afrik Sub-Sahara ak etid apwofondi sou Afrik di Sid, RDK, Rwanda, ak Nijerya.
Global Studies: Asia

strings.text: A multi-disciplinary exploration of Asia with in-depth examinations of China and the Koreas.
strings.t: Yon eksplorasyon ant disiplin sou Azi ak egzamen apwofondi sou Lachin ak Kore yo.

strings.text: Global Studies: Middle East and North Africa
strings.t: Global Studies: Middle East and North Africa

strings.text: A multi-disciplinary examination of regional trends and cultures in the Middle East and North Africa through a historical lens.
strings.t: Yon egzamen ant disiplin sou tandans ak kilti rejyonal nan Mwayen Oryan ak Afrik di Nò atravè yon lantiy istorik.
Global Leadership

strings.text: Seniors in the Global Studies Diploma become effective global collaborators and leaders, completing a research project and exit interview process.
strings.t: Elèv dènye ane nan Global Studies Diploma a vin kolaboratè ak lidè mondyal efikas, ki konplete yon pwojè rechèch ak yon pwosesis entèvyou sòti.
Algebra I

strings.text: A first-year algebra course integrating algebra and physics concepts through data collection, symbolic rule-building, and real-world applications.
strings.t: Yon kou aljèb premye ane ki entegre konsèp aljèb ak fizik atravè koleksyon done, konstriksyon règ senbolik, ak aplikasyon nan mond reyèl la.
Geometry

strings.text: Students study points, lines, planes, triangles, polygons, circles, and solids, exploring congruence and similarity with ACT/SAT geometry content covered.
strings.t: Elèv yo etidye pwen, liy, plan, triyang, poligòn, sèk, ak solid, yo eksplore kongriyans ak similarite ak kontni jeyometri ACT/SAT ki kouvri.
Geometry (Accelerated)

strings.text: Teaches how mathematics develops from a postulate system using deductive reasoning, with mathematical proof, constructions, and coordinate geometry.
strings.t: Anseye kijan matematik devlope apati yon sistèm postila ak rezònman dediktif, ak prèv matematik, konstriksyon, ak jeyometri kòdone.
Geometry (Advanced)

strings.text: Offers rigorous treatment and in-depth development of direct and indirect proofs across congruence, similarity, circles, and triangle trigonometry.
strings.t: Ofri yon tretman rijid ak yon devlopman apwofondi prèv dirèk ak endirèk atravè kongriyans, similarite, sèk, ak trigonometri triyang.
Algebra II

strings.text: Reviews Algebra I then covers polynomials, linear and quadratic equations, real and complex numbers, logarithms, graphing, inequalities, and functions.
strings.t: Revize Algebra I apre sa li kouvri polinòm, ekwasyon lineyè ak kadratik, nonb reyèl ak konplèks, logaritm, grafik, inegalite, ak fonksyon.
Algebra II/Trigonometry (Accelerated)

strings.text: Students study functions, graphing, rational exponents, polynomials, systems, sequences, series, logarithms, conic sections, and trigonometry.
strings.t: Elèv yo etidye fonksyon, grafik, ekspozan rasyonèl, polinòm, sistèm, sekans, seri, logaritm, seksyon konik, ak trigonometri.
Algebra II/Trigonometry (Advanced)

strings.text: Studies linear through trigonometric functions plus logic, set theory, and proof, seeking algebraic, graphical, numerical, and verbal treatments.
strings.t: Etidye fonksyon lineyè rive nan trigonometrik plis lojik, teori ansanm, ak prèv, k ap chèche tretman aljebrik, grafik, nimerik, ak vèbal.
Precalculus

strings.text: Satisfies the four-year requirement via trigonometry and advanced algebraic topics viewed through personal finance, culminating in a personal budget.
strings.t: Satisfè kondisyon kat ane a atravè trigonometri ak sijè aljebrik avanse gade atravè finans pèsonèl, ki fini nan yon bidjè pèsonèl.
Precalculus (Advanced)

strings.text: Covers trigonometry, logarithmic and exponential functions, induction, conics, complex numbers, polar coordinates, and limits to prepare for college calculus.
strings.t: Kouvri trigonometri, fonksyon logaritmik ak eksponansyèl, endiksyon, konik, nonb konplèks, kòdone polè, ak limit pou prepare pou kalkil inivèsitè.
Analysis (Advanced)

strings.text: A thorough analysis of polynomial, rational, exponential, and logarithmic functions plus vectors and an introduction to limits and first derivatives.
strings.t: Yon analiz konplè fonksyon polinòm, rasyonèl, eksponansyèl, ak logaritmik plis vektè ak yon entwodiksyon nan limit ak premye derive.
Statistics

strings.text: An introductory course covering data collection, experimental design, descriptive and inferential statistics, and probability using applets and Excel.
strings.t: Yon kou entwodiksyon ki kouvri koleksyon done, konsepsyon eksperimantal, estatistik deskriptif ak enferansyèl, ak pwobabilite ak applet ak Excel.
Calculus (Advanced)

strings.text: Introduces differential calculus concepts and applications, teaching students to evaluate limits and differentiate and integrate elementary functions.
strings.t: Entwodui konsèp ak aplikasyon kalkil diferansyèl, epi li anseye elèv yo evalye limit epi diferansye ak entegre fonksyon elemantè.
AP Calculus AB

strings.text: Students learn to evaluate limits, differentiate, and integrate elementary functions, using a graphing calculator as an integral part of the course.
strings.t: Elèv yo aprann evalye limit, diferansye, ak entegre fonksyon elemantè, ak yon kalkilatris grafik kòm yon pati entegral nan kou a.
AP Calculus BC

strings.text: Covers AB content plus vector, polar, and parametric equations and the calculus of infinite series.
strings.t: Kouvri kontni AB la plis ekwasyon vektoryèl, polè, ak paramtetrik ak kalkil seri enfini.
AP Statistics

strings.text: Students simulate probability distributions and analyze relationships between variables via correlation and regression using calculators and software.
strings.t: Elèv yo similye distribisyon pwobabilite epi yo analize relasyon ant varyab atravè korelasyon ak regresyon ak kalkilatris ak lojisyèl.
Calculus III (Advanced)
Pòs-AP

strings.text: Follows BC Calculus with multivariable and vector-valued functions, curvature, double and triple integrals, and vector analysis.
strings.t: Swiv BC Calculus ak fonksyon miltivaryab ak vektoryèl, koubi, entegral doub ak tripl, ak analiz vektoryèl.
Linear Algebra (Advanced)

strings.text: Moves into three- and n-dimensional space covering matrices, determinants, simultaneous linear equations, vector spaces, rank, inverses, and inner products.
strings.t: Antre nan espas twa ak n dimansyon ki kouvri matris, detèminan, ekwasyon lineyè similtane, espas vektoryèl, ran, envès, ak pwodwi entèn.
Differential Equations (Advanced)

strings.text: Students examine differential equations and their solutions, Laplace Transforms, linear and nonlinear systems, series methods, and Fourier Series.
strings.t: Elèv yo egzamine ekwasyon diferansyèl ak solisyon yo, Transfòme Laplace, sistèm lineyè ak ki pa lineyè, metòd seri, ak Seri Fourier.
Physics I

strings.text: A modeling-based course in which students develop models for motion, forces, energy, and electrostatics using algebra to express quantitative relationships.
strings.t: Yon kou ki baze sou modèl kote elèv yo devlope modèl pou mouvman, fòs, enèji, ak elektwostatik ak aljèb pou eksprime relasyon kantitatif.
Physics I Accelerated

strings.text: Moves faster and is more mathematically rigorous than Physics I, adding circular motion and waves.
strings.t: Ale pi vit epi li pi rijid sou plan matematik pase Physics I, epi li ajoute mouvman sikilè ak vag.
Chemistry I

strings.text: Students build a foundation in matter, composition, periodicity, energy, and reactions, developing models to explain the structure of matter.
strings.t: Elèv yo bati yon fondasyon nan matyè, konpozisyon, peryodisite, enèji, ak reyaksyon, epi yo devlope modèl pou esplike estrikti matyè.
Chemistry I Accelerated

strings.text: Covers Chemistry I topics at greater depth and pace, highly recommended for students considering AP sciences.
strings.t: Kouvri sijè Chemistry I ak plis pwofondè ak vitès, trè rekòmande pou elèv k ap konsidere syans AP.
Biology I

strings.text: A college-preparatory course covering basic ecology, human anatomy and physiology, cell biology, and evolution with mammalian dissection.
strings.t: Yon kou preparasyon pou inivèsite ki kouvri ekoloji debaz, anatomi ak fizyoloji moun, byoloji selilè, ak evolisyon ak disèksyon mamifè.
Biology I Accelerated

strings.text: Differs significantly in range, depth, pace, and longer-term guided-independent laboratory work, with dissection central.
strings.t: Diferan siyifikativman nan etandi, pwofondè, vitès, ak travay laboratwa gide-endepandan ki pi long, ak disèksyon nan sant lan.
Anatomy and Physiology

strings.text: Students learn human anatomy and physiology while working in pairs on a semester-long cat dissection documented in portfolios.
strings.t: Elèv yo aprann anatomi ak fizyoloji moun pandan y ap travay an pè sou yon disèksyon chat ki dire yon semès ki dokimante nan pòtfèy.
Applied Sports Anatomy

strings.text: Students learn musculoskeletal anatomy and injury management, completing 15 hours as student athletic trainers for PDS teams.
strings.t: Elèv yo aprann anatomi mikilo-eskeletik ak jesyon blesi, epi yo konplete 15 èdtan kòm antrenè atletik elèv pou ekip PDS yo.
Astronomy

strings.text: Students study stars, galaxies, the solar system, and the composition, structure, and origins of the universe using astrolabs and sun spots.
strings.t: Elèv yo etidye zetwal, galaksi, sistèm solè a, ak konpozisyon, estrikti, ak orijin linivè a ak astrolab ak tach solè.
Bioethics/Biotechnology

strings.text: A lab and case-study course using micropipettes, PCR, DNA isolation, and gel electrophoresis while debating GMOs, transgenics, and cloning.
strings.t: Yon kou laboratwa ak etid ka ki sèvi ak mikwopipèt, PCR, izolasyon ADN, ak elektwoforèz jèl pandan y ap diskite sou OGM, transjenik, ak klonaj.
Environmental Sustainability

strings.text: A multidisciplinary exploration of sustainable development in urban planning, energy, water, and agriculture with hands-on work in Charger Gardens.
strings.t: Yon eksplorasyon ant disiplin sou devlopman dirab nan planifikasyon iben, enèji, dlo, ak agrikilti ak travay pratik nan Charger Gardens.
Forensic Science

strings.text: Students apply fingerprint analysis, DNA profiling, and bloodstain pattern interpretation through labs, simulations, and case studies.
strings.t: Elèv yo aplike analiz anprent dwèt, pwofil ADN, ak entèpretasyon modèl tach san atravè laboratwa, similasyon, ak etid ka.
Microbiology

strings.text: A hands-on introduction to bacteria and viruses, identifying environmental bacteria and discussing global topics such as antibiotic resistance.
strings.t: Yon entwodiksyon pratik nan bakteri ak viris, ki idantifye bakteri anviwònmantal epi ki diskite sijè mondyal tankou rezistans a antibyotik.
Neuroscience

strings.text: An introduction to the cellular and molecular functioning of the nervous system, recording electrical activity from nerves, muscles, and plants.
strings.t: Yon entwodiksyon nan fonksyònman selilè ak molekilè sistèm nève a, ak anrejistreman aktivite elektrik nan nè, mis, ak plant.
STEM Research and Design

strings.text: Students pursue original scientific research, choosing a topic, designing and conducting experiments, and presenting results.
strings.t: Elèv yo pouswiv rechèch syantifik orijinal, yo chwazi yon sijè, yo konsevwa epi fè eksperyans, epi yo prezante rezilta yo.
AP Biology

strings.text: Follows the College Board syllabus around evolution, energetics, information storage, and systems interactions with double periods for college-level labs.
strings.t: Swiv silabis College Board la otou evolisyon, enèjetik, depo enfòmasyon, ak entèraksyon sistèm ak peryòd doub pou laboratwa nivo inivèsite.
AP Chemistry

strings.text: In-depth study of atomic theory, chemical kinetics, thermodynamics, and equilibrium with double class periods for labs.
strings.t: Etid apwofondi sou teori atomik, sinetik chimik, tèmodinamik, ak ekilib ak peryòd klas doub pou laboratwa.
AP Environmental Science

strings.text: Provides principles to analyze natural and human-made environmental problems, synthesizing physics, chemistry, biology, geology, and economics.
strings.t: Bay prensip pou analize pwoblèm anviwònmantal natirèl ak sa moun fè, ki rasanble fizik, chimi, byoloji, jeyoloji, ak ekonomi.
AP Physics 1

strings.text: Students use algebra to study introductory college physics, analyzing data and developing models for systems, fields, forces, conservation, and waves.
strings.t: Elèv yo sèvi ak aljèb pou etidye fizik inivèsitè entwodiksyon, yo analize done epi yo devlope modèl pou sistèm, chan, fòs, konsèvasyon, ak vag.
AP Physics C

strings.text: Develops classical mechanics and electricity and magnetism concepts, meeting two periods daily for frequent laboratory activities.
strings.t: Devlope konsèp mekanik klasik ak elektrisite ak mayetis, ki reyini de peryòd chak jou pou aktivite laboratwa souvan.
Enfòmatik ak Inovasyon
Computer-Aided Design with 3D Printing

strings.text: An introduction to traditional mechanical drawing using CAD software plus 3D printing, isometric drawings, and full 3D modeling techniques.
strings.t: Yon entwodiksyon nan desen mekanik tradisyonèl ak lojisyèl CAD plis enprime 3D, desen izometrik, ak teknik modèl 3D konplè.
Computer Programming with Python

strings.text: Introduces programming in Python covering variables, data types, iteration, flow of control, functions, GUIs, and event-driven programming.
strings.t: Entwodui pwogramasyon nan Python ki kouvri varyab, kalite done, iterasyon, kontwòl flo, fonksyon, GUI, ak pwogramasyon ki mennen pa evènman.
Advanced Data Structures in Java

strings.text: For students who completed AP CS A, covering data abstraction and encapsulation including stacks, queues, linked lists, binary trees, and hash maps.
strings.t: Pou elèv ki fini AP CS A, ki kouvri abstraksyon done ak enkapsilasyon ki enkli pil, ke, lis ki lye, pyebwa binè, ak hash map.

strings.text: Game Development with Unity and C#
strings.t: Game Development with Unity and C#

strings.text: Students learn to develop video games from scratch using the C# language and Unity engine via the "Create with Code" curriculum.
strings.t: Elèv yo aprann devlope jwèt videyo depi nan zewo ak lang C# la ak motè Unity a atravè kourikoulòm “Create with Code” la.
iOS Programming with Swift

strings.text: Students use Xcode and the iOS SDK to learn Swift and the Cocoa Touch frameworks, testing apps on their own mobile devices.
strings.t: Elèv yo sèvi ak Xcode ak iOS SDK la pou aprann Swift ak kad Cocoa Touch yo, epi yo teste app sou pwòp aparèy mobil pa yo.
Physical Computing

strings.text: Students engineer interactive systems with Arduinos and Raspberry Pis using buttons, sensors, displays, LEDs, motors, and wireless modules.
strings.t: Elèv yo fè enjenyri sistèm entèaktif ak Arduino ak Raspberry Pi ak bouton, detektè, ekran, LED, motè, ak modil san fil.
Robotics & Engineering

strings.text: Explores robotics and engineering foundations and global issues in the field through hands-on problem solving and debate over ethical implications.
strings.t: Eksplore fondasyon robotik ak enjenyri ak pwoblèm mondyal nan domèn nan atravè rezolisyon pwoblèm pratik ak deba sou enplikasyon etik.
AP Computer Science A

strings.text: Follows the College Board syllabus in Java, emphasizing syntax, class structure, object-oriented methodologies, algorithms, and data structures.
strings.t: Swiv silabis College Board la nan Java, ak aksan sou sentaks, estrikti klas, metodoloji oryante objè, algoritm, ak estrikti done.
AP Computer Science Principles

strings.text: Engages students in creative aspects of computer science using computational tools to analyze large data sets and draw conclusions from trends.
strings.t: Angaje elèv yo nan aspè kreyatif syans enfòmatik ak zouti enfòmatik pou analize gwo ansanm done epi tire konklizyon nan tandans.
Konsepsyon ak Antreprenarya
Broadcast Journalism

strings.text: Students create and edit compelling stories in Adobe Premiere Pro, producing feature stories, interviews, sports, podcasts, and film challenges.
strings.t: Elèv yo kreye epi edite istwa ki atire nan Adobe Premiere Pro, epi yo pwodui istwa espesyal, entèvyou, espò, podcast, ak defi fim.
Introduction to Financial Analytics

strings.text: Covers daily personal finance skills through advanced topics such as the difference between fundamental and technical analysis.
strings.t: Kouvri konpetans finans pèsonèl chak jou atravè sijè avanse tankou diferans ant analiz fondamantal ak teknik.
Architecture Design

strings.text: Focuses on architectural design principles and Building Information Modeling using 3D CAD tools such as REVIT for floor plans, sections, and elevations.
strings.t: Konsantre sou prensip konsepsyon achitektiral ak Building Information Modeling ak zouti CAD 3D tankou REVIT pou plan etaj, seksyon, ak elevasyon.
Social Entrepreneurship

strings.text: An experiential course guiding students to launch businesses creating social value, rapidly testing ideas against customer and marketplace feedback.
strings.t: Yon kou eksperyansyèl ki gide elèv yo lanse biznis ki kreye valè sosyal, ki teste ide rapidman kont fidbak kliyan ak mache a.

strings.text: Students pursue original scientific research, designing and conducting experiments and presenting results; also carries Science credit.
strings.t: Elèv yo pouswiv rechèch syantifik orijinal, yo konsevwa epi fè eksperyans epi yo prezante rezilta yo; li bay kredi Syans tou.

strings.text: Students cultivate design-thinking skills as a studio of designers and enterprise of entrepreneurs to address pressing issues facing students.
strings.t: Elèv yo kiltive konpetans panse konsepsyon kòm yon estidyo konsèptè ak yon antrepriz antreprenè pou adrese pwoblèm ijan elèv yo ap konfwonte.
French / German / Spanish I–V

strings.text: Sequenced ACTFL-aligned courses progressing from Novice High through Intermediate Mid 2 proficiency across themes from family to health and storytelling.
strings.t: Kou an sekans ki aliyen ak ACTFL ki pwogrese soti Novice High rive nan metriz Intermediate Mid 2 atravè tèm soti nan fanmi rive nan sante ak rakonte istwa.
French / German / Spanish 6

strings.text: Advanced courses promoting fluency and accuracy toward Intermediate High proficiency, exploring culture in contemporary and historical contexts.
strings.t: Kou avanse ki ankouraje fasilite ak presizyon vè metriz Intermediate High, k ap eksplore kilti nan kontèks kontanporen ak istorik.
Spanish 7 Advanced: Conversation and Culture

strings.text: Develops strong conversational skills and deeper appreciation of Hispanic culture through formal and colloquial language and contact with native speakers.
strings.t: Devlope bon konpetans konvèsasyon ak yon apresyasyon pi pwofon pou kilti Ispanik atravè lang fòmèl ak familye ak kontak ak moun ki pale l natif natal.

strings.text: French 7 Advanced: Francophone Culture through Literature
strings.t: French 7 Advanced: Francophone Culture through Literature

strings.text: Improves proficiency and cultural awareness through francophone novels and graphic novels such as Oscar et la Dame Rose and Aya de Yopoungon.
strings.t: Amelyore metriz ak konsyans kiltirèl atravè woman ak woman grafik frankofòn tankou Oscar et la Dame Rose ak Aya de Yopoungon.

strings.text: French 7 Advanced: Francophone Culture through Movies
strings.t: French 7 Advanced: Francophone Culture through Movies

strings.text: Improves proficiency and cultural awareness through francophone films such as Bienvenue Chez les Ch’tis and Mariam.
strings.t: Amelyore metriz ak konsyans kiltirèl atravè fim frankofòn tankou Bienvenue Chez les Ch’tis ak Mariam.
AP French Language

strings.text: Prepares seniors for the AP French Language and Culture exam through persuasive essays and timed guided conversations using authentic sources.
strings.t: Prepare elèv dènye ane pou egzamen AP French Language and Culture la atravè redaksyon pèsuazif ak konvèsasyon gide ak tan limite ak sous otantik.
AP Spanish Language

strings.text: Prepares seniors for the AP Spanish Language Exam with a holistic proficiency approach and Spanish-only classroom conversation.
strings.t: Prepare elèv dènye ane pou Egzamen AP Spanish Language la ak yon apwòch metriz global ak konvèsasyon nan sal klas an panyòl sèlman.

strings.text: Familiarizes students with classical language acquisition through language, historical context, and Rome’s impact, covering daily life, gods, and heroes.
strings.t: Familyarize elèv yo ak akizisyon lang klasik atravè lang, kontèks istorik, ak enpak Wòm, ki kouvri lavi chak jou, bondye, ak ewo.

strings.text: Students read Latin stories set in ancient Rome, studying grammar concepts through themes of feasting, bathing, piracy, gladiators, and political unrest.
strings.t: Elèv yo li istwa an Laten ki fèt nan Wòm ansyen, epi yo etidye konsèp gramè atravè tèm fèt, beny, piratri, gladyatè, ak twoub politik.
Latin 3

strings.text: Reviews grammar and introduces clauses, progressing to unadapted Latin through the prose of Livy and Pliny and the poetry of Catullus.
strings.t: Revize gramè epi entwodui pwopozisyon, ki pwogrese vè Laten ki pa adapte atravè pwoz Livy ak Pliny ak pwezi Catullus.
Latin 4

strings.text: A literature course exploring the poetry of Catullus, Ovid, and Vergil, reading Latin aloud to hear meter and evaluate literary devices.
strings.t: Yon kou literati k ap eksplore pwezi Catullus, Ovid, ak Vergil, ak lekti Laten awotvwa pou tande mèt la epi evalye pwosede literè.
Latin 5 (Advanced)

strings.text: A prose and poetry literature course with a project-based comparative-texts component spanning Vergil, Pliny, Catullus, Ovid, Vespucci, and Boccaccio.
strings.t: Yon kou literati pwoz ak pwezi ak yon konpozan tèks konparatif ki baze sou pwojè ki kouvri Vergil, Pliny, Catullus, Ovid, Vespucci, ak Boccaccio.
AP Latin

strings.text: Presents the material and skills for the AP Latin Exam, analyzing text, recognizing literary devices, and citing underlying themes.
strings.t: Prezante materyèl ak konpetans pou Egzamen AP Latin la, ak analiz tèks, rekonesans pwosede literè, ak sitasyon tèm ki anba yo.
Mandarin Chinese 1–5

strings.text: Sequenced courses from Novice Mid to Intermediate Mid 1 proficiency across themes such as Greetings, Dining, Travel, and In the Restaurant.
strings.t: Kou an sekans soti Novice Mid rive nan metriz Intermediate Mid 1 atravè tèm tankou Salitasyon, Manje, Vwayaj, ak Nan Restoran an.
Mandarin Chinese 6 (Advanced)

strings.text: Consolidates Intermediate Mid 2 abilities while exploring contemporary Chinese culture in educational, social, and technological contexts.
strings.t: Konsolide kapasite Intermediate Mid 2 pandan l ap eksplore kilti chinwa kontanporen nan kontèks edikatif, sosyal, ak teknolojik.
Mandarin Chinese 7 (Advanced)

strings.text: Continues Intermediate Mid 2 consolidation, exploring culture through Education, Festivals, Environmental Challenges, and Healthy Living.
strings.t: Kontinye konsolidasyon Intermediate Mid 2, k ap eksplore kilti atravè Edikasyon, Fèt, Defi Anviwònmantal, ak Lavi Ansante.
AP Chinese Language and Culture

strings.text: Covers aural and oral skills, reading comprehension, grammar, and composition across the five goal areas, developing awareness of China’s global role.
strings.t: Kouvri konpetans oditif ak oral, konpreyansyon lekti, gramè, ak konpozisyon atravè senk domèn objektif yo, ki devlope konsyans wòl mondyal Lachin.
Atizay Vizyèl
Foundations of Art and Design
Kondisyon anvan

strings.text: Students learn to communicate visually through elements and principles of aesthetic design, exploring drawing, painting, and 3D design.
strings.t: Elèv yo aprann kominike vizyèlman atravè eleman ak prensip konsepsyon estetik, k ap eksplore desen, penti, ak konsepsyon 3D.
Drawing

strings.text: An introduction to drawing as visual investigation involving perspective, proportion, rendering, and expression across various techniques and media.
strings.t: Yon entwodiksyon nan desen kòm envestigasyon vizyèl ki enplike pèspektiv, pwopòsyon, randi, ak ekspresyon atravè plizyè teknik ak medya.
Painting

strings.text: Provides a foundation of painting concepts and techniques with water-based and mixed media, brush technique, and basic color theory.
strings.t: Bay yon fondasyon konsèp ak teknik penti ak medya ki baze sou dlo ak medya melanje, teknik penso, ak teori koulè debaz.
3D Design

strings.text: Students learn traditional black-and-white darkroom processes from film negatives plus digital color correction and manipulation in Adobe Photoshop.
strings.t: Elèv yo aprann pwosesis chanm nwa nwa-ak-blan tradisyonèl apati negatif fim plis koreksyon koulè dijital ak manipilasyon nan Adobe Photoshop.

strings.text: Introduces Adobe Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, and Premiere Pro for print, video, and web projects including logo design and photo compositing.
strings.t: Entwodui Adobe Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, ak Premiere Pro pou pwojè enprime, videyo, ak entènèt ki enkli konsepsyon logo ak konpozisyon foto.
Studio Art

strings.text: For highly motivated students ready to work independently, practicing various media, art criticism, and an individual exploratory approach.
strings.t: Pou elèv ki gen anpil motivasyon ki pare pou travay endepandamman, ak pratik nan plizyè medya, kritik atistik, ak yon apwòch eksplorasyon endividyèl.

strings.text: A year-long program of three portfolio courses — AP 2-D Art and Design, AP 3-D Art and Design, and AP Drawing — developing sustained investigation.

strings.text: Students select, cast, design, rehearse, and produce a one-act play, with tech-focused students serving as designers.
strings.t: Elèv yo chwazi, distribye wòl, konsevwa, repete, epi pwodui yon pyès yon-ak, ak elèv ki konsantre sou teknik k ap sèvi kòm konsèptè.

strings.text: Examines global theatrical traditions including Japanese Noh, Indian Kathakali, UK Pantomime, Italian Opera, and Brazilian Theatre of the Oppressed.

strings.text: Reading uses a structured literacy approach with phonemic awareness and phonics in early grades, shifting to morphology and active comprehension later.

strings.text: Emphasizes the "why" over rote memorization, moving from concrete manipulatives to pictorial representation to algorithmic understanding.

strings.text: JK covers My Five Senses, Animals, Weather and Sky, and Plants, progressing to Grade 4 Soils Rocks and Landforms, Environments, and Energy in the STEM Lab.

strings.text: JK covers friends and family, beginning maps, great Americans, and community helpers, progressing to Grade 4 North Carolina geography, history, economics, and government.

Etid biblik
Old Testament Survey

strings.text: Covers the historical flow of the Old Testament, acquainting students with the background, content, and message of each book.
strings.t: Kouvri flo istorik Ansyen Testaman an, ki fè elèv yo konnen kontèks, kontni, ak mesaj chak liv.
New Testament Survey

strings.text: An overview of the New Testament books covering the validity of Scripture, geography of Bible lands, and the life of Messiah Jesus.
strings.t: Yon gade jeneral sou liv Nouvo Testaman yo ki kouvri validite Ekriti a, jeyografi peyi Bib la, ak lavi Mesi Jezi a.
Christian Theology

strings.text: Surveys the essential doctrines of the Christian faith using both systematic and historical theology to answer "What is a Christian?"
strings.t: Fè yon survey sou doktrin esansyèl lafwa kretyen an ak teoloji sistematik ak istorik pou reponn “Kisa yon kretyen ye?”
World Religions

strings.text: Trains students to analyze and evaluate the truth claims of other faith systems, examining ancient, Eastern, Judaic, and Islamic religions plus cults.
strings.t: Antrene elèv yo analize epi evalye reklamasyon verite lòt sistèm lafwa, ak egzamen sou relijyon ansyen, Oryantal, Jidayik, ak Islamik plis sèk.
Apologetics and Cultural Engagement
Gr 12

strings.text: Equips students to articulate and live out their Christian faith, with first semester on apologetics and second on cultural engagement.
strings.t: Prepare elèv yo pou eksprime epi viv lafwa kretyen yo, ak premye semès sou apolojetik ak dezyèm sou angajman kiltirèl.
English 9

strings.text: Introduces high-school-level critical thinking, reading comprehension, research, and writing through a Survey of Genres.
strings.t: Entwodui panse kritik, konpreyansyon lekti, rechèch, ak ekriti nan nivo lekòl segondè atravè yon Survey Jan.
English 9 Honors

strings.text: Differs from English 9 in intensity, pace, and depth, with more reading, independent work, and complex writing assignments.
strings.t: Diferan de English 9 nan entansite, vitès, ak pwofondè, ak plis lekti, travay endepandan, ak devwa ekri konplèks.
English 10

strings.text: A Survey of American Literature built on the questions "what does it mean to be an American" and "what does freedom mean," from a biblical perspective.
strings.t: Yon Survey Literati Ameriken bati sou kesyon “kisa sa vle di pou w yon Ameriken” ak “kisa libète vle di,” nan yon pèspektiv biblik.
English 10 Honors

strings.text: Differs from English 10 in intensity, pace, and depth, demanding mastery of abstract concepts.
strings.t: Diferan de English 10 nan entansite, vitès, ak pwofondè, ki egzije metriz konsèp abstrè.
English 11

strings.text: A Survey of World Literature asking "What does it mean to be an engaged global citizen?" through literature of Latin America, Africa, and Asia.
strings.t: Yon Survey Literati Mondyal k ap mande “Kisa sa vle di pou w yon sitwayen mondyal ki angaje?” atravè literati Amerik Latin, Afrik, ak Azi.
English 11 Honors

strings.text: Differs from English 11 in pace and depth with focused intensity on fine-tuning already strong writing skills.
strings.t: Diferan de English 11 nan vitès ak pwofondè ak yon entansite konsantre sou rafine konpetans ekri ki deja solid.
English 12

strings.text: A Survey of European Literature and Legacy examining adulthood, choices, and consequences from Greek and Roman classics through modern Europe.
strings.t: Yon Survey Literati ak Eritaj Ewopeyen k ap egzamine laj granmoun, chwa, ak konsekans soti nan klasik Grèk ak Women rive nan Ewòp modèn.
English 12 Honors

strings.text: Differs from English 12 in pace and depth with focused intensity on refining strong writing skills.
strings.t: Diferan de English 12 nan vitès ak pwofondè ak yon entansite konsantre sou rafine konpetans ekri solid.

strings.text: Advanced Placement English Language and Composition
strings.t: Advanced Placement English Language and Composition

strings.text: An intensive course teaching students to read purposefully for complexity and nuance and write persuasively for varied audiences.
strings.t: Yon kou entansif ki anseye elèv yo li ak entansyon pou konpleksite ak nyans epi ekri yon fason pèsuazif pou odyans divès.

strings.text: Advanced Placement English Literature and Composition
strings.t: Advanced Placement English Literature and Composition

strings.text: Focuses on reading, analyzing, and writing about imaginative literature — fiction, poetry, and drama — from various periods.
strings.t: Konsantre sou li, analize, ak ekri sou literati imajinatif — fiksyon, pwezi, ak teyat — ki soti nan divès peryòd.
Introduction to Public Speaking

strings.text: Equips students with practical techniques to control the fear of public speaking, fulfilling the speech graduation requirement.
strings.t: Bay elèv yo teknik pratik pou kontwole laperèz pale an piblik, ki satisfè kondisyon diskou pou gradyasyon an.
Children's Literature and Film Study

strings.text: A general survey of children’s literature from early childhood books to young adult novels, pairing texts with their film versions.
strings.t: Yon survey jeneral sou literati timoun soti nan liv pou timoun piti rive nan woman pou jèn, ki makonnen tèks ak vèsyon fim yo.

strings.text: A workshop course spanning poetry, short story, humor and satire, personal essay, memoir, and creative nonfiction.
strings.t: Yon kou atelye ki kouvri pwezi, istwa kout, imè ak satir, redaksyon pèsonèl, memwa, ak tèks kreyatif ki pa fiksyon.

strings.text: Sci-Fi and Fantasy: Literature and Film through a Biblical Lens
strings.t: Sci-Fi and Fantasy: Literature and Film through a Biblical Lens

strings.text: Explores classic science fiction and fantasy — Lewis, Tolkien, Rowling — examining themes, symbolism, and allegory from a Christian worldview.
strings.t: Eksplore syans fiksyon ak fantezi klasik — Lewis, Tolkien, Rowling — k ap egzamine tèm, senbolis, ak alegori nan yon vizyon kretyen.

strings.text: Dystopian Literature and Film through a Biblical Lens
strings.t: Dystopian Literature and Film through a Biblical Lens

strings.text: Examines Orwell, Huxley, and Collins through a Christian lens to analyze what happens when societies reject God to build a "perfect" world.
strings.t: Egzamine Orwell, Huxley, ak Collins atravè yon lantiy kretyen pou analize sa k ap pase lè sosyete rejte Bondye pou bati yon mond “pafè”.
Poetry Workshop, Honors

strings.text: A rigorous course in both the creation and critical analysis of poetry, covering rhythm, imagery, metaphor, and structure.
strings.t: Yon kou rijid nan kreyasyon ak analiz kritik pwezi, ki kouvri rit, imaj, metafò, ak estrikti.

strings.text: Reviews pre-algebra skills and introduces integers, functions and graphs, equations and inequalities, linear and quadratic functions, and polynomials.
strings.t: Revize konpetans pre-aljèb epi entwodui antye relatif, fonksyon ak grafik, ekwasyon ak inegalite, fonksyon lineyè ak kadratik, ak polinòm.

strings.text: A thorough introduction to classical Euclidean geometry emphasizing deductive reasoning via lines, angles, triangles, circles, polygons, and solids.
strings.t: Yon entwodiksyon konplè nan jeyometri Euklidyen klasik ak aksan sou rezònman dediktif atravè liy, ang, triyang, sèk, poligòn, ak solid.
Geometry Honors

strings.text: Covers Euclidean geometry in a more formal, proof-centered approach at a more rigorous and faster pace.
strings.t: Kouvri jeyometri Euklidyen nan yon apwòch pi fòmèl ki santre sou prèv nan yon vitès pi rijid ak pi rapid.

strings.text: Study of the real number system emphasizing functions and their properties, including matrices, polynomial, exponential, and rational functions.
strings.t: Etid sistèm nonb reyèl la ak aksan sou fonksyon ak pwopriyete yo, ki enkli matris, fonksyon polinòm, eksponansyèl, ak rasyonèl.
Algebra II & Trigonometry

strings.text: Covers the Algebra II function content plus probability and a deeper understanding of trigonometric concepts.
strings.t: Kouvri kontni fonksyon Algebra II la plis pwobabilite ak yon konpreyansyon pi pwofon konsèp trigonometrik.
Algebra II & Trigonometry Honors

strings.text: A fast-paced course taking a deep look at the real number system, functions, probability, and trigonometry in detail.
strings.t: Yon kou rapid ki gade an pwofondè sistèm nonb reyèl la, fonksyon, pwobabilite, ak trigonometri an detay.

strings.text: Further development of modeling and applying linear, polynomial, exponential, trigonometric, power, and logarithmic functions plus sequences and series.
strings.t: Devlopman pi lwen nan modèl ak aplikasyon fonksyon lineyè, polinòm, eksponansyèl, trigonometrik, pisans, ak logaritmik plis sekans ak seri.
Pre-Calculus Honors

strings.text: For students who enjoy mathematics without the depth or stress of an AP course, adding analytic trigonometry, vectors, and an introduction to limits.
strings.t: Pou elèv ki renmen matematik san pwofondè oswa estrès yon kou AP, ki ajoute trigonometri analitik, vektè, ak yon entwodiksyon nan limit.
Advanced Placement Pre-Calculus

strings.text: Covers the topics of a freshman college algebra course with in-depth study of functions, analytic trigonometry, vectors, and discrete mathematics.
strings.t: Kouvri sijè yon kou aljèb inivèsitè premye ane ak etid apwofondi sou fonksyon, trigonometri analitik, vektè, ak matematik diskrè.
Advanced Placement Calculus AB

strings.text: A college-level course following a first-semester college calculus curriculum covering limits, derivatives, and integrals; single-blocked.
strings.t: Yon kou nivo inivèsite ki swiv yon kourikoulòm kalkil inivèsitè premye semès ki kouvri limit, derive, ak entegral; yon sèl blòk.
Advanced Placement Calculus BC

strings.text: Follows first- and second-semester college calculus, adding sequences, infinite series, and parametric, vector, and polar functions; double-blocked.
strings.t: Swiv kalkil inivèsitè premye ak dezyèm semès, ki ajoute sekans, seri enfini, ak fonksyon paramtetrik, vektoryèl, ak polè; doub blòk.
Probability, Statistics and Finite Mathematics

strings.text: Develops statistics — collecting, organizing, analyzing, and interpreting data — plus an elementary introduction to probability.
strings.t: Devlope estatistik — ranmase, òganize, analize, ak entèprete done — plis yon entwodiksyon elemantè nan pwobabilite.

strings.text: Probability, Statistics and Finite Mathematics Honors
strings.t: Probability, Statistics and Finite Mathematics Honors

strings.text: A fast-paced treatment of statistics and probability including distributions, statistical estimation and testing, and linear regression.
strings.t: Yon tretman rapid estatistik ak pwobabilite ki enkli distribisyon, estimasyon ak tès estatistik, ak regresyon lineyè.
Advanced Placement Statistics

strings.text: Examines and simulates probability distributions to predict and estimate future events, analyzing relationships via correlation and regression.
strings.t: Egzamine epi similye distribisyon pwobabilite pou predi ak estime evènman fiti, k ap analize relasyon atravè korelasyon ak regresyon.
Calculus III

strings.text: Follows AP Calculus with multivariable functions, vector-valued functions, curvature, double and triple integrals, and differential equations.
strings.t: Swiv AP Calculus ak fonksyon miltivaryab, fonksyon vektoryèl, koubi, entegral doub ak tripl, ak ekwasyon diferansyèl.

strings.text: Integrates class work with laboratory experience covering molecular life, cell structure and function, metabolism, genetics, and classification.
strings.t: Entegre travay klas ak eksperyans laboratwa ki kouvri lavi molekilè, estrikti ak fonksyon selil, metabolis, jenetik, ak klasifikasyon.
Biology Honors

strings.text: For students with exceptional math and science skills, covering Biology topics with increased breadth and depth.
strings.t: Pou elèv ki gen konpetans eksepsyonèl nan matematik ak syans, ki kouvri sijè Biology ak plis etandi ak pwofondè.

strings.text: Explores the composition, structure, properties, and transformation of matter through atomic theory, stoichiometry, bonding, and equilibrium.
strings.t: Eksplore konpozisyon, estrikti, pwopriyete, ak transfòmasyon matyè atravè teori atomik, estekyometri, lyezon, ak ekilib.
Chemistry Honors

strings.text: For students with exceptional aptitude in math and science, covering topics with increased breadth, depth, and lab time.
strings.t: Pou elèv ki gen aptitid eksepsyonèl nan matematik ak syans, ki kouvri sijè ak plis etandi, pwofondè, ak tan laboratwa.
Physics

strings.text: A general overview of Newtonian mechanics plus electricity, magnetism, light, and sound, with heavy emphasis on hands-on laboratory work.
strings.t: Yon gade jeneral sou mekanik Newtonyen plis elektrisite, mayetis, limyè, ak son, ak anpil aksan sou travay laboratwa pratik.
Physics Honors

strings.text: Investigates matter from subatomic particles to galaxies, training students to solve problems scientifically through classical mechanics and E&M.
strings.t: Envestige matyè soti nan patikil sibatomik rive nan galaksi, ki antrene elèv yo rezoud pwoblèm syantifikman atravè mekanik klasik ak E&M.
Advanced Placement Physics I

strings.text: Covers mechanics and fluids using an algebra-based approach, equivalent to the first semester of introductory college physics.
strings.t: Kouvri mekanik ak fliyid ak yon apwòch ki baze sou aljèb, ekivalan a premye semès fizik inivèsitè entwodiksyon.
Advanced Placement Biology

strings.text: Focuses on college-level biological principles and methodology, investigating cell structure and function, genetics, and ecology in depth.
strings.t: Konsantre sou prensip ak metodoloji byolojik nan nivo inivèsite, k ap envestige estrikti ak fonksyon selil, jenetik, ak ekoloji an pwofondè.
Advanced Placement Chemistry

strings.text: The equivalent of a general college chemistry course, investigating topics in depth and at a brisk pace.
strings.t: Ekivalan a yon kou chimi jeneral inivèsitè, k ap envestige sijè an pwofondè epi nan yon vitès rapid.
Advanced Placement Environmental Science

strings.text: An interdisciplinary college-level course on ecosystems, human population dynamics, resource use, pollution, and climate change.
strings.t: Yon kou ant disiplin nan nivo inivèsite sou ekosistèm, dinamik popilasyon moun, itilizasyon resous, polisyon, ak chanjman klimatik.
Environmental Science Honors

strings.text: A hands-on interdisciplinary elective on the interrelationships of the natural world, identifying environmental problems and evaluating solutions.
strings.t: Yon elektif pratik ant disiplin sou entèrelasyon mond natirèl la, ki idantifye pwoblèm anviwònmantal epi evalye solisyon.

strings.text: Explores the cosmos including constellations, the solar system, radiation and matter, black holes, galaxies, and dark matter.
strings.t: Eksplore kosmòs la ki enkli konstelasyon, sistèm solè a, radyasyon ak matyè, tou nwa, galaksi, ak matyè nwa.
Anatomy/Physiology

strings.text: A survey of the structure, function, and interactive dynamics of the human body, with case studies and required dissections.
strings.t: Yon survey sou estrikti, fonksyon, ak dinamik entèaktif kò moun, ak etid ka ak disèksyon obligatwa.
Forensic Science I

strings.text: Applies basic biological, chemical, and physical science principles to crime scene investigation, from the crime scene to the courtroom.
strings.t: Aplike prensip syans byolojik, chimik, ak fizik debaz nan envestigasyon sèn krim, soti nan sèn krim nan rive nan tribinal la.
Forensic Science II Honors

strings.text: Applies advanced science principles to crime scenes, focusing on laws and evaluation of evidence through extensive lab work.
strings.t: Aplike prensip syantifik avanse nan sèn krim, ak konsantrasyon sou lwa ak evalyasyon prèv atravè anpil travay laboratwa.
World History I: Ancient Civilizations

strings.text: Studies geography, world religions, and major developments from early civilizations through the mid 1300–1400s.
strings.t: Etidye jeyografi, relijyon mondyal, ak gwo devlopman soti nan premye sivilizasyon yo rive nan mitan ane 1300–1400 yo.

strings.text: World History I Honors: Ancient Civilizations
strings.t: World History I Honors: Ancient Civilizations

strings.text: Differs in intensity and depth, with primary-source analysis, document-based questions, and more writing to prepare for AP World History.
strings.t: Diferan nan entansite ak pwofondè, ak analiz sous prensipal, kesyon ki baze sou dokiman, ak plis ekri pou prepare pou AP World History.

strings.text: World History II: The World and the West
strings.t: World History II: The World and the West

strings.text: Surveys c. 1200 onward, exploring the political, religious, social, and ideological forces that shaped the modern world.

strings.text: World History II Honors: The World and the West
strings.t: World History II Honors: The World and the West

strings.text: Adds select honors-level topics, depth, and writing skills preparing students for future AP social studies courses.

Advanced Placement World History: Modern

strings.text: A college-level survey of major civilizations, events, religions, and ideologies from c. 1200 through the end of the twentieth century.
strings.t: Yon survey nivo inivèsite sou gwo sivilizasyon, evènman, relijyon, ak ideyoloji soti anviwon 1200 rive nan fen ventyèm syèk la.

strings.text: Surveys American history from Native American settlements to the end of the twentieth century against the backdrop of world and current events.
strings.t: Fè yon survey sou istwa ameriken soti nan etablisman Endyen Ameriken yo rive nan fen ventyèm syèk la sou fon evènman mondyal ak aktyalite.
United States History Honors

strings.text: Differs in intensity and depth, emphasizing examination of primary sources and writing assignments.
strings.t: Diferan nan entansite ak pwofondè, ak aksan sou egzamen sous prensipal ak devwa ekri.
Advanced Placement United States History

strings.text: Studies cultural, economic, political, and social developments shaping the U.S. from c. 1491 to the present.
strings.t: Etidye devlopman kiltirèl, ekonomik, politik, ak sosyal ki fòme Etazini soti anviwon 1491 rive jodi a.
American Government

strings.text: Gives a broad-based understanding of the institutions and purposes of American government, the political process, and civil liberties.
strings.t: Bay yon konpreyansyon laj sou enstitisyon ak objektif gouvènman ameriken an, pwosesis politik la, ak libète sivil.
American Government Honors

strings.t: Kouvri gouvènman ameriken an ak plis pwofondè epi li egzije yon papye rechèch semès sou fonksyònman entèn gouvènman an.
Economics

strings.text: Gives a broad-based understanding of the free-market economic system including macroeconomic and microeconomic elements.
strings.t: Bay yon konpreyansyon laj sou sistèm ekonomik mache lib la ki enkli eleman makwoekonomik ak mikwoekonomik.
Economics Honors

strings.text: Covers economics in greater depth and requires a semester research paper demonstrating deeper analysis of economic theory.
strings.t: Kouvri ekonomi ak plis pwofondè epi li egzije yon papye rechèch semès ki demontre yon analiz pi pwofon sou teori ekonomik.

strings.text: Advanced Placement United States Government & Politics
strings.t: Advanced Placement United States Government & Politics

strings.text: Gives a critical perspective on economics, politics, and government through general concepts and case studies of American political reality.
strings.t: Bay yon pèspektiv kritik sou ekonomi, politik, ak gouvènman atravè konsèp jeneral ak etid ka sou reyalite politik ameriken an.
Psychology

strings.text: An appreciation of the science of psychology across self, body, mind, environment, and mental health, integrating a Christian perspective.
strings.t: Yon apresyasyon syans sikoloji atravè tèt, kò, lespri, anviwònman, ak sante mantal, ki entegre yon pèspektiv kretyen.

strings.t: Etidye devlopman istorik ak disiplin kontanporen sikoloji atravè byoloji, koyisyon, ak fonksyònman sosyal.

strings.text: An overview of psychological theories and research relating to sport and exercise participation at both individual and group levels.

strings.t: Advanced Placement French Language and Culture
