strings.t: Sa a se yon kou nivo inivèsite kote elèv yo envestige evènman, moun, devlopman ak pwosesis istorik enpòtan nan istwa Etazini apeprè depi 1491 rive jounen jodi a.

strings.text: This course introduces students to the scientific study of human behavior and mental processes.
strings.t: Kou sa a entwodui elèv yo nan etid syantifik sou konpòtman moun ak pwosesis mantal.

strings.text: This course is a college-level course that introduces students to the systematic and scientific study of human behavior and mental processes.
strings.t: Kou sa a se yon kou nivo inivèsite ki entwodui elèv yo nan etid sistematik ak syantifik sou konpòtman moun ak pwosesis mantal.
Politics

strings.text: This course is a college prep level U.S. Government class that introduces students to the foundations, structures, and processes of the American political system.
strings.t: Kou sa a se yon klas U.S. Government nivo preparasyon pou inivèsite ki entwodui elèv yo nan fondasyon, estrikti ak pwosesis sistèm politik Ameriken an.
Honors Politics

strings.text: This course covers the same foundational topics as the college prep level U.S. Government course, but with greater depth, pace, and academic rigor.
strings.t: Kou sa a kouvri menm sijè fondamantal ak kou U.S. Government nivo preparasyon pou inivèsite a, men ak plis pwofondè, vitès ak rigè akademik.
Advanced Placement United States Government

strings.text: This course provides a college-level introduction to key political concepts, ideas, institutions, policies, interactions, roles, and behaviors that characterize the constitutional system and political culture of the United States.
strings.t: Kou sa a bay yon entwodiksyon nivo inivèsite nan konsèp, lide, enstitisyon, politik, entèraksyon, wòl ak konpòtman politik kle ki karakterize sistèm konstitisyonèl ak kilti politik Etazini.

strings.text: This course is a college prep level economics course that introduces students to the fundamental principles of economics with a primary focus on the American economic system.
strings.t: Kou sa a se yon kou ekonomi nivo preparasyon pou inivèsite ki entwodui elèv yo nan prensip fondamantal ekonomi ak yon konsantrasyon prensipal sou sistèm ekonomik Ameriken an.
Honors Economics

strings.text: This class provides students with a thorough understanding of the principles of economics that apply to the behavior of individual decision makers, including consumers and producers, within the larger economic system.
strings.t: Klas sa a bay elèv yo yon konpreyansyon apwofondi sou prensip ekonomi ki aplike nan konpòtman moun k ap pran desizyon endividyèl, ki enkli konsomatè ak pwodiktè, anndan sistèm ekonomik ki pi laj la.
Advanced Placement Microeconomics

strings.text: This class is a college-level course that introduces students to the principles of economics that apply to the behavior of individual consumers, firms, and resource owners.
strings.t: Klas sa a se yon kou nivo inivèsite ki entwodui elèv yo nan prensip ekonomi ki aplike nan konpòtman konsomatè, konpayi ak pwopriyetè resous endividyèl.
Advanced Placement European History

strings.text: This course begins with a brief orientation to philosophy and logic. The remainder of the course examines how God reveals himself to people.
strings.t: Kou sa a kòmanse ak yon ti oryantasyon nan filozofi ak lojik. Rès kou a egzamine kijan Bondye revele tèt li bay moun.
Teoloji
Faith and Revelation: Knowing

strings.text: The Blessed Trinity and Our Christian Vocation
strings.t: The Blessed Trinity and Our Christian Vocation

strings.text: This course presents the Blessed Trinity – one God in three divine Persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit – which is the central mystery of the Christian Faith.
strings.t: Kou sa a prezante Trinite Sen an – yon sèl Bondye nan twa Pèsòn divin: Papa, Pitit, ak Sentespri – ki se mistè santral Lafwa Kretyen an.
SASP Theology 9: Sacred Scripture

strings.text: Sacred Scripture offers students a deep encounter with the Word of God through a traditional, liberal arts lens.
strings.t: Sacred Scripture bay elèv yo yon rankont pwofon ak Pawòl Bondye a atravè yon pèspektiv tradisyonèl nan atizay liberal.

strings.text: The Mystery of Redemption and Christian
strings.t: The Mystery of Redemption and Christian

strings.text: This course examines the meaning of redemption; Original Sin; and how the salvific promise made to our first parents is fulfilled in the life, Death, Resurrection, and Ascension of Jesus Christ.
strings.t: Kou sa a egzamine sans redanmsyon an; Peche Orijinèl la; ak kijan pwomès sali yo te fè premye paran nou yo akonpli nan lavi, Lanmò, Rezirèksyon ak Asansyon Jezikri.
The Church: Sacrament of Salvation

strings.text: The Church, which is established by Jesus Christ and guided by the Holy Spirit, continues the salvific ministry of Christ in the world today; thus, the Church is both the Sacrament of Communion and the Sacrament of Salvation.
strings.t: Legliz la, ke Jezikri etabli epi Sentespri a gide, kontinye ministè sali Kris la nan mond lan jodi a; konsa, Legliz la se ni Sakreman Kominyon an ni Sakreman Sali a.

strings.text: SASP Theology 10: Wisdom of the Fathers
strings.t: SASP Theology 10: Wisdom of the Fathers

strings.text: This course will immerse students in the works of the major Fathers of the Church and discuss their influence on the theological development of the Church and its understanding of Divine Revelation (Sacred Tradition and Sacred Scripture).
strings.t: Kou sa a ap plonje elèv yo nan zèv gwo Papa Legliz yo epi diskite enfliyans yo sou devlopman teyolojik Legliz la ak konpreyansyon li sou Revelasyon Divin (Tradisyon Sakre ak Ekriti Sakre).

strings.text: The Sacraments: Source of Our Life in Christ
strings.t: The Sacraments: Source of Our Life in Christ

strings.text: This course recognizes how Jesus Christ, through his great love for us, instituted the Sacraments as the ordinary means of receiving salvation and entrusted them to the Church.
strings.t: Kou sa a rekonèt kijan Jezikri, atravè gwo lanmou li pou nou, te enstitisyone Sakreman yo kòm mwayen òdinè pou resevwa sali epi li te konfye yo bay Legliz la.
Our Moral Life in Christ

strings.text: Through participation in this course students will learn how a well-formed conscience is essential to make moral decisions.
strings.t: Nan patisipe nan kou sa a elèv yo ap aprann kijan yon konsyans byen fòme esansyèl pou pran desizyon moral.
Catholic Apologetics

strings.text: This course prepares students for active dialogue with non-Catholics in the public sphere.
strings.t: Kou sa a prepare elèv yo pou dyalòg aktif ak moun ki pa Katolik nan espas piblik la.

strings.text: Vocations and the Universal Call to Holiness
strings.t: Vocations and the Universal Call to Holiness

strings.text: This course explores the vocations of life that spring from our Baptism and how God calls each of us to holiness on earth and to eternal life with him in heaven.
strings.t: Kou sa a eksplore vokasyon nan lavi ki soti nan Batèm nou an ak kijan Bondye rele chak nan nou nan sentete sou latè epi nan lavi etènèl avè l nan syèl la.

strings.text: The Social Doctrine of the Catholic Church
strings.t: The Social Doctrine of the Catholic Church

strings.text: This course introduces students to the social teachings of the Catholic Church, a rich body of thought covering love and family, law and justice, war and peace, wealth and poverty, rights and duties, and freedom and obligation.
strings.t: Kou sa a entwodui elèv yo nan ansèyman sosyal Legliz Katolik la, yon kò panse rich ki kouvri lanmou ak fanmi, lwa ak jistis, lagè ak lapè, richès ak povrete, dwa ak devwa, ak libète ak obligasyon.
History of the Church

strings.text: This course begins with the story of God’s definitive intervention into human history in the Person of his Son and continues through his Church to the present day.
strings.t: Kou sa a kòmanse ak istwa entèvansyon definitif Bondye nan istwa moun nan Pèsòn Pitit li a epi li kontinye atravè Legliz li a jiska jounen jodi a.
Honors Gospel and Film

strings.text: This course will enable students to develop a standard for analyzing what they see portrayed in the cinema.
strings.t: Kou sa a ap pèmèt elèv yo devlope yon estanda pou analize sa yo wè yo prezante nan sinema.
Honors Ecumenical and Interreligious Studies

strings.text: This course presents an overview of world religions including Judaism, Christianity, Islam, Hinduism and Buddhism.
strings.t: Kou sa a prezante yon apèsi sou relijyon mondyal yo ki enkli Jidayis, Krisyanis, Islam, Endouyis ak Boudis.
Atizay Vizyèl ak Pèfòmans

strings.text: Art I is an introductory course focusing on fundamental art skills. Various media and tools are explored including painting, drawing, and sculpture.
strings.t: Art I se yon kou entwodiksyon ki konsantre sou ladrès atistik fondamantal. Yo eksplore divès mwayen ak zouti ki enkli penti, desen ak eskilti.

strings.text: Art II is an intermediate course focused on expanding on fundamental art skills learned in Art I, with an emphasis on further developing drawing techniques.
strings.t: Art II se yon kou entèmedyè ki konsantre sou elaji ladrès atistik fondamantal yo aprann nan Art I, ak yon aksan sou devlope teknik desen pi lwen.
Art III

strings.text: Art III is a proficient course focused on developing techniques in painting and printmaking.
strings.t: Art III se yon kou nivo konpetan ki konsantre sou devlope teknik nan penti ak enprimri.
Honors Portfolio Prep

strings.text: Honors Portfolio Prep is an advanced course designed to prepare students for AP Studio Art and college portfolio submissions.
strings.t: Honors Portfolio Prep se yon kou avanse ki fèt pou prepare elèv yo pou AP Studio Art ak soumisyon pòtfolyo pou inivèsite.
Honors Art IV

strings.text: Honors Art IV is an advanced course focusing on refining proficient art skills through experimental and advanced techniques.
strings.t: Honors Art IV se yon kou avanse ki konsantre sou rafine ladrès atistik konpetan atravè teknik eksperimantal ak avanse.
AP Studio Art

strings.text: AP Studio Art is a college equivalent course in which students create a 2D Design or a Drawing portfolio to be evaluated by the College Board.
strings.t: AP Studio Art se yon kou ekivalan a inivèsite kote elèv yo kreye yon pòtfolyo 2D Design oswa Drawing pou College Board evalye.
Ceramics I

strings.text: Ceramics I is an introductory course focusing on fundamental skills for working with clay.
strings.t: Ceramics I se yon kou entwodiksyon ki konsantre sou ladrès fondamantal pou travay ak ajil.
Ceramics II

strings.text: Ceramics II is an intermediate course focusing on fundamental skills for working with the pottery wheel.
strings.t: Ceramics II se yon kou entèmedyè ki konsantre sou ladrès fondamantal pou travay ak wou pòtri a.
Introduction to Photography

strings.text: Photography II is a continuation of Photography I and requires students to have a good working knowledge of DSLR camera controls and the fundamentals of composition.
strings.t: Photography II se yon kontinyasyon Photography I epi li mande pou elèv yo gen yon bon konesans pratik sou kontwòl kamera DSLR ak baz konpozisyon.
Photography II
Photography III

strings.text: Photography III is a continuation of Photography I and II and requires students to have a thorough knowledge of DSLR camera controls and the fundamentals of composition.
strings.t: Photography III se yon kontinyasyon Photography I ak II epi li mande pou elèv yo gen yon konesans apwofondi sou kontwòl kamera DSLR ak baz konpozisyon.
Digital Art and Graphic Design

strings.text: The foundational premise of graphic design is that the artist/designer uses words and pictures to tell a story.
strings.t: Premis fondamantal konsepsyon grafik la se ke atis/konseptè a sèvi ak mo ak imaj pou rakonte yon istwa.
Digital Art, Graphics, and Anime

strings.text: How digital art and graphics including anime took over the world. Students in this course will take a visual romp through the evolution of comics and advertising graphics, including the current anime craze, over the past century.
strings.t: Kijan atizay dijital ak grafik ki enkli anime te pran mond lan. Elèv nan kou sa a ap fè yon vwayaj vizyèl atravè evolisyon komik ak grafik piblisite, ki enkli angouman anime aktyèl la, pandan dènye syèk la.
Freshman Men’s Chorus

strings.text: This course offers incoming freshmen men an opportunity to develop their singing voices through choral singing, correct breathing, sight singing, and vocal production techniques.
strings.t: Kou sa a ofri nouvo elèv premye ane gason yo yon opòtinite pou devlope vwa yo nan chante atravè chan koral, respirasyon kòrèk, lekti mizik ak teknik pwodiksyon vokal.
Freshman Women’s Chorus

strings.text: This course offers incoming freshmen women an opportunity to develop their singing voices through choral singing, correct breathing, sight singing, and vocal production techniques.
strings.t: Kou sa a ofri nouvo elèv premye ane fi yo yon opòtinite pou devlope vwa yo nan chante atravè chan koral, respirasyon kòrèk, lekti mizik ak teknik pwodiksyon vokal.
Choral Ensemble

strings.text: The Choral Ensemble is an intermediate level choir of students who are continuing to develop their singing voices through choral singing, correct breathing, sight singing, and vocal production techniques.
strings.t: Choral Ensemble la se yon koral nivo entèmedyè pou elèv k ap kontinye devlope vwa yo nan chante atravè chan koral, respirasyon kòrèk, lekti mizik ak teknik pwodiksyon vokal.
Women’s Chamber Ensemble

strings.text: This course is an auditioned proficient level choir for women with previous singing experience.
strings.t: Kou sa a se yon koral nivo konpetan ak odisyon pou fanm ki gen eksperyans chante anvan.
Honors Women’s Chamber Ensemble

strings.text: This course is an auditioned proficient and advanced level choir for women with previous singing experience.
strings.t: Kou sa a se yon koral nivo konpetan ak avanse ak odisyon pou fanm ki gen eksperyans chante anvan.
Men’s Chamber Ensemble

strings.text: This course is an auditioned proficient level choir for men with previous singing experience.
strings.t: Kou sa a se yon koral nivo konpetan ak odisyon pou gason ki gen eksperyans chante anvan.
Honors Men’s Chamber Ensemble

strings.text: This course is an auditioned proficient and advanced level choir for men with previous singing experience.
strings.t: Kou sa a se yon koral nivo konpetan ak avanse ak odisyon pou gason ki gen eksperyans chante anvan.
Honors Concert Choir

strings.text: This course is an auditioned, advanced level mixed choir for men and women with significant previous singing experience.
strings.t: Kou sa a se yon koral melanje nivo avanse ak odisyon pou gason ak fanm ki gen anpil eksperyans chante anvan.
Costume Design and Production

strings.text: Join this award-winning class that will lay the groundwork for hands-on experience in the world of clothing design and application.
strings.t: Antre nan klas sa a ki genyen prim epi k ap poze baz pou eksperyans pratik nan mond konsepsyon ak aplikasyon rad.
Honors Costume Design and Production

strings.text: The clothes look great, but why do they look great? Learn about color theory and aesthetics to perfect your skills that can launch your career in the industry.
strings.t: Rad yo bèl, men poukisa yo bèl? Aprann sou teyori koulè ak estetik pou pafè ladrès ou yo ki ka lanse karyè ou nan endistri a.
Theatre: Design and Tech

strings.text: Interested in the craft of technical theatre? This program allows students the chance to design, build, rig, and engineer all the technical elements of our theatre performances.
strings.t: Èske ou enterese nan metye teyat teknik la? Pwogram sa a bay elèv yo chans pou konsevwa, konstwi, monte ak fè jeni sou tout eleman teknik nan pèfòmans teyat nou yo.
Honors Theatre: Design and Tech

strings.text: Perfect the craft, create and apply the vision. This advanced element of the course not only allows students to create the sets but gives them the tools to work in a professional setting, where all the concepts of design and aesthetics…
strings.t: Pafè metye a, kreye epi aplike vizyon an. Eleman avanse kou sa a pa sèlman kite elèv yo kreye dekò yo men li ba yo zouti pou travay nan yon anviwònman pwofesyonèl, kote tout konsèp konsepsyon ak estetik…

strings.text: On The Stage: Acting, Directing, Movie Making
strings.t: On The Stage: Acting, Directing, Movie Making

strings.text: Begin your journey to stardom as a student of the craft of acting, directing, and movie making.
strings.t: Kòmanse vwayaj ou pou vin yon vedèt kòm yon elèv nan metye aktè, mizansèn ak fè fim.

strings.text: Behind the Scenes: Set Design, Construction,
strings.t: Behind the Scenes: Set Design, Construction,

strings.text: Come see how we make it look easy. The world of stage craft is vast and can lend itself to numerous other career paths.
strings.t: Vin wè kijan nou fè l parèt fasil. Mond metye sèn nan vas epi li ka mennen nan anpil lòt chemen karyè.

strings.text: This course is offered to students who desire to seriously pursue all acting techniques for the stage as well as screen.
strings.t: Kou sa a ofri pou elèv ki vle pouswiv seryezman tout teknik aktè pou sèn nan ansanm ak pou ekran.
Honors Acting

strings.text: Honors Acting requires students to put time, energy and commitment into fulfilling superior theater student requirements.
strings.t: Honors Acting mande pou elèv yo mete tan, enèji ak angajman pou ranpli egzijans siperyè pou yon elèv nan teyat.
Honors TV, Film, and Production

strings.text: This course furthers the knowledge of the principles, procedures, and techniques of television/web series production.
strings.t: Kou sa a avanse konesans sou prensip, pwosedi ak teknik pwodiksyon televizyon/seri sou entènèt.
Dance I

strings.text: Dance I is an introductory course for incoming freshmen with little or no formal dance instruction, but offered to those interested in learning and possibly furthering their dance knowledge and technique.
strings.t: Dance I se yon kou entwodiksyon pou nouvo elèv premye ane ki gen tikras oswa okenn enstriksyon fòmèl nan dans, men ki ofri pou moun ki enterese aprann epi petèt avanse konesans ak teknik dans yo.
Dance II

strings.text: Dance II is an intermediate to advanced level dance class in which students with previous dance experience either outside of school or through Dance I freshman year can continue to improve their dance techniques and performance skills.
strings.t: Dance II se yon klas dans nivo entèmedyè a avanse kote elèv ki gen eksperyans dans anvan swa deyò lekòl la oswa atravè Dance I nan premye ane ka kontinye amelyore teknik dans ak ladrès pèfòmans yo.
Honors Dance III

strings.text: Dance III is an honors level performance course which highlights the advanced technique skills of students through the application of choreography The class meets the full year and two staged recitals are required including the use of…
strings.t: Dance III se yon kou pèfòmans nivo honors ki mete an valè ladrès teknik avanse elèv yo atravè aplikasyon koregrafi. Klas la reyini pou tout ane a epi de resital sou sèn obligatwa ki enkli itilizasyon…
Concert Band

strings.text: Students with playing experience are eligible for this class through an audition. Students accepted into this ensemble are expected to be proficient on their instrument, have a basic knowledge of music theory, and be fluent in reading…
strings.t: Elèv ki gen eksperyans jwe kalifye pou klas sa a atravè yon odisyon. Nou atann elèv yo aksepte nan ansanm sa a konpetan sou enstriman yo, gen yon konesans debaz nan teyori mizik, epi fasil nan lekti…
Honors Wind Ensemble

strings.text: This class is for juniors and seniors who have completed one year of Concert Band and who wish to receive honors credit for their participation in band.
strings.t: Klas sa a se pou elèv twazyèm ak katriyèm ane ki fin fè yon ane nan Concert Band epi ki vle resevwa kredi honors pou patisipasyon yo nan fanfa a.
Percussion

strings.text: This class is for members of the symphonic band who play percussion instruments. The class will cover the fundamentals of playing percussion instruments and application of musicianship skills to the genre.
strings.t: Klas sa a se pou manm fanfa senfonik la ki jwe enstriman pèkisyon. Klas la ap kouvri baz pou jwe enstriman pèkisyon ak aplikasyon ladrès mizikal nan jan sa a.
Honors Percussion

strings.text: This class is for members of the percussion group who wish to receive honors credit for their participation in band.
strings.t: Klas sa a se pou manm gwoup pèkisyon an ki vle resevwa kredi honors pou patisipasyon yo nan fanfa a.

strings.text: This course is designed as a performance based class to give an understanding of the fundamentals of acoustic guitar playing.
strings.t: Kou sa a fèt kòm yon klas ki baze sou pèfòmans pou bay yon konpreyansyon sou baz jwe gita akoustik.
Guitar II

strings.text: This course is designed for the intermediate-advanced guitar student. The course will be a continuation of the material covered in Guitar I with more emphasis on improving the fundamentals with sight reading, scales, chord spellings,…
strings.t: Kou sa a fèt pou elèv gita nivo entèmedyè-avanse. Kou a ap se yon kontinyasyon materyèl Guitar I kouvri a ak plis aksan sou amelyore baz yo ak lekti a vi, gam, konpozisyon akò,…
French I

strings.text: The French I course involves the elementary acquisition of the four fundamental skills of learning the language: reading, writing, listening, and speaking.
strings.t: Kou French I la enplike akizisyon elemantè kat ladrès fondamantal pou aprann lang lan: lekti, ekriti, koute ak pale.
French II

strings.text: This course is designed to continue the foundation learned in French I and build a greater understanding and comprehension of reading, writing, listening, and speaking.
strings.t: Kou sa a fèt pou kontinye fondasyon yo aprann nan French I epi bati yon pi gwo konpreyansyon nan lekti, ekriti, koute ak pale.
Advanced French II
Advanced French III

strings.text: This course is an advanced course designed to develop in the students a greater understanding and comprehension of the French language, by continuing the development and application of the language on reading, writing, listening and…
strings.t: Kou sa a se yon kou avanse ki fèt pou devlope nan elèv yo yon pi gwo konpreyansyon sou lang Franse a, lè li kontinye devlopman ak aplikasyon lang lan nan lekti, ekriti, koute ak…
Honors French III

strings.text: This course is designed to prepare the student for Honors Spanish IV or AP French Language and Culture, developing in the student a greater comprehension and understanding of more complex reading, writing, listening and speaking.
strings.t: Kou sa a fèt pou prepare elèv la pou Honors Spanish IV oswa AP French Language and Culture, pou devlope nan elèv la yon pi gwo konpreyansyon nan lekti, ekriti, koute ak pale ki pi konplèks.
Honors French IV

strings.text: On the linguistic level, the acquisition and honing of the four language skills are still constant goals within a culturally rich setting.
strings.t: Sou plan lengwistik, akizisyon ak rafinman kat ladrès lang yo toujou rete objektif konstan nan yon anviwònman rich sou plan kiltirèl.
Advanced Placement French V

strings.text: The Advanced Placement French Language and Culture course is equivalent to an introductory college-level course and is designed to advance students’ communicative proficiency in French within a culturally rich and content-based framework.
strings.t: Kou Advanced Placement French Language and Culture la ekivalan ak yon kou entwodiksyon nivo inivèsite epi li fèt pou avanse konpetans kominikasyon elèv yo an Franse nan yon kad ki rich sou plan kiltirèl epi ki baze sou kontni.
German I

strings.text: The German I course involves the elementary acquisition of the four fundamental skills of learning the language: reading, writing, listening, and speaking.
strings.t: Kou German I la enplike akizisyon elemantè kat ladrès fondamantal pou aprann lang lan: lekti, ekriti, koute ak pale.
German II

strings.text: This course is designed to continue the foundation learned in German I and build a greater understanding and comprehension of reading, writing, listening, and speaking.
strings.t: Kou sa a fèt pou kontinye fondasyon yo aprann nan German I epi bati yon pi gwo konpreyansyon nan lekti, ekriti, koute ak pale.
Honors German III

strings.text: This course is designed to prepare the student for Honors German IV or AP German Language and Culture, developing in the student a greater comprehension and understanding of more complex reading, writing, listening and speaking.
strings.t: Kou sa a fèt pou prepare elèv la pou Honors German IV oswa AP German Language and Culture, pou devlope nan elèv la yon pi gwo konpreyansyon nan lekti, ekriti, koute ak pale ki pi konplèks.
Honors German IV
Advanced Placement German V

strings.text: The Advanced Placement German Language and Culture course is equivalent to an introductory college-level course and is designed to advance students’ communicative proficiency in German within a culturally rich and content-based framework.
strings.t: Kou Advanced Placement German Language and Culture la ekivalan ak yon kou entwodiksyon nivo inivèsite epi li fèt pou avanse konpetans kominikasyon elèv yo an Alman nan yon kad ki rich sou plan kiltirèl epi ki baze sou kontni.

strings.text: The Latin I course involves the elementary acquisition of Latin grammar, reading, and vocabulary.
strings.t: Kou Latin I la enplike akizisyon elemantè gramè, lekti ak vokabilè Laten.
Latin II

strings.text: This course is designed to continue the foundation learned in Latin I and build a greater understanding of complex sentence structures, increase vocabulary and help students prepare to read from well known authors from the ancient world.
strings.t: Kou sa a fèt pou kontinye fondasyon yo aprann nan Latin I epi bati yon pi gwo konpreyansyon sou estrikti fraz konplèks, ogmante vokabilè epi ede elèv yo prepare pou li otè byen koni nan mond ansyen an.
Advanced Latin II
Advanced Latin III

strings.text: Advanced Latin III will further review and apply Latin vocabulary and grammar. Students will explore readings in adapted and authentic Latin literature, while learning to read and interpret prose and poetry.
strings.t: Advanced Latin III ap revize epi aplike vokabilè ak gramè Laten pi lwen. Elèv yo ap eksplore lekti nan literati Laten adapte ak otantik, pandan y ap aprann li epi entèprete pwoz ak pwezi.
Honors Latin III

strings.text: This course is designed for students whose demonstrated mastery of Latin fundamentals indicates readiness for authentic literary texts.
strings.t: Kou sa a fèt pou elèv ki montre metriz baz Laten yo ki endike yo pare pou tèks literè otantik.
Honors Latin lV

strings.text: This course emphasizes the rhetorical, metrical, and cultural conventions of epic and lyric poetry.
strings.t: Kou sa a mete aksan sou konvansyon retorik, metrik ak kiltirèl nan pwezi epik ak lirik.

strings.text: The Advanced Placement Latin course focuses on advanced Latin language acquisition through close reading, textual analysis, and contextualization of authentic texts.
strings.t: Kou Advanced Placement Latin la konsantre sou akizisyon avanse nan lang Laten atravè lekti apwofondi, analiz tèks ak kontekstyalizasyon tèks otantik.
Spanish I

strings.text: The Spanish I course involves the elementary acquisition of the four fundamental skills of learning the language: reading, writing, listening, and speaking.
strings.t: Kou Spanish I la enplike akizisyon elemantè kat ladrès fondamantal pou aprann lang lan: lekti, ekriti, koute ak pale.
Spanish II

strings.text: This course is designed to continue the foundation learned in Spanish 1 and build a greater understanding and comprehension of reading, writing, listening, and speaking.
strings.t: Kou sa a fèt pou kontinye fondasyon yo aprann nan Spanish 1 epi bati yon pi gwo konpreyansyon nan lekti, ekriti, koute ak pale.
Advanced Spanish II
Advanced Spanish III

strings.text: This course is an advanced course designed to develop in the students a greater understanding and comprehension of the Spanish language, by continuing the development and application of the language on reading, writing, listening and…
strings.t: Kou sa a se yon kou avanse ki fèt pou devlope nan elèv yo yon pi gwo konpreyansyon sou lang Panyòl la, lè li kontinye devlopman ak aplikasyon lang lan nan lekti, ekriti, koute ak…
Advanced Spanish III - Native Speaker

strings.text: This course is an advanced course designed for students who already speak Spanish at home or in their communities.
strings.t: Kou sa a se yon kou avanse ki fèt pou elèv ki deja pale Panyòl lakay yo oswa nan kominote yo.
Honors Spanish III

strings.text: This course is designed to prepare the student for Honors Spanish IV or AP Spanish Language and Culture, developing in the student a greater comprehension and understanding of more complex reading, writing, listening and speaking.
strings.t: Kou sa a fèt pou prepare elèv la pou Honors Spanish IV oswa AP Spanish Language and Culture, pou devlope nan elèv la yon pi gwo konpreyansyon nan lekti, ekriti, koute ak pale ki pi konplèks.
Honors Spanish IV
Advanced Placement Spanish V:

strings.text: The Advanced Placement Spanish Language and Culture course is equivalent to an introductory college-level course and is designed to advance students’ communicative proficiency in Spanish within a culturally rich and content-based framework.
strings.t: Kou Advanced Placement Spanish Language and Culture la ekivalan ak yon kou entwodiksyon nivo inivèsite epi li fèt pou avanse konpetans kominikasyon elèv yo an Panyòl nan yon kad ki rich sou plan kiltirèl epi ki baze sou kontni.
Advanced Placement Spanish VI:

strings.text: The Advanced Placement Spanish Literature and Culture course is equivalent to a college-level literature course and is designed to advance students’ interpretive, analytical, and communicative skills in Spanish.
strings.t: Kou Advanced Placement Spanish Literature and Culture la ekivalan ak yon kou literati nivo inivèsite epi li fèt pou avanse ladrès entèpretasyon, analiz ak kominikasyon elèv yo an Panyòl.
Enskripsyon Doub
Doub enskripsyon: Public Speaking

strings.text: This course provides instruction and experience in preparation and delivery of speeches within a public setting and group discussion.
strings.t: Kou sa a bay enstriksyon ak eksperyans nan preparasyon ak prezantasyon diskou nan yon anviwònman piblik ak diskisyon an gwoup.
Doub enskripsyon: Introduction to Sociology

strings.text: This course introduces the scientific study of human society, culture, and social interactions.
strings.t: Kou sa a entwodui etid syantifik sou sosyete moun, kilti ak entèraksyon sosyal.

strings.text: 10 subject areas — both French and Spanish from JK, a Design Lab, and a Grade 4 Exhibition research capstone.
strings.t: 10 domèn matyè — ni Franse ni Panyòl apati JK, yon Design Lab, ak yon kapston rechèch Exhibition nan Grad 4.

strings.text: Charlotte Country Day publishes ten Lower School subject areas, described narratively per grade, rather than named courses. There is no Lower School course catalogue.
strings.t: Charlotte Country Day pibliye dis domèn matyè Lower School, dekri an naratif pa nivo, olye ke kou ki gen non. Pa gen okenn katalòg kou Lower School.
Units of Inquiry
JK

strings.text: Intentionally weave together literacy, math, science, and social studies instruction.
strings.t: Espre makonnen ansanm enstriksyon alfabetizasyon, matematik, syans, ak syans sosyal.
Atizay Lang / Alfabetizasyon

strings.text: Focuses on the Five Pillars of Reading — phonics, phonological awareness, fluency, vocabulary, and comprehension — embedded throughout the day.
strings.t: Konsantre sou Senk Pilye Lekti yo — fonik, konsyans fonolojik, fasilite, vokabilè, ak konpreyansyon — entegre pandan tout jounen an.

strings.text: Develops number sense, spatial awareness, and math language through active exploration and hands-on games toward rigorous problem solving.
strings.t: Devlope sans nonb, konsyans espasyal, ak lang matematik atravè eksplorasyon aktif ak jwèt pratik vè rezolisyon pwoblèm rijid.

strings.text: Hands-on investigation via the scientific method across physical, life, and earth sciences — from seasonal change in JK to the solar system by Grade 4.
strings.t: Envestigasyon pratik atravè metòd syantifik la nan syans fizik, lavi, ak tè — soti nan chanjman sezon nan JK rive nan sistèm solè a nan Grad 4.

strings.text: Examines people in relation to their past, present, and future, their environment, and their society.
strings.t: Egzamine moun parapò ak tan lontan yo, jodi a ak demen yo, anviwònman yo, ak sosyete yo.
Lang Modèn
Franse ak Panyòl

strings.text: All students are exposed to both French and Spanish, progressing from the sound of each language to the four language skills plus basic writing by Grade 4.
strings.t: Yo ekspoze tout elèv yo a Franse ak Panyòl tou de, ki pwogrese soti nan son chak lang rive nan kat konpetans lang yo plis ekri debaz nan Grad 4.
Atizay, PE ak Konsepsyon
Bozar (Atizay, Mizik, Teyat)
Chak semèn

strings.text: Weekly immersion in art, music, and drama to instill a love of the arts and build design-thinking skills.
strings.t: Imèsyon chak semèn nan atizay, mizik, ak teyat pou enstale yon lanmou pou atizay yo epi bati konpetans panse konsepsyon.
Chak jou

strings.text: A daily opportunity to move, play, and learn, developing gross motor, body control, and spatial awareness skills.
strings.t: Yon opòtinite chak jou pou deplase, jwe, ak aprann, ki devlope konpetans motè gwo, kontwòl kò, ak konsyans espasyal.
Design Lab

strings.text: Engineering, coding, robotics, 3D printing, and multi-media design used to solve design problems collaboratively.
strings.t: Enjenyri, kodaj, robotik, enprime 3D, ak konsepsyon miltimedya yo sèvi pou rezoud pwoblèm konsepsyon an kolaborasyon.
Bibliyotèk / Alfabetizasyon Enfòmasyon

strings.text: Supports a growing love of reading and builds toward the full research cycle, applied in the Grade 4 Exhibition project.
strings.t: Sipòte yon lanmou k ap grandi pou lekti epi li bati vè sik rechèch konplè a, aplike nan pwojè Exhibition Grad 4 la.

strings.text: Nine named math tracks plus grade-level subjects across 6 areas — Geometry for high-school credit as early as Grade 8.
strings.t: Nèf pis matematik ki gen non plis matyè pa nivo atravè 6 domèn — Geometry pou kredi lekòl segondè depi Grad 8.

strings.text: Country Day publishes named Middle School courses only for mathematics; other disciplines are published as grade-level subjects. There is no Middle School course catalogue.
strings.t: Country Day pibliye kou Middle School ki gen non sèlman pou matematik; lòt disiplin yo pibliye kòm matyè pa nivo. Pa gen okenn katalòg kou Middle School.
Fifth Grade Math

strings.text: Addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of whole numbers, decimals, and fractions, concluding with basic geometry.
strings.t: Adisyon, soustraksyon, miltiplikasyon, ak divizyon nonb antye, desimal, ak fraksyon, ki fini ak jeyometri debaz.
Sixth Grade Math

strings.text: The number line, values, operations with decimals and fractions, ratio and percent, and algebraic expressions and equations.
strings.t: Liy nonb nan, valè, operasyon ak desimal ak fraksyon, rapò ak pousantaj, ak ekspresyon ak ekwasyon aljebrik.
Sixth Grade Pre-Algebra

strings.text: Number sense, fractions, factors, exponents, simplifying expressions, and solving and graphing linear equations.
strings.t: Sans nonb, fraksyon, faktè, ekspozan, senplifye ekspresyon, ak rezoud ak grafike ekwasyon lineyè.

strings.text: Number sense, fractions, factors, exponents, linear equations, ratios, proportions, percent, probability, and statistics.
strings.t: Sans nonb, fraksyon, faktè, ekspozan, ekwasyon lineyè, rapò, pwopòsyon, pousantaj, pwobabilite, ak estatistik.
Honors Pre-Algebra

strings.text: The same topics as Pre-Algebra covered in greater depth and at a faster pace.
strings.t: Menm sijè ak Pre-Algebra kouvri ak plis pwofondè epi nan yon vitès pi rapid.
Honors Algebra 1

strings.text: Algebra foundations, linear functions and systems, exponents, polynomials, quadratics, radicals, and an introduction to geometry.
strings.t: Fondasyon aljèb, fonksyon ak sistèm lineyè, ekspozan, polinòm, kadratik, radikal, ak yon entwodiksyon nan jeyometri.
Algebra 8A

strings.text: Foundational expressions, equations, and linear functions for students needing additional preparation.
strings.t: Ekspresyon, ekwasyon, ak fonksyon lineyè fondasyonèl pou elèv ki bezwen plis preparasyon.
Algebra 1

strings.text: Full high-school Algebra I covering linear functions and systems, exponents, polynomials, quadratics, and radicals.
strings.t: Algebra I konplè nivo lekòl segondè ki kouvri fonksyon ak sistèm lineyè, ekspozan, polinòm, kadratik, ak radikal.
Kredi HS

strings.text: Placement for students who completed Honors Algebra I, studying deductive reasoning, proofs, trigonometry, and coordinate geometry.
strings.t: Plasman pou elèv ki fini Honors Algebra I, k ap etidye rezònman dediktif, prèv, trigonometri, ak jeyometri kòdone.
Angle ak Syans Sosyal
Atizay Lang ak Syans Sosyal (entegre)

strings.text: An integrated program featuring cross-curricular reading to enhance understanding of the world and writing to communicate key ideas and opinions.
strings.t: Yon pwogram entegre ki prezante lekti ant kourikoulòm pou amelyore konpreyansyon mond lan ak ekri pou kominike lide ak opinyon kle.

strings.text: Students journey through the past learning about the creation and development of communities in global civilizations.
strings.t: Elèv yo vwayaje atravè tan lontan pou aprann sou kreyasyon ak devlopman kominote nan sivilizasyon mondyal.

strings.text: Further develops basic communication skills through the study of literature, reading strategies, and process writing.
strings.t: Devlope pi lwen konpetans kominikasyon debaz atravè etid literati, estrateji lekti, ak ekri pwosesis.

strings.text: Builds understanding of global geography and cultures while investigating the major turning points shaping the world through inquiry-based learning.
strings.t: Bati konpreyansyon jeyografi ak kilti mondyal pandan l ap envestige gwo pwen chanjman ki fòme mond lan atravè aprantisaj ki baze sou envestigasyon.

strings.text: Uses both classic and contemporary literature to help foster a love of reading and writing.
strings.t: Sèvi ak literati klasik ak kontanporen pou ede ankouraje yon lanmou pou lekti ak ekri.

strings.text: Examines U.S. history from the late nineteenth century through the twentieth, from Reconstruction through Watergate.
strings.t: Egzamine istwa Etazini soti nan fen diznevyèm syèk la rive nan ventyèm nan, soti nan Rekonstriksyon rive nan Watergate.
Syans ak Enjenyri

strings.text: Students become working scientists, making authentic connections to the world and constructing solutions using the engineering design process.
strings.t: Elèv yo vin syantifik k ap travay, ki fè koneksyon otantik ak mond lan epi ki konstwi solisyon ak pwosesis konsepsyon enjenyri a.
Syans: Forces of Change

strings.text: Examines topics through the lens of Forces of Change while using the scientific method and the engineering design process.
strings.t: Egzamine sijè atravè lantiy Forces of Change la pandan l ap sèvi ak metòd syantifik la ak pwosesis konsepsyon enjenyri a.

strings.text: Inquiry-based study of the human body covering energy, body systems, cells, genetics, natural selection, and energy transformations.
strings.t: Etid ki baze sou envestigasyon sou kò moun ki kouvri enèji, sistèm kò, selil, jenetik, seleksyon natirèl, ak transfòmasyon enèji.

strings.text: An introduction to the multidisciplinary field of environmental science, using case studies to evaluate environmental issues.
strings.t: Yon entwodiksyon nan domèn ant disiplin syans anviwònmantal, ak etid ka pou evalye pwoblèm anviwònmantal.

strings.text: Scaffolded across the Middle School with design-thinking and prototyping work.
strings.t: Etaje atravè Middle School la ak travay panse konsepsyon ak pwototip.
Lang Modèn ak Klasik

strings.text: A proficiency-oriented course practicing reading, writing, listening, and speaking in interpretive, interpersonal, and presentational modes.
strings.t: Yon kou oryante sou metriz k ap pratike li, ekri, koute, ak pale nan mòd entèpretatif, entèpèsonèl, ak prezantasyonèl.
Franse

strings.text: Develops language competency and cultural awareness through thematic units using authentic websites, videos, print, and maps.
strings.t: Devlope konpetans lang ak konsyans kiltirèl atravè inite tematik ak sit entènèt otantik, videyo, enprime, ak kat.
Laten

strings.text: Offered as one of the Middle School language options alongside French and Spanish.
strings.t: Ofri kòm youn nan opsyon lang Middle School yo ansanm ak Franse ak Panyòl.
Atizay Vizyèl

strings.text: Foundational visual-arts instruction expanding individual skill sets across the Middle School years.
strings.t: Enstriksyon atizay vizyèl fondasyonèl ki elaji konpetans endividyèl atravè ane Middle School yo.

strings.text: An instrumental ensemble in wind and percussion performance.
strings.t: Yon ansanm enstrimantal nan pèfòmans van ak pèkisyon.

strings.text: A vocal ensemble developing singing skills and musical understanding.
strings.t: Yon ansanm vokal ki devlope konpetans chante ak konpreyansyon mizikal.

strings.text: Instrumental ensemble training for string players.
strings.t: Antrènman ansanm enstrimantal pou jwè kòd.

strings.text: Performing-arts instruction developing creative thinking and self-expression.
strings.t: Enstriksyon atizay pèfòmans ki devlope panse kreyatif ak ekspresyon pèsonèl.
General Music

strings.text: Musical fundamentals and concepts for all fifth-grade students.
strings.t: Baz ak konsèp mizikal pou tout elèv senkyèm ane.
PE, Sante ak Advisory

strings.text: A daily class focused on individual fitness improvement, cardiovascular endurance, physical strength, and exposure to various sports.
strings.t: Yon klas chak jou ki konsantre sou amelyorasyon fòm fizik endividyèl, andirans kadyovaskilè, fòs fizik, ak ekspozisyon a divès espò.

strings.text: Instruction on human growth and development including reproductive systems and childbirth.
strings.t: Enstriksyon sou kwasans ak devlopman moun ki enkli sistèm repwodiktif ak akouchman.

strings.text: Focuses on nutrition, emphasizing "Food is Fuel" and how bodies use energy.
strings.t: Konsantre sou nitrisyon, ak aksan sou “Manje se Konbistib” ak kijan kò a sèvi ak enèji.

strings.text: Identity, stress management, coping skills, mental well-being, and decision making, including social-media impacts.
strings.t: Idantite, jesyon estrès, konpetans pou fè fas, byennèt mantal, ak pran desizyon, ki enkli enpak medya sosyal.

strings.text: Human growth and development, decision making, and reproductive systems.
strings.t: Kwasans ak devlopman moun, pran desizyon, ak sistèm repwodiktif.
Konsèy

strings.text: Life-skills development addressing values, friendships, cooperation, decision-making, and social skills.
strings.t: Devlopman konpetans lavi ki adrese valè, zanmitay, koperasyon, pran desizyon, ak konpetans sosyal.
Counseling: Too Good For Drugs

strings.text: A curriculum addressing decision-making and communication skills.
strings.t: Yon kourikoulòm ki adrese konpetans pou pran desizyon ak kominikasyon.
Alfabetizasyon Enfòmasyon
Konpetans rechèch nan bibliyotèk ak sitwayènte dijital.
Advisory

strings.text: Each student is assigned a faculty advisor providing academic and personal guidance and serving as a school-family communication link.
strings.t: Yo asiyen chak elèv yon konseye pwofesè ki bay gid akademik ak pèsonèl epi ki sèvi kòm yon lyen kominikasyon lekòl-fanmi.

strings.text: 119 catalogued course lines across 9 departments — 23 AP courses AND 18 IB courses plus the full IB Diploma core.
strings.t: 119 liy kou nan katalòg atravè 9 depatman — 23 kou AP AK 18 kou IB plis nwayo Diplòm IB konplè a.
English 9: Foundations in English

strings.text: First of a two-year foundations sequence, introducing advanced literary study through argument-building and examination of poetry, short stories, and longer texts.
strings.t: Premye nan yon sekans fondasyon de ane, ki entwodui etid literè avanse atravè konstriksyon agiman ak egzamen pwezi, istwa kout, ak tèks pi long.

strings.text: English 10: Foundations in English II: The Individual in Society
strings.t: English 10: Foundations in English II: The Individual in Society

strings.text: Studies classic and modern texts through how literature reflects the desire to understand oneself in relation to the world.
strings.t: Etidye tèks klasik ak modèn atravè kijan literati reflete dezi pou konprann tèt ou parapò ak mond lan.
English 11: American Literature

strings.text: A selected survey covering the Enlightenment, Romanticism, and Modernism, culminating in an autobiographical portfolio.
strings.t: Yon survey chwazi ki kouvri Syèk Limyè a, Womantis, ak Modènis, ki fini nan yon pòtfèy otobyografik.
AP English 11: Language & Composition

strings.text: College-level study of rhetoric and composition, with students expected to sit the AP exam.
strings.t: Etid retorik ak konpozisyon nan nivo inivèsite, ak atant ke elèv yo pase egzamen AP la.
AP English 12: Literature & Composition

strings.text: College-level literary analysis across genres and periods, with students expected to sit the AP exam.
strings.t: Analiz literè nan nivo inivèsite atravè jan ak peryòd, ak atant ke elèv yo pase egzamen AP la.
IB English 11 (HL)
IB HL

strings.text: Required first year for IB juniors, expanding experience with a broad range of genres, periods, and styles.
strings.t: Premye ane obligatwa pou elèv twazyèm ane IB, ki elaji eksperyans ak yon gran varyete jan, peryòd, ak style.
IB English 12 (HL)

strings.text: Second year of the two-year IB Language & Literature commitment.
strings.t: Dezyèm ane angajman IB Language & Literature de ane a.

strings.text: Senior English for students continuing from English 11 outside the AP and IB tracks.
strings.t: Angle dènye ane pou elèv k ap kontinye apati English 11 deyò pis AP ak IB yo.

strings.text: A semester elective in original composition.
strings.t: Yon elektif semès nan konpozisyon orijinal.
Intermediate & Advanced ESL

strings.text: English-language-support courses, alongside ESL American History and ESL World History, which may substitute for English or History credit.
strings.t: Kou sipò lang angle, ansanm ak ESL American History ak ESL World History, ki ka ranplase kredi Angle oswa Istwa.
