strings.t: Algebra II akselere; li egzije 90 nan Geometry oswa 83 nan Honors Geometry.
Honors Algebra II/Precalculus
Gr 10 sèlman

strings.text: A compressed two-subject course open only to sophomores who completed Honors Geometry in ninth grade.
strings.t: Yon kou de matyè konprese ki louvri sèlman pou elèv dezyèm ane ki fini Honors Geometry nan nevyèm ane.
Algebra III/Trigonometry

strings.text: A bridge course extending algebra into trigonometry.
strings.t: Yon kou pon ki pwolonje aljèb nan trigonometri.
Dynamic Math
Yon wout matematik altènatif.
Pre-calculus
Pre-kalkil estanda.
Honors Pre-calculus

strings.text: Accelerated precalculus; requires 90 in Algebra II or 83 in Honors Algebra II.
strings.t: Pre-kalkil akselere; li egzije 90 nan Algebra II oswa 83 nan Honors Algebra II.
Introduction to Calculus & Statistics

strings.text: A survey of both calculus and statistics concepts.
strings.t: Yon survey sou konsèp kalkil ak estatistik tou de.

strings.text: College-level statistics; qualifying students should choose either AP Calculus AB or AP Statistics, not both.
strings.t: Estatistik nan nivo inivèsite; elèv ki kalifye ta dwe chwazi swa AP Calculus AB oswa AP Statistics, se pa tou de.

strings.text: Advanced AP Statistics with R and R Studio
strings.t: Advanced AP Statistics with R and R Studio

strings.text: Post-BC-Calculus statistics using the R language; requires 83 in BC Calculus or concurrent enrollment.
strings.t: Estatistik apre BC Calculus ak lang R la; li egzije 83 nan BC Calculus oswa enskripsyon an menm tan.
Kalkil inivèsitè premye semès.

strings.text: The full-year college calculus sequence; requires 87 in Honors Precalculus or Honors Algebra II/Precalculus.
strings.t: Sekans kalkil inivèsitè pou tout ane a; li egzije 87 nan Honors Precalculus oswa Honors Algebra II/Precalculus.
IB Applications SL
IB SL

strings.text: IB Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation at standard level.
strings.t: IB Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation nan nivo estanda.
IB Analysis SL

strings.text: IB Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches at standard level; requires 83 in Honors Precalculus.
strings.t: IB Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches nan nivo estanda; li egzije 83 nan Honors Precalculus.
Calculus III/IB Analysis HL

strings.text: Multivariable calculus doubling as IB Analysis Higher Level; requires 83 in BC Calculus.
strings.t: Kalkil miltivaryab ki sèvi kòm IB Analysis Higher Level tou; li egzije 83 nan BC Calculus.
Syans

strings.text: Inquiries in Biological and Physical Science
strings.t: Inquiries in Biological and Physical Science
Yon kou syans entegre entwodiksyon.

strings.text: Required of all students in ninth or tenth grade; the core high-school biology requirement.
strings.t: Obligatwa pou tout elèv nan nevyèm oswa dizyèm ane; kondisyon byoloji debaz lekòl segondè a.

strings.text: College-level biology; prerequisites Biology I and Chemistry I.
strings.t: Byoloji nan nivo inivèsite; kondisyon anvan Biology I ak Chemistry I.
IB Biology SL
Byoloji IB nan nivo estanda.
IB Biology HL
Byoloji IB nan nivo siperyè.

strings.text: College-level environmental science covering eutrophication, acid rain, ozone depletion, and climate change, with mandatory field trips.
strings.t: Syans anviwònmantal nan nivo inivèsite ki kouvri etwofizasyon, lapli asid, rediksyon ozòn, ak chanjman klimatik, ak vwayaj teren obligatwa.
Environmental Issues

strings.text: A survey of contemporary environmental issues drawing on the humanities, social sciences, and natural sciences, culminating in team debates.
strings.t: Yon survey sou pwoblèm anviwònmantal kontanporen ki baze sou syans imèn, syans sosyal, ak syans natirèl, ki fini nan deba an ekip.
Marine Biology

strings.text: Marine biology concepts including trophic dynamics and marine ecosystems, with an expected overnight Charleston data-collection trip.
strings.t: Konsèp byoloji maren ki enkli dinamik twofik ak ekosistèm maren, ak yon vwayaj koleksyon done Charleston ak yon nwit ki prevwa.
Human Anatomy: External Structural Systems

strings.text: The body’s major organ systems with in-depth study of the skeletal and muscular systems; dissection is mandatory.
strings.t: Gwo sistèm ògàn kò a ak etid apwofondi sou sistèm eskeletik ak miskilè; disèksyon obligatwa.
Human Anatomy: Internal Structural Systems

strings.text: Deeper study of the nervous, blood, cardiovascular, respiratory, and digestive systems; dissection is mandatory.
strings.t: Etid pi pwofon sou sistèm nève, san, kadyovaskilè, respiratwa, ak dijestif; disèksyon obligatwa.

strings.text: Develops conceptual understanding of chemistry; requires Biology I and concurrent Algebra II or higher.
strings.t: Devlope konpreyansyon konseptyèl chimi; li egzije Biology I ak Algebra II an menm tan oswa pi wo.
Honors Chemistry I

strings.text: Accelerated chemistry; requires 87 in Biology and 87 in a math course.
strings.t: Chimi akselere; li egzije 87 nan Biology ak 87 nan yon kou matematik.

strings.text: College-level chemistry; requires previous or concurrent Precalculus.
strings.t: Chimi nan nivo inivèsite; li egzije Precalculus anvan oswa an menm tan.
IB Chemistry SL
Chimi IB nan nivo estanda.
IB Chemistry HL
Chimi IB nan nivo siperyè.
Fizik entwodiksyon.
Honors Physics I

strings.text: Accelerated physics; requires previous or concurrent Precalculus.
strings.t: Fizik akselere; li egzije Precalculus anvan oswa an menm tan.
AP Physics C: Mechanics, E&M

strings.text: Calculus-based college physics in mechanics and electricity and magnetism; requires previous or concurrent AP or IB Calculus.
strings.t: Fizik inivèsitè ki baze sou kalkil nan mekanik ak elektrisite ak mayetis; li egzije AP oswa IB Calculus anvan oswa an menm tan.
Astronomy: Solar Systems

strings.text: Constellations, celestial navigation, telescope design, electromagnetic radiation, and solar-system bodies, assessed by a major project.
strings.t: Konstelasyon, navigasyon selès, konsepsyon teleskòp, radyasyon elektwomayetik, ak kò sistèm solè a, evalye pa yon gwo pwojè.
Forensic Science: Biochemical Applications

strings.text: Biological and biochemical methods of criminal investigation including forensic pathology, entomology, anthropology, and DNA profiling.
strings.t: Metòd byolojik ak byochimik nan envestigasyon kriminèl ki enkli patoloji legal, antomoloji, antwopoloji, ak pwofil ADN.
Forensic Science: Physical Applications

strings.text: Physical-science forensics including glass and matter analysis, toxicology, bloodstain pattern analysis, fire investigation, and firearms identification.
strings.t: Syans legal fizik ki enkli analiz vè ak matyè, toksikoloji, analiz modèl tach san, envestigasyon dife, ak idantifikasyon zam.
Organic Chemistry

strings.text: Replicates a semester of undergraduate organic chemistry with a full synthetic lab component; requires AP or IB Chemistry.
strings.t: Repwodui yon semès chimi òganik nan nivo lisans ak yon konpozan laboratwa sentetik konplè; li egzije AP oswa IB Chemistry.
Honors Principles of Engineering

strings.text: Structural mechanics, material science, and digital electronics through projects from digital keyboards to a wirelessly controlled robotic hand.
strings.t: Mekanik estriktirèl, syans materyèl, ak elektwonik dijital atravè pwojè soti nan klavye dijital rive nan yon men robotik ki kontwole san fil.
Physical Computational Biochemistry
Rechèch

strings.text: Primary research on protein folding and 3D-printed dynamic models, working with professors nationally with potential to publish.
strings.t: Rechèch prensipal sou pliyaj pwoteyin ak modèl dinamik enprime an 3D, k ap travay ak pwofesè nan tout peyi a ak posiblite pou pibliye.
Istwa ak Syans Sosyal
9th Grade History

strings.text: Introduces basic historical thinking through in-depth study of several crucial themes.
strings.t: Entwodui panse istorik debaz atravè etid apwofondi sou plizyè tèm esansyèl.
Modern World History

strings.text: The second required history course, typically taken in tenth grade.
strings.t: Dezyèm kou istwa obligatwa a, ke yo pran nòmalman nan dizyèm ane.
Honors Modern World History

strings.text: Accelerated Modern World History; requires 87 in 9th Grade History.
strings.t: Modern World History akselere; li egzije 87 nan 9th Grade History.
IB World History SL
Istwa IB nan nivo estanda.

strings.text: Required of all graduates, usually completed junior year.
strings.t: Obligatwa pou tout gradye, abityèlman konplete nan twazyèm ane.

strings.text: College-level US History satisfying the graduation requirement; requires 87 in Modern World History.
strings.t: Istwa Etazini nan nivo inivèsite ki satisfè kondisyon gradyasyon an; li egzije 87 nan Modern World History.

strings.text: IB History of the Americas HL
strings.t: IB History of the Americas HL

strings.text: IB higher-level history through which IB students typically fulfill the US History requirement senior year.
strings.t: Istwa IB nivo siperyè kote elèv IB yo nòmalman satisfè kondisyon US History la nan dènye ane.

strings.text: College-level psychology, with preference given to seniors.
strings.t: Sikoloji nan nivo inivèsite, ak preferans pou elèv dènye ane.
IB Psychology SL
Sikoloji IB nan nivo estanda.
Jeyografi imèn nan nivo inivèsite.

strings.text: College-level European history, with preference given to seniors.
strings.t: Istwa Ewopeyen nan nivo inivèsite, ak preferans pou elèv dènye ane.
AP US Government and Politics

strings.text: College-level American government and politics, with preference given to seniors.
strings.t: Gouvènman ak politik ameriken nan nivo inivèsite, ak preferans pou elèv dènye ane.
Ancient Empires

strings.text: The origins, evolution, and varieties of ancient civilizations from c. 3000 BCE to c. 1000 CE using primary sources and archaeological findings.
strings.t: Orijin, evolisyon, ak varyete sivilizasyon ansyen soti anviwon 3000 AEK rive anviwon 1000 EK ak sous prensipal ak dekouvèt akeyolojik.
Adolescent Psychology and Behavior

strings.text: Adolescent psychosocial development and the mental-health challenges adolescents face, including protective factors and intervention strategies.
strings.t: Devlopman sikososyal adolesan ak defi sante mantal adolesan yo konfwonte, ki enkli faktè pwoteksyon ak estrateji entèvansyon.

strings.text: African American History: From Slavery to Civil Rights
strings.t: African American History: From Slavery to Civil Rights

strings.text: Major themes from slavery in Africa and the Americas through abolition, the Harlem Renaissance, and the Civil Rights Movement.
strings.t: Gwo tèm soti nan esklavaj ann Afrik ak nan Amerik yo rive nan abolisyon, Renesans Harlem lan, ak Mouvman Dwa Sivil la.
Education for Social Justice

strings.text: Critical analysis of several forms of social oppression and alternative ways of understanding social relations.
strings.t: Analiz kritik plizyè fòm opresyon sosyal ak fason altènatif pou konprann relasyon sosyal.
IB Digital Society
IB

strings.text: Open to IB and non-IB students; requires previous or concurrent Precalculus.
strings.t: Louvri pou elèv IB ak ki pa IB; li egzije Precalculus anvan oswa an menm tan.
Honors Chinese I–V

strings.text: A five-level Honors-only Mandarin sequence; entry requires 87 in a current French, Spanish, or Latin class.
strings.t: Yon sekans Mandaren senk nivo ki Honors sèlman; antre a egzije 87 nan yon klas Franse, Panyòl, oswa Laten aktyèl.
Chinese II
Mandaren dezyèm nivo ki pa honors.
IB Chinese
Kou Mandaren IB la.

strings.text: A five-level French sequence building proficiency across all four skills.
strings.t: Yon sekans Franse senk nivo ki bati metriz atravè tout kat konpetans yo.
Honors French II, III, IV

strings.text: Accelerated French; requires 93 in the current language class or 85 in current Honors.
strings.t: Franse akselere; li egzije 93 nan klas lang aktyèl la oswa 85 nan Honors aktyèl la.
AP French Language & Culture

strings.text: College-level French language and culture; requires 87 in Level 4 Honors.
strings.t: Lang ak kilti franse nan nivo inivèsite; li egzije 87 nan Nivo 4 Honors.
IB French HL
Franse IB nan nivo siperyè.
Spanish I–V
Yon sekans Panyòl senk nivo.
Honors Spanish II, III, IV
Panyòl akselere.
AP Spanish Language & Culture
IB Spanish HL
Panyòl IB nan nivo siperyè.
Honors Latin II, III, IV
Laten akselere.
IB Latin
Kou Laten IB la.
Yon ansanm koral san odisyon.
Koral konsè nan nivo honors.
Honors Chamber Choir

strings.text: A select choral ensemble admitted by audition, open to Grades 10–12.
strings.t: Yon ansanm koral selèk yo admèt pa odisyon, louvri pou Grad 10–12.
Symphonic Band
Fanfa van konsè a.
Honors Symphonic Band

strings.text: Honors wind band admitted by audition.
strings.t: Fanfa van honors yo admèt pa odisyon.

strings.text: The string and full orchestra ensemble.
strings.t: Ansanm kòd ak òkès konplè a.
Òkès honors yo admèt pa odisyon.
Introduction to Piano
Enstriksyon klavye pou debitan.
Supersonic: Percussion Ensemble
Yon ansanm pèfòmans pèkisyon.

strings.text: Develops the ability to recognize and describe melody, harmony, texture, rhythm, form, history, and style; requires an entrance proficiency exam.
strings.t: Devlope kapasite pou rekonèt epi dekri melodi, amoni, teksti, rit, fòm, istwa, ak style; li egzije yon egzamen metriz pou antre.
Acting/Directing I

strings.text: Introduces the tools of acting through disciplined work on voice, speech, movement, and the actor’s use of self.
strings.t: Entwodui zouti aktyaj yo atravè travay disipline sou vwa, pale, mouvman, ak fason aktè a sèvi ak tèt li.
Acting/Directing II

strings.text: Advanced acting and directing across Stanislavsky, Strasberg, Adler, and Meisner approaches in workshop format.
strings.t: Aktyaj ak direksyon avanse atravè apwòch Stanislavsky, Strasberg, Adler, ak Meisner nan fòma atelye.
Theater Workshop

strings.text: A capstone project course for advanced students in acting, directing, or improv.
strings.t: Yon kou pwojè kapston pou elèv avanse nan aktyaj, direksyon, oswa improv.
Improvisation I

strings.text: In-depth study of short- and long-form improvisation plus sketch writing.
strings.t: Etid apwofondi sou enpwovizasyon fòm kout ak long plis ekri eskèch.
Improvisation II

strings.text: Advanced improvisation building on Improvisation I.
strings.t: Enpwovizasyon avanse ki bati sou Improvisation I.
IB Theatre Arts (SL, HL)

strings.text: IB theatre at standard or higher level.
strings.t: Teyat IB nan nivo estanda oswa siperyè.
2-D Art I–IV

strings.text: A four-level sequence in two-dimensional art and drawing.
strings.t: Yon sekans kat nivo nan atizay an de dimansyon ak desen.
Design/Photography I–IV

strings.text: A four-level sequence in digital design and photography.
strings.t: Yon sekans kat nivo nan konsepsyon dijital ak fotografi.
Sculpture I–IV

strings.text: A four-level sequence in three-dimensional and sculptural work.
strings.t: Yon sekans kat nivo nan travay an twa dimansyon ak eskilti.
Architectural Design Studio

strings.text: A studio course in architectural design.
strings.t: Yon kou estidyo nan konsepsyon achitektiral.
Special Projects in Visual Arts

strings.text: Portfolio-based independent studio work following Level IV; requires portfolio evaluation.
strings.t: Travay estidyo endepandan ki baze sou pòtfèy apre Nivo IV; li egzije yon evalyasyon pòtfèy.
AP Studio: 2D Art

strings.text: A portfolio course emphasizing art-making as informed and critical decision-making.
strings.t: Yon kou pòtfèy ki mete aksan sou kreyasyon atistik kòm yon pran desizyon enfòme ak kritik.
AP Studio: Design/Photography

strings.text: An AP portfolio course in digital and photographic arts.
strings.t: Yon kou pòtfèy AP nan atizay dijital ak fotografik.
AP Studio: Sculpture

strings.text: An AP portfolio course addressing sculptural issues and purposeful decision-making.
strings.t: Yon kou pòtfèy AP ki adrese pwoblèm eskilti ak pran desizyon ak entansyon.

strings.text: Significant works of art and architecture in European and non-European traditions from cave paintings to the twenty-first century.
strings.t: Zèv atistik ak achitekti enpòtan nan tradisyon Ewopeyen ak ki pa Ewopeyen soti nan penti gwòt rive nan venteyinyèm syèk la.
IB Art I & II (SL, HL)

strings.text: A two-year IB visual arts course; portfolios due February of sophomore year for admittance.
strings.t: Yon kou atizay vizyèl IB de ane; pòtfèy yo dwe rive nan fevriye dezyèm ane pou admisyon.

strings.text: Students produce The Postscript, learning page layout, photo and copy editing, and writing.
strings.t: Elèv yo pwodui The Postscript, epi yo aprann mizanpaj, editaj foto ak tèks, ak ekri.
Yearbook Editor, Honors

strings.text: A leadership option for returning yearbook staff serving as team leaders and editors.
strings.t: Yon opsyon lidèchip pou estaf ane-liv ki retounen k ap sèvi kòm chèf ekip ak editè.
Teknoloji ak Syans Enfòmatik
Exploring Computer Science

strings.text: The breadth of computer science including Python programming, web page design, data analysis, phone apps, and ethical issues in computing.
strings.t: Etandi syans enfòmatik ki enkli pwogramasyon Python, konsepsyon paj entènèt, analiz done, app telefòn, ak pwoblèm etik nan enfòmatik.

strings.text: Follows the College Board syllabus in Java, emphasizing problem-solving, object-oriented methodologies, algorithms, and container classes.
strings.t: Swiv silabis College Board la nan Java, ak aksan sou rezolisyon pwoblèm, metodoloji oryante objè, algoritm, ak klas konteni.
Advanced Topics in Computer Science

strings.text: Data structures in Java, then student-designed projects presented before the academic council; requires AP Computer Science.
strings.t: Estrikti done nan Java, apre sa pwojè elèv yo konsevwa yo prezante devan konsèy akademik la; li egzije AP Computer Science.
San Depatman
9th Grade Seminar

strings.text: A required transition course covering goal setting, time management, decision-making, media literacy, leadership, wellness, and identity development.
strings.t: Yon kou tranzisyon obligatwa ki kouvri fikse objektif, jesyon tan, pran desizyon, alfabetizasyon medya, lidèchip, byennèt, ak devlopman idantite.
IB Theory of Knowledge
Nwayo IB

strings.text: A junior-year IB core course analyzing personal and shared knowledge using the knowledge framework.
strings.t: Yon kou nwayo IB nan twazyèm ane k ap analize konesans pèsonèl ak pataje ak kad konesans lan.
Public Speaking and Professional Communication

strings.text: Builds confidence before an audience and proficiency organizing content for varied speech categories, interviews, and active listening.
strings.t: Bati konfyans devan yon odyans ak metriz nan òganize kontni pou divès kategori diskou, entèvyou, ak koute aktif.
IB Extended Essay & CAS

strings.text: The IB core also requires the Extended Essay, a major research paper completed junior year, and Creativity, Activity & Service.
strings.t: Nwayo IB la egzije tou Extended Essay la, yon gwo papye rechèch ki fèt nan twazyèm ane, ak Creativity, Activity & Service.
Antrenman fòs

strings.text: Weightlifting technique, functional movement, nutrition, injury prevention, and goal setting; satisfies one of two annual co-curricular credits.
strings.t: Teknik leve pwa, mouvman fonksyonèl, nitrisyon, prevansyon blesi, ak fikse objektif; li satisfè youn nan de kredi ko-kourikoulè anyèl yo.
Ultimate Frisbee
Aprè-lekòl

strings.text: Practices three days a week with winter-term scrimmages; credit based on attendance.
strings.t: Pratik twa jou pa semèn ak match antrènman nan trimès ivè a; kredi baze sou prezans.
JrK – Grad 4

strings.text: 13 named curriculum areas — Reveal Math, TAB art, the Orff Approach, Scratch 3.0 coding, and the CHAMP fitness test.
strings.t: 13 domèn kourikoulòm ki gen non — Reveal Math, atizay TAB, Apwòch Orff la, kodaj Scratch 3.0, ak tès fòm fizik CHAMP la.

strings.text: Cannon publishes 12 named curriculum areas per grade for JrK–4 rather than a course catalog. The /academics/lower-school/curriculum path returns a 404.
strings.t: Cannon pibliye 12 domèn kourikoulòm ki gen non pa nivo pou JrK–4 olye ke yon katalòg kou. Chemen /academics/lower-school/curriculum la bay yon 404.
Gr 1–4

strings.text: A literacy block integrating whole-class and small-group differentiated instruction across phonics, fluency, vocabulary, and comprehension.
strings.t: Yon blòk alfabetizasyon ki entegre enstriksyon tout klas ak ti gwoup diferansye atravè fonik, fasilite, vokabilè, ak konpreyansyon.

strings.text: Uses Reveal Math to develop number sense and problem solving; Grade 4 works with multi-digit numbers, fractions, and decimals.
strings.t: Sèvi ak Reveal Math pou devlope sans nonb ak rezolisyon pwoblèm; Grad 4 travay ak nonb ki gen plizyè chif, fraksyon, ak desimal.

strings.text: Inquiry-driven; by Grade 3 students generate their own scientific questions to test through experimentation.
strings.t: Mennen pa envestigasyon; anvan Grad 3 elèv yo jenere pwòp kesyon syantifik yo pou teste atravè eksperyans.

strings.text: Uses the Social Studies Alive! curriculum — Regions of Our Country in Grade 3, America’s Past in Grade 4.
strings.t: Sèvi ak kourikoulòm Social Studies Alive! la — Regions of Our Country nan Grad 3, America’s Past nan Grad 4.
Pwogram timoun piti
JrK–K

strings.text: Curriculum builds a strong academic foundation in reading, writing, and math through hands-on, collaborative, experiential, and multi-sensory learning.
strings.t: Kourikoulòm nan bati yon fondasyon akademik solid nan lekti, ekri, ak matematik atravè aprantisaj pratik, kolaboratif, eksperyansyèl, ak milti-sansoryèl.

strings.text: Combines the Communicative Language Approach with the Foreign Language in the Elementary School (FLES) approach.
strings.t: Konbine Apwòch Lang Kominikatif la ak apwòch Foreign Language in the Elementary School (FLES) la.
Atizay ak PE

strings.text: Grade 3 onward uses the TAB (Teaching for Artistic Behavior) model so students work and think as artists.
strings.t: Apati Grad 3 li sèvi ak modèl TAB (Teaching for Artistic Behavior) la pou elèv yo travay epi panse tankou atis.

strings.text: Uses the Orff Approach; Grade 3 introduces the recorder including Recorder Karate.
strings.t: Sèvi ak Apwòch Orff la; Grad 3 entwodui flit dous la ki enkli Recorder Karate.

strings.text: Motor-skill development including the Cannon Health and Performance (CHAMP) Test.
strings.t: Devlopman konpetans motè ki enkli Tès Cannon Health and Performance (CHAMP) la.
Teknoloji ak Kreyatè

strings.text: Robotics and coding with Scratch 3.0 and block-based scripting, using Root Robotics and Edison robots.
strings.t: Robotik ak kodaj ak Scratch 3.0 ak eskript ak blòk, ak robo Root Robotics ak Edison.
Makers

strings.text: Problem solving through an engineering design thinking approach.
strings.t: Rezolisyon pwoblèm atravè yon apwòch panse konsepsyon enjenyri.

strings.text: Research skills including use of the digital library catalog to locate materials.
strings.t: Konpetans rechèch ki enkli itilizasyon katalòg bibliyotèk dijital la pou jwenn materyèl.
Konsèy Lekòl

strings.text: Addresses typical challenges and characteristics of children by age and developmental stage.
strings.t: Adrese defi ak karakteristik tipik timoun pa laj ak etap devlopman.

strings.text: Six core subjects plus four math tracks — a Grade 5 rotation through all three world languages, and the ThinkTank makerspace.
strings.t: Sis matyè debaz plis kat pis matematik — yon wotasyon Grad 5 atravè tout twa lang etranje yo, ak makerspace ThinkTank la.

strings.text: Cannon publishes Middle School curriculum as per-grade subject descriptions, not a named-course catalog. There is no Middle School equivalent of the 44-page Upper School catalog.
strings.t: Cannon pibliye kourikoulòm Middle School kòm deskripsyon matyè pa nivo, se pa yon katalòg kou ki gen non. Pa gen okenn ekivalan Middle School pou katalòg Upper School 44 paj la.

strings.text: Grade 5 explores genres and writing critically; Grade 6 reinforces grammar with narrative writing; Grade 7 integrates literature, writing, and grammar; Grade 8 builds all four skills.
strings.t: Grad 5 eksplore jan ak ekri yon fason kritik; Grad 6 ranfòse gramè ak ekri naratif; Grad 7 entegre literati, ekri, ak gramè; Grad 8 bati tout kat konpetans yo.

strings.text: Grade 5 studies ecology; Grade 6 classification, cells, rocks, plate tectonics, and motion; Grade 7 chemistry, the electromagnetic spectrum, astronomy, and anatomy; Grade 8 the Sun’s impact on Earth.
strings.t: Grad 5 etidye ekoloji; Grad 6 klasifikasyon, selil, wòch, plak tektonik, ak mouvman; Grad 7 chimi, spèk elektwomayetik la, astwonomi, ak anatomi; Grad 8 enpak Solèy la sou Latè.

strings.text: Grades 5–6 study ancient and Medieval civilizations thematically; Grade 7 covers the origins of the United States; Grade 8 emphasizes modern U.S. history as it becomes a world power.
strings.t: Grad 5–6 etidye sivilizasyon ansyen ak Medyeval yon fason tematik; Grad 7 kouvri orijin Etazini; Grad 8 mete aksan sou istwa modèn Etazini pandan l ap vin yon pisans mondyal.

strings.text: Soccer, flag football, volleyball, tennis, aerobics, cardiovascular fitness and conditioning, basketball, softball, baseball, and lacrosse.
strings.t: Foutbòl, flag football, volebòl, tenis, ayerobik, fòm ak kondisyònman kadyovaskilè, baskètbòl, softball, bezbòl, ak kwòs.
Edikasyon sante

strings.text: Human growth and development, evaluating health information, decision-making, family living, nutrition, safety and first aid, and environmental health.
strings.t: Kwasans ak devlopman moun, evalye enfòmasyon sante, pran desizyon, lavi fanmi, nitrisyon, sekirite ak premye swen, ak sante anviwònmantal.
Gr 5–6

strings.text: Covers operations, equations and inequalities, ratio, proportion and percent, area and volume, statistics, and graphing linear equations.
strings.t: Kouvri operasyon, ekwasyon ak inegalite, rapò, pwopòsyon ak pousantaj, sifas ak volim, estatistik, ak grafike ekwasyon lineyè.

strings.text: Builds on prior knowledge to dive deeper into expressions, equations, inequalities, integers, linear functions, geometry, probability, and statistics.
strings.t: Bati sou konesans anvan pou plonje pi pwofon nan ekspresyon, ekwasyon, inegalite, antye relatif, fonksyon lineyè, jeyometri, pwobabilite, ak estatistik.
Seventh-Grade Algebra I

strings.text: An accelerated option allowing seventh graders to take Algebra I.
strings.t: Yon opsyon akselere ki pèmèt elèv setyèm ane pran Algebra I.

strings.text: Linear equations, inequalities, polynomials, factoring, graphing, radicals, quadratics, and an introduction to trigonometry.
strings.t: Ekwasyon lineyè, inegalite, polinòm, faktorizasyon, grafik, radikal, kadratik, ak yon entwodiksyon nan trigonometri.
Accelerated Geometry

strings.text: Parallel and perpendicular lines, congruent triangles, similar polygons, trigonometry, quadrilaterals and circles, area and volume.
strings.t: Liy paralèl ak pèpandikilè, triyang kongriyan, poligòn sanble, trigonometri, kwadrilatè ak sèk, sifas ak volim.
Wotasyon lang etranje

strings.text: Students rotate through all three world languages offered at Cannon — Spanish, French, and Mandarin — before choosing one to pursue.
strings.t: Elèv yo fè wotasyon atravè tout twa lang etranje Cannon ofri yo — Panyòl, Franse, ak Mandaren — anvan yo chwazi youn pou pouswiv.
Lang Etranje (chak jou)

strings.text: Daily classes learning basic grammar and vocabulary to describe themselves and the world in the target language.
strings.t: Klas chak jou k ap aprann gramè ak vokabilè debaz pou dekri tèt yo ak mond lan nan lang sib la.

strings.text: Spanish I / French I / Mandarin I
strings.t: Spanish I / French I / Mandarin I

strings.text: Students complete one of Spanish I, French I, or Mandarin I, conducted primarily in the target language.
strings.t: Elèv yo konplete youn nan Spanish I, French I, oswa Mandarin I, ki fèt sitou nan lang sib la.
Atizay ak Teknoloji

strings.text: Major Art: Strings, Band, or Chorus
strings.t: Atizay Prensipal: Strings, Band, oswa Chorus

strings.text: Students select one major performing art class.
strings.t: Elèv yo chwazi yon sèl klas atizay pèfòmans prensipal.
Wotasyon Atizay

strings.text: A rotation through Visual Art, Theater, General Music, and Small Group Lessons in the major art.
strings.t: Yon wotasyon atravè Visual Art, Theater, General Music, ak Leson an Ti Gwoup nan atizay prensipal la.
Elektif Atizay (chwazi de)

strings.text: Band, Chorus, Strings, Visual Art, Theater, Photography/Tech Art Fusion, Creative Explorations, and Art Magazine.
strings.t: Band, Chorus, Strings, Visual Art, Theater, Photography/Tech Art Fusion, Creative Explorations, ak Art Magazine.
Teknoloji akademik

strings.text: Blends 3D printing, virtual reality, drones, robotics, CAD design, and computer programming in the ThinkTank makerspace.
strings.t: Melanje enprime 3D, reyalite vityèl, dwòn, robotik, konsepsyon CAD, ak pwogramasyon enfòmatik nan makerspace ThinkTank la.

strings.text: 104 courses across 8 departments — 14 AP plus 13 faculty-designed Advanced Topics courses, each capped by a Signature Learning Experience.
strings.t: 104 kou atravè 8 depatman — 14 AP plis 13 kou Advanced Topics pwofesè yo konsevwa, chak kouwone pa yon Signature Learning Experience.
Honors English I

strings.text: A foundational course cultivating critical thinking, analytical skills, and creative expression across memoirs, plays, novels, poetry, and short stories.
strings.t: Yon kou fondasyonèl ki kiltive panse kritik, konpetans analitik, ak ekspresyon kreyatif atravè memwa, pyès teyat, woman, pwezi, ak istwa kout.

strings.text: Honors English II: Reading and Discourse
strings.t: Honors English II: Reading and Discourse

strings.text: A sophomore seminar-style class reading and discussing influential literary and philosophical works from a variety of historical periods and cultures.
strings.t: Yon klas dezyèm ane nan style seminè k ap li epi diskite zèv literè ak filozofik enfliyan ki soti nan divès peryòd istorik ak kilti.

strings.text: Honors English II: Reading and Composition
strings.t: Honors English II: Reading and Composition

strings.text: A process-driven sophomore course in which students read, write, and think in service of developing writing and analytical skills.
strings.t: Yon kou dezyèm ane ki mennen pa pwosesis kote elèv yo li, ekri, epi panse pou devlope konpetans ekri ak analitik.
Honors English III

strings.text: The study of rhetoric guided by Aristotle’s appeals of ethos, pathos, and logos, culminating in a writing-portfolio presentation.
strings.t: Etid retorik gide pa apèl ethos, pathos, ak logos Aristòt yo, ki fini nan yon prezantasyon pòtfèy ekri.

strings.text: Advanced Topics: English Language and Composition
strings.t: Advanced Topics: English Language and Composition
AT

strings.text: College-level nonfiction writing with major emphasis on revision, culminating in the Portfolio Defense signature learning experience.
strings.t: Ekri ki pa fiksyon nan nivo inivèsite ak gwo aksan sou revizyon, ki fini nan eksperyans aprantisaj siyatè Portfolio Defense la.

strings.text: Advanced Topics: English Seminar and Inquiry
strings.t: Advanced Topics: English Seminar and Inquiry

strings.text: College-level reading and writing emphasizing inquiry, independent research, and multi-disciplinary analysis; optional AP Seminar exam.
strings.t: Lekti ak ekri nan nivo inivèsite ak aksan sou envestigasyon, rechèch endepandan, ak analiz ant disiplin; egzamen AP Seminar opsyonèl.
Honors English IV

strings.text: A senior course preparing college-bound students through diverse contemporary and canonical texts plus an Independent Reading program.
strings.t: Yon kou dènye ane ki prepare elèv k ap prepare pou inivèsite atravè tèks kontanporen ak kanonik divès plis yon pwogram Lekti Endepandan.

strings.text: Advanced Topics: English Literature and Composition
strings.t: Advanced Topics: English Literature and Composition

strings.text: College-level literary conversation about fiction and poetry, culminating in the Lit Defense signature learning experience.
strings.t: Konvèsasyon literè nan nivo inivèsite sou fiksyon ak pwezi, ki fini nan eksperyans aprantisaj siyatè Lit Defense la.

strings.text: Honors Creative Writing: Fiction, Poetry and Screenwriting
strings.t: Honors Creative Writing: Fiction, Poetry and Screenwriting

strings.text: Students develop individual literary voices through poetry, fiction, and screenwriting, completing a polished peer-critiqued screenplay.
strings.t: Elèv yo devlope vwa literè endividyèl atravè pwezi, fiksyon, ak ekri senaryo, epi yo konplete yon senaryo poli ke kanmarad yo kritike.
Honors History of Film

strings.text: A fast-paced survey tracing cinema from its 1895 origins through the digital revolution across genres and movements.
strings.t: Yon survey rapid ki swiv sinema soti nan orijin li an 1895 rive nan revolisyon dijital la atravè jan ak mouvman.
Honors Algebra I

strings.text: Introduces basic functions, their graphs, and the rules of solving equations.
strings.t: Entwodui fonksyon debaz, grafik yo, ak règ pou rezoud ekwasyon.

strings.text: Honors Principles of Geometry and Algebra
strings.t: Honors Principles of Geometry and Algebra

strings.text: Strengthens and applies arithmetic, algebra, and reasoning to measure the world through traditional geometry concepts.
strings.t: Ranfòse epi aplike aritmetik, aljèb, ak rezònman pou mezire mond lan atravè konsèp jeyometri tradisyonèl.
Honors Accelerated Geometry

strings.text: Euclidean geometry with heavy emphasis on notation, justification, and proof at greater rigor and depth than Honors Geometry.
strings.t: Jeyometri Euklidyen ak gwo aksan sou notasyon, jistifikasyon, ak prèv nan yon rigè ak pwofondè pi wo pase Honors Geometry.

strings.text: Uses functions to reinforce and extend Algebra I skills, focusing on elementary functions and their properties.
strings.t: Sèvi ak fonksyon pou ranfòse epi pwolonje konpetans Algebra I, ak konsantrasyon sou fonksyon elemantè ak pwopriyete yo.
Honors Accelerated Algebra II

strings.text: An in-depth exploration of algebraic concepts, preparing students for Accelerated Precalculus and subsequently AP Calculus and AP Statistics.
strings.t: Yon eksplorasyon apwofondi konsèp aljebrik, ki prepare elèv yo pou Accelerated Precalculus epi apre sa AP Calculus ak AP Statistics.
Honors Precalculus

strings.text: Further development of advanced algebraic concepts and trigonometry with heavy emphasis on functions and their properties.
strings.t: Devlopman pi lwen konsèp aljebrik avanse ak trigonometri ak gwo aksan sou fonksyon ak pwopriyete yo.
Honors Accelerated Precalculus

strings.text: Prepares students for college-level mathematics and serves as the prerequisite for AP Calculus.
strings.t: Prepare elèv yo pou matematik nan nivo inivèsite epi li sèvi kòm kondisyon anvan pou AP Calculus.
Advanced Placement Precalculus

strings.text: A research-based exploration of function types modeling real-world phenomena, best suited to students on track for AP Calculus BC.
strings.t: Yon eksplorasyon ki baze sou rechèch sou kalite fonksyon ki modle fenomèn nan mond reyèl la, ki pi bon pou elèv ki sou wout AP Calculus BC.

strings.text: Introduces the topics of a semester of college calculus at a less intense pace and depth than the AP courses.
strings.t: Entwodui sijè yon semès kalkil inivèsitè nan yon vitès ak pwofondè mwens entans pase kou AP yo.
Honors Statistics

strings.text: Exposes juniors and seniors to statistics through graphing data, normal probabilities, linear regression, and experimental design; no AP exam.
strings.t: Ekspoze elèv twazyèm ak dènye ane a estatistik atravè grafike done, pwobabilite nòmal, regresyon lineyè, ak konsepsyon eksperimantal; pa gen egzamen AP.

strings.text: Major concepts and tools for collecting, analyzing, and drawing conclusions from data, preparing students for the AP exam.
strings.t: Gwo konsèp ak zouti pou ranmase, analize, ak tire konklizyon nan done, ki prepare elèv yo pou egzamen AP la.

strings.text: Honors Discrete Mathematics and Personal Finance
strings.t: Honors Discrete Mathematics and Personal Finance

strings.text: Explores mathematics as it relates to the social sciences plus the mathematics behind money in everyday life.
strings.t: Eksplore matematik jan li gen rapò ak syans sosyal plis matematik ki dèyè lajan nan lavi chak jou.

strings.text: A rigorous course covering a semester of college calculus through limits, differential calculus, and integral calculus.
strings.t: Yon kou rijid ki kouvri yon semès kalkil inivèsitè atravè limit, kalkil diferansyèl, ak kalkil entegral.

strings.text: An intense course covering two semesters of first-year college calculus including parametric equations, infinite series, vectors, and polar functions.
strings.t: Yon kou entans ki kouvri de semès kalkil inivèsitè premye ane ki enkli ekwasyon paramtetrik, seri enfini, vektè, ak fonksyon polè.

strings.text: Advanced Topics in Mathematics and Calculus
strings.t: Advanced Topics in Mathematics and Calculus

strings.text: A student-centered seminar for students who have completed AP Calculus BC, using Phillips Exeter Academy’s Mathematics 4C and 5 curricula.
strings.t: Yon seminè ki santre sou elèv pou elèv ki fini AP Calculus BC, ki sèvi ak kourikoulòm Mathematics 4C ak 5 Phillips Exeter Academy a.

strings.text: Honors Principles of Chemistry and Physics
strings.t: Honors Principles of Chemistry and Physics

strings.text: A hands-on, inquiry-based introduction to physical science covering matter, energy transformations, motion, forces, and waves.
strings.t: Yon entwodiksyon pratik ki baze sou envestigasyon nan syans fizik ki kouvri matyè, transfòmasyon enèji, mouvman, fòs, ak vag.

strings.text: Honors Accelerated Principles of Chemistry and Physics
strings.t: Honors Accelerated Principles of Chemistry and Physics

strings.text: A challenging ninth-grade physical science course covering a broader range of chemistry and physics topics at an accelerated pace.
strings.t: Yon kou syans fizik nevyèm ane ki difisil ki kouvri yon pi laj varyete sijè chimi ak fizik nan yon vitès akselere.
Honors Principles of Life Science

strings.text: A comprehensive foundation in biological and environmental principles including cell biology, genetics, evolution, and ecology.
strings.t: Yon fondasyon konplè nan prensip byolojik ak anviwònmantal ki enkli byoloji selilè, jenetik, evolisyon, ak ekoloji.

strings.text: Honors Accelerated Principles of Life Science
strings.t: Honors Accelerated Principles of Life Science

strings.text: In-depth life science emphasizing application-based learning and analytical reasoning from molecules to ecosystems.
strings.t: Syans lavi apwofondi ak aksan sou aprantisaj ki baze sou aplikasyon ak rezònman analitik soti nan molekil rive nan ekosistèm.

strings.text: A guided-inquiry course developing the properties, composition, and structure of matter plus energy’s role in changing matter.
strings.t: Yon kou envestigasyon gide ki devlope pwopriyete, konpozisyon, ak estrikti matyè plis wòl enèji nan chanje matyè.
Honors Accelerated Chemistry

strings.text: Covers Honors Chemistry at a faster pace plus molecular geometry, periodicity, and acid-base chemistry.
strings.t: Kouvri Honors Chemistry nan yon vitès pi rapid plis jeyometri molekilè, peryodisite, ak chimi asid-baz.
Honors Chemistry and Physics II

strings.text: An experimentation-driven course covering chemistry and physics concepts not included in the Honors and Accelerated courses.
strings.t: Yon kou ki mennen pa eksperimantasyon ki kouvri konsèp chimi ak fizik ki pa enkli nan kou Honors ak Accelerated yo.
Honors Biology

strings.text: Introductory biology connecting key concepts through lab work and guided research, culminating in a third-trimester research project.
strings.t: Byoloji entwodiksyon ki konekte konsèp kle atravè travay laboratwa ak rechèch gide, ki fini nan yon pwojè rechèch nan twazyèm trimès la.
Honors Accelerated Biology

strings.text: Major principles of biology at deeper level and faster pace, with additional lab experiences and a third-trimester research project.
strings.t: Gwo prensip byoloji nan yon nivo pi pwofon ak yon vitès pi rapid, ak lòt eksperyans laboratwa ak yon pwojè rechèch nan twazyèm trimès la.
Advanced Topics: Environmental Science

strings.text: The scientific principles behind the interrelationships of the natural world, culminating in an independent research project.
strings.t: Prensip syantifik ki dèyè entèrelasyon mond natirèl la, ki fini nan yon pwojè rechèch endepandan.

strings.text: A year-long general chemistry equivalent covering nine major topics from atomic structure to thermodynamics.
strings.t: Yon ekivalan chimi jeneral pou tout ane a ki kouvri nèf gwo sijè soti nan estrikti atomik rive nan tèmodinamik.

strings.text: The equivalent of a college introductory course for biology majors, built around student-directed, inquiry-based labs.
strings.t: Ekivalan a yon kou entwodiksyon inivèsitè pou elèv ki gen espesyalite nan byoloji, bati otou laboratwa elèv yo dirije ki baze sou envestigasyon.
Advanced Placement Physics 1

strings.text: Algebra-based introductory college-level physics covering kinematics, dynamics, energy, momentum, torque, and rotational motion.
strings.t: Fizik nivo inivèsite entwodiksyon ki baze sou aljèb ki kouvri sinematik, dinamik, enèji, momantòm, kouraj, ak mouvman wotasyonèl.
Advanced Placement Physics C

strings.text: A calculus-based mechanics course equivalent to introductory college physics for engineering or physical science majors.
strings.t: Yon kou mekanik ki baze sou kalkil ekivalan a fizik inivèsitè entwodiksyon pou elèv ki gen espesyalite nan enjenyri oswa syans fizik.
Honors Marine Science

strings.text: Studies the animals inhabiting the world’s oceans, including setup and maintenance of saltwater aquariums.
strings.t: Etidye bèt k ap viv nan oseyan mond lan, ki enkli enstalasyon ak antretyen akwaryòm dlo sale.

strings.text: An introductory study of the anatomical structures and physiological processes of key human body systems.
strings.t: Yon etid entwodiksyon sou estrikti anatomik ak pwosesis fizyolojik gwo sistèm kò moun yo.

strings.text: Honors Seminar: Contemporary Issues in Science
strings.t: Honors Seminar: Contemporary Issues in Science
Anliy

strings.text: An asynchronous fully online course building appreciation for scientific phenomena relevant to scientifically literate adults.
strings.t: Yon kou konplètman anliy asenkwòn ki bati apresyasyon pou fenomèn syantifik ki enpòtan pou granmoun ki gen alfabetizasyon syantifik.

strings.text: Surveys prehistory through the twentieth century while equipping ninth graders with core humanities skills.
strings.t: Fè yon survey soti nan preyistwa rive nan ventyèm syèk la pandan l ap bay elèv nevyèm ane konpetans debaz nan syans imèn.
Honors Accelerated World History I

strings.text: The ancient world through circa 1450 CE using the skills, practices, and methods employed by historians.
strings.t: Mond ansyen an rive anviwon 1450 EK ak konpetans, pratik, ak metòd istoryen yo sèvi.

strings.text: Honors Civics: Foundations of Democracy and Citizenship
strings.t: Honors Civics: Foundations of Democracy and Citizenship

strings.text: Introduces the fundamental principles of democracy, citizenship, and economics in historical and modern contexts.
strings.t: Entwodui prensip fondamantal demokrasi, sitwayènte, ak ekonomi nan kontèks istorik ak modèn.
Advanced Topics: World History II

strings.text: Investigates world history from circa 1450 CE to the present, culminating in the Colloquium research project and policy proposal.
strings.t: Envestige istwa mondyal soti anviwon 1450 EK rive jodi a, ki fini nan pwojè rechèch Colloquium lan ak yon pwopozisyon politik.
Honors United States History

strings.text: Examines the development of equality, liberty, democracy, rights, and opportunity in American society.
strings.t: Egzamine devlopman egalite, libète, demokrasi, dwa, ak opòtinite nan sosyete ameriken an.
Advanced Topics: United States History

strings.text: Hones analytical skills across themes in U.S. History, culminating in the Symposium signature learning experience.
strings.t: Rafine konpetans analitik atravè tèm nan Istwa Etazini, ki fini nan eksperyans aprantisaj siyatè Symposium lan.

strings.text: Honors Practicum: Civil Discourse and the Social Sciences
strings.t: Honors Practicum: Civil Discourse and the Social Sciences

strings.text: Uses current events to explore economics, psychology, sociology, political science, and history; students teach mini-lessons in Lower and Middle School.
strings.t: Sèvi ak aktyalite pou eksplore ekonomi, sikoloji, sosyoloji, syans politik, ak istwa; elèv yo anseye mini-leson nan Lower ak Middle School.
Honors Psychology

strings.text: Introduces psychological science while diving into topics especially relevant to high school life.
strings.t: Entwodui syans sikolojik pandan l ap plonje nan sijè ki espesyalman enpòtan pou lavi lekòl segondè.

strings.text: The scientific study of human behavior and mental processes mirroring an introductory college psychology course.
strings.t: Etid syantifik konpòtman moun ak pwosesis mantal ki reflete yon kou sikoloji inivèsitè entwodiksyon.

strings.text: Advanced Topics: United States Government and Politics
strings.t: Advanced Topics: United States Government and Politics

strings.text: An analytical perspective on U.S. government and politics, culminating in an Oral Arguments Supreme Court simulation.
strings.t: Yon pèspektiv analitik sou gouvènman ak politik Etazini, ki fini nan yon similasyon Oral Arguments Supreme Court.
Advanced Topics: European History

strings.text: A hybrid senior course investigating European history from approximately 1450 to the present across seven themes.
strings.t: Yon kou dènye ane ibrid k ap envestige istwa Ewopeyen soti apeprè 1450 rive jodi a atravè sèt tèm.
Honors Spanish I: Novice
Nivo I

strings.text: Foundational communication, comprehension, and presentation skills on highly familiar topics.
strings.t: Konpetans fondasyonèl nan kominikasyon, konpreyansyon, ak prezantasyon sou sijè ki byen abitye.
Honors Spanish II: Intermediate Foundations
Nivo II

strings.text: Progresses to Novice-High and Intermediate-Low proficiency across a broader range of familiar topics.
strings.t: Pwogrese rive nan metriz Novice-High ak Intermediate-Low atravè yon pi laj varyete sijè abitye.

strings.text: Honors Spanish III: Intermediate Mid A
strings.t: Honors Spanish III: Intermediate Mid A
Nivo III

strings.text: Students participate in exchanges and present on a variety of topics using familiar vocabulary and learned grammar.
strings.t: Elèv yo patisipe nan echanj epi yo prezante sou yon varyete sijè ak vokabilè abitye ak gramè yo aprann.

strings.text: Honors Spanish IV: Intermediate Mid B
strings.t: Honors Spanish IV: Intermediate Mid B
Nivo IV

strings.text: Refines skills and broadens exposure to diverse accents from Spanish-speaking countries.
strings.t: Rafine konpetans epi elaji ekspozisyon a aksan divès nan peyi ki pale panyòl.

strings.text: Honors Spanish V: Language with a Purpose
strings.t: Honors Spanish V: Language with a Purpose
Nivo V

strings.text: Uses Spanish for communication and leadership through institution visits and conversations with native-speaking professionals.
strings.t: Sèvi ak Panyòl pou kominikasyon ak lidèchip atravè vizit nan enstitisyon ak konvèsasyon ak pwofesyonèl ki pale l natif natal.

strings.text: AP Spanish Language and Culture: Advanced
strings.t: AP Spanish Language and Culture: Advanced

strings.text: A rigorous interdisciplinary course taught exclusively in Spanish, building proficiency toward advanced-low.
strings.t: Yon kou rijid ant disiplin ansenye eksklizivman an Panyòl, ki bati metriz vè advanced-low.
Honors French I: Novice

strings.text: Acquires vocabulary and skills to start communicating in French across simple communicative tasks.
strings.t: Aprann vokabilè ak konpetans pou kòmanse kominike an Franse atravè travay kominikatif senp.
Honors French II: Intermediate Foundations

strings.text: Builds on French I with daily routines, past events, and future plans plus francophone cultures and current events.
strings.t: Bati sou French I ak woutin chak jou, evènman pase, ak plan fiti plis kilti frankofòn ak aktyalite.

strings.text: Honors French III: Intermediate Mid A
strings.t: Honors French III: Intermediate Mid A

strings.text: Immersive oral and written exchanges within the context of culture, connections, and comparisons.
strings.t: Echanj oral ak ekri imèsif nan kontèks kilti, koneksyon, ak konparezon.

strings.text: Honors French IV: Intermediate Mid B
strings.t: Honors French IV: Intermediate Mid B

strings.text: Deepens advanced grammar and vocabulary with exposure to accents from various French-speaking countries.
strings.t: Apwofondi gramè ak vokabilè avanse ak ekspozisyon a aksan ki soti nan divès peyi ki pale franse.
Honors French V: Intermediate High

strings.text: An intensive class equivalent to a fourth-semester college course developing all four language skills.
strings.t: Yon klas entansif ekivalan a yon kou inivèsitè katriyèm semès ki devlope tout kat konpetans lang yo.
Advanced Placement French Language: Advanced

strings.text: An intensive class preparing students for the AP French language examination in the spring.
strings.t: Yon klas entansif ki prepare elèv yo pou egzamen lang AP French la nan prentan.
Honors Chinese I: Novice

strings.text: Introductory Mandarin covering functional communication plus Pinyin and Chinese characters.
strings.t: Mandaren entwodiksyon ki kouvri kominikasyon fonksyonèl plis Pinyin ak karaktè chinwa.

strings.text: Honors Chinese II: Novice Mid A
strings.t: Honors Chinese II: Novice Mid A

strings.text: Students discern language patterns and forms to create complete sentences and short spontaneous conversations.
strings.t: Elèv yo distenge modèl ak fòm lang pou kreye fraz konplè ak kout konvèsasyon espontane.

strings.text: Honors Chinese III: Novice Mid B
strings.t: Honors Chinese III: Novice Mid B

strings.text: Expands characters and compound usages with emphasis on verbal usage and circumlocution.
strings.t: Elaji karaktè ak itilizasyon konpoze ak aksan sou itilizasyon vèbal ak sikonlokisyon.
Honors Chinese IV: Intermediate Foundations

strings.text: More complex structures and current events, designed to prepare students for the AP language class.
strings.t: Estrikti pi konplèks ak aktyalite, konsevwa pou prepare elèv yo pou klas lang AP la.

strings.text: Honors Chinese V: Intermediate Mid A
strings.t: Honors Chinese V: Intermediate Mid A

strings.text: Emphasizes natural colloquial usage, idiomatic phrases, Hanzi writing, and essay writing.
strings.t: Mete aksan sou itilizasyon familye natirèl, fraz idyomatik, ekri Hanzi, ak ekri redaksyon.

strings.text: Advanced Placement Chinese Language and Culture
strings.t: Advanced Placement Chinese Language and Culture

strings.text: Comparable to fourth-semester college Mandarin, deepening immersion in the Chinese-speaking world.
strings.t: Konparab a Mandaren inivèsitè katriyèm semès, ki apwofondi imèsyon nan mond ki pale chinwa a.
Atizay
Honors Visual Foundations

strings.text: A one-year introductory course and the prerequisite for all Studio Art and Media Arts courses.
strings.t: Yon kou entwodiksyon yon ane epi kondisyon anvan pou tout kou Studio Art ak Media Arts.
Honors Studio-2D

strings.text: Examines how art across two-dimensional media communicates ideas through a choice-based classroom model.
strings.t: Egzamine kijan atizay atravè medya an de dimansyon kominike lide atravè yon modèl sal klas ki baze sou chwa.
Honors Studio-3D

strings.text: Hands-on exploration of clay, wire, wood, plaster, and found objects to create sculptures, installations, and functional designs.
strings.t: Eksplorasyon pratik ajil, fil, bwa, plat, ak objè yo jwenn pou kreye eskilti, enstalasyon, ak konsepsyon fonksyonèl.
Honors Studio Arts II

strings.text: An introduction to deep studio practice, creating a series of work based on the student’s own artistic voice.
strings.t: Yon entwodiksyon nan pratik estidyo pwofon, k ap kreye yon seri travay ki baze sou pwòp vwa atistik elèv la.
Honors Studio Arts III

strings.text: A continuation of Studio Arts II with more independent research and out-of-class project work.
strings.t: Yon kontinyasyon Studio Arts II ak plis rechèch endepandan ak travay pwojè deyò klas la.
Advanced Placement Studio Art

strings.text: An intensive portfolio course for students seriously interested in the practical experience of art; portfolios replace a written exam.
strings.t: Yon kou pòtfèy entansif pou elèv ki serye sou eksperyans pratik atizay; pòtfèy yo ranplase yon egzamen ekri.
Advanced Topics: Art History

strings.text: A journey across continents and centuries pairing art analysis with hands-on studio projects; prepares for the AP Art History exam.
strings.t: Yon vwayaj atravè kontinan ak syèk ki makonnen analiz atistik ak pwojè estidyo pratik; li prepare pou egzamen AP Art History la.
Honors Theater I

strings.text: Explores fundamental skills of realistic acting plus basic principles of directing and designing for the stage.
strings.t: Eksplore konpetans fondamantal aktyaj reyalis plis prensip debaz direksyon ak konsepsyon pou sèn nan.
Honors Theater II

strings.text: Further develops acting, directing, and design through more challenging projects and greater artistic ownership.
strings.t: Devlope pi lwen aktyaj, direksyon, ak konsepsyon atravè pwojè pi difisil ak plis apwopriyasyon atistik.
Honors Theater in Performance

strings.text: For experienced students committing to public acting, directing, or production design including Fall One-Acts and Arts Jam.
strings.t: Pou elèv ki gen eksperyans ki angaje yo nan aktyaj piblik, direksyon, oswa konsepsyon pwodiksyon ki enkli Fall One-Acts ak Arts Jam.
Honors Concert Chorus

strings.text: Students sing a wide variety of literature composed for mixed choirs while learning healthful vocal production.
strings.t: Elèv yo chante yon gran varyete literati ki konpoze pou koral miks pandan y ap aprann pwodiksyon vokal ki bon pou sante.
Honors String Ensemble I–IV
Nivo I–IV

strings.text: Accommodates experienced instrumentalists performing traditional orchestra and chamber repertoire with rising technical mastery and leadership each year.
strings.t: Akomode enstrimantalis ki gen eksperyans k ap jwe repètwa òkès ak chanm tradisyonèl ak metriz teknik ak lidèchip k ap monte chak ane.
Honors Upper School Band

strings.text: Builds on middle school band across Concert Band, Big Band, and small classical Chamber Ensembles.
strings.t: Bati sou fanfa middle school atravè Concert Band, Big Band, ak ti Chamber Ensembles klasik.
Honors Cannon School Jazz Combo

strings.text: Explores modern jazz in the small combo format with daily focus on jazz theory and improvisation.
strings.t: Eksplore jaz modèn nan fòma ti gwoup ak konsantrasyon chak jou sou teori jaz ak enpwovizasyon.
Honors Modern Ensemble

strings.text: Performs American Pop, Rock, R&B, and Rap with heavy use of multi-track recording via Soundtrap.
strings.t: Jwe Pop, Rock, R&B, ak Rap Ameriken ak anpil itilizasyon anrejistreman miltipis atravè Soundtrap.
Honors Music Technology I

strings.text: Learns the language and mechanics of music through composition using the latest music technology; designed for the music novice.
strings.t: Aprann lang ak mekanik mizik atravè konpozisyon ak dènye teknoloji mizikal la; konsevwa pou debitan an mizik.
Honors Music Technology II

strings.text: Deepens compositional skills through Ableton Live and the Ableton Push MIDI controller.
strings.t: Apwofondi konpetans konpozisyon atravè Ableton Live ak kontwolè MIDI Ableton Push la.

strings.text: Honors Music Technology III: Music Production
strings.t: Honors Music Technology III: Music Production

strings.text: Advanced self-driven projects using industry-standard DAWs such as Ableton Live and Logic Pro.
strings.t: Pwojè avanse oto-dirije ak DAW estanda endistri tankou Ableton Live ak Logic Pro.

strings.text: Honors Creative Design and Engineering I
strings.t: Honors Creative Design and Engineering I

strings.text: Project-based exploration of the Iterative Design Engineering process across woodworking, sewing, electronics, and CAD.
strings.t: Eksplorasyon ki baze sou pwojè sou pwosesis Iterative Design Engineering la atravè travay bwa, koud, elektwonik, ak CAD.

strings.text: Honors Creative Design and Engineering II
strings.t: Honors Creative Design and Engineering II

strings.text: Further develops idea curation, project planning, design, and fabrication through increasingly challenging design prompts.
strings.t: Devlope pi lwen kirasyon ide, planifikasyon pwojè, konsepsyon, ak fabrikasyon atravè defi konsepsyon ki de pli zan pli difisil.

strings.text: Honors Creative Design and Engineering Studio
strings.t: Honors Creative Design and Engineering Studio
Pèmisyon

strings.text: An open-block studio for independent maker projects, evaluated through portfolio development and project check-ins.
strings.t: Yon estidyo ak blòk louvri pou pwojè kreyatè endepandan, evalye atravè devlopman pòtfèy ak revizyon pwojè.
Inovasyon ak Antrepriz

strings.text: Advanced Topics: Principles of Computer Science and Coding
strings.t: Advanced Topics: Principles of Computer Science and Coding

strings.text: Introduces the breadth of computer science, covering algorithms, programs, the internet, and AI and their consequences.
strings.t: Entwodui etandi syans enfòmatik, ki kouvri algoritm, pwogram, entènèt la, ak IA ak konsekans yo.

strings.text: Fundamentals of computer science through object-oriented design in Java, including data structures and algorithms.
strings.t: Baz syans enfòmatik atravè konsepsyon oryante objè nan Java, ki enkli estrikti done ak algoritm.

strings.text: Advanced Topics: Microeconomics: Politics and Policy
strings.t: Advanced Topics: Microeconomics: Politics and Policy

strings.text: College-level microeconomics examining supply and demand, market structures, and market failure alongside public policy.
strings.t: Mikwoekonomi nan nivo inivèsite k ap egzamine òf ak demann, estrikti mache, ak echèk mache ansanm ak politik piblik.

strings.text: Advanced Topics: Business and Entrepreneurship with Personal Finance
strings.t: Advanced Topics: Business and Entrepreneurship with Personal Finance

strings.text: A year-long project-based course where students develop and launch a business model, culminating in a Shark Tank-style pitch to investors.
strings.t: Yon kou pou tout ane a ki baze sou pwojè kote elèv yo devlope epi lanse yon modèl biznis, ki fini nan yon prezantasyon style Shark Tank bay envestisè.
Honors Business of Esports

strings.text: A hands-on exploration of the esports industry and entrepreneurship; students intern for the Collective Esports Company.
strings.t: Yon eksplorasyon pratik sou endistri esports la ak antreprenarya; elèv yo fè estaj pou Collective Esports Company.
Honors Glocal Perspectives

strings.text: An immersive service-learning exploration of global and local perspectives; required for the Global Education Certificate.
strings.t: Yon eksplorasyon aprantisaj-sèvis imèsif sou pèspektiv mondyal ak lokal; obligatwa pou Global Education Certificate la.

strings.text: Reviews arithmetic and number sense — decimal and fraction operations — before ratios and percentages, integers, variables, equations and inequalities, 2D and 3D geometry, and statistics.

strings.text: Life Science — cells, heredity, DNA, viruses, bacteria, protists and fungi, animals, human body systems, plants and dissection, with lab experiments and projects.

strings.text: Deeper literary analysis within a biblical worldview — multi-paragraph argumentative essays with thesis, textual evidence and commentary, plus expository writing and accelerated language conventions.

strings.text: Ratios and proportional relationships, unit conversions, integers across all operations, order of operations and expressions, equations and inequalities, geometry, statistics and probability.
strings.t: Rapò ak relasyon pwopòsyonèl, konvèsyon inite, antye relatif nan tout operasyon, lòd operasyon ak ekspresyon, ekwasyon ak inekwasyon, jeyometri, estatistik ak pwobabilite.

strings.text: The Gospels, woven together to show the life of Christ and his fulfilment of Scripture, alongside how to study the Bible and build a habit of personal devotions.

strings.text: Phonics through directionality, letter sounds, at least 10 digraphs, CVC sound blending and 5 common exception words; retelling and predicting in comprehension; and forming most lowercase and capital letters.
strings.t: Fonetik atravè direksyon, son lèt yo, omwen 10 digraf, melanj son CVC ak 5 mo komen ki gen òtograf iregilye; rakonte ankò ak prevwa nan konpreyansyon; ak fòme pifò lèt miniskil ak majiskil.

strings.text: Positional relationships and 2D shapes, comparing length, weight and capacity; counting to 20 and backward from 10, number bonds to 5, doubles to 10, subitizing to 5; and repeating patterns, sorting, and comparing quantities to 10.
strings.t: Relasyon pozisyon ak fòm 2D, konpare longè, pwa ak kapasite; konte jiska 20 ak fè bak depi 10, konpozisyon nonb jiska 5, doub jiska 10, ak subitizasyon jiska 5; ak modèl ki repete, klasman, ak konparezon kantite jiska 10.

strings.text: God’s love through short memorized Scripture passages and key Bible characters, with weekly chapel and lower school Missions Week.

strings.text: Exploring the natural world — body parts, seasons, life cycles, plant growth and changing states of matter — alongside significant historical figures, past/present/future, other countries, and community helpers.
strings.t: Eksplore mond natirèl la — pati kò a, sezon, sik lavi, kwasans plant ak chanjman eta matyè — bò kote gwo figi istorik, tan pase, prezan ak fiti, lòt peyi, ak moun k ap sèvi kominote a.

strings.text: Imaginative role-play and performing for an audience, with nursery rhymes and songs alongside a range of materials, tools and art techniques.
strings.t: Jwèt wòl imajinatif ak jwe devan yon piblik, ak kontin ak chante bò kote yon seri materyèl, zouti ak teknik atistik.

strings.text: Math talks with manipulatives — counting and skip counting to 100, number recognition and formation 0–20, place value to 20, geometry, patterns, sorting, measurement, combinations of 10, graphing, estimating and calendar.

strings.text: Friendship with God and others through group projects, activity centers and classroom community, with weekly chapel, Missions Week, memorized Scripture and Bible characters.

strings.text: God’s strength in the oceans, creative patterns through the seasons, and animal life cycles.
strings.t: Fòs Bondye nan lanmè yo, modèl kreyasyon an atravè sezon yo, ak sik lavi bèt yo.

strings.text: Explorers, pilgrims and Native Americans, famous artists and holidays, and world cultures and traditions as a way into empathy for others.
strings.t: Eksploratè, pelren ak Amerendyen, atis selèb ak fèt, ak kilti ak tradisyon mondyal kòm yon chemen pou gen anpati pou lòt moun.
