Gr 1

strings.text: Phonics and spelling through decoding and fluency; grammar covering parts of speech, capitalization and sentence types; comprehension from retelling to cause/effect and fact/opinion; and personal narrative, opinion and informational writing.
strings.t: Fonetik ak òtograf atravè dekodaj ak fasilite; gramè ki kouvri klas mo, majiskil ak kalite fraz; konpreyansyon depi rakonte ankò rive nan koz/efè ak reyalite/opinyon; ak ekri istwa pèsonèl, opinyon ak tèks enfòmatif.

strings.text: Place value to 100 and numbers to 120, number bonds, addition and subtraction to 100, ordinal numbers, 2D and 3D shapes, mental math, customary length and weight, picture and bar graphs, money, calendar and time.
strings.t: Valè pozisyon jiska 100 ak nonb jiska 120, konpozisyon nonb, adisyon ak soustraksyon jiska 100, nonb òdinal, fòm 2D ak 3D, kalkil mantal, longè ak pwa nan sistèm ameriken an, graf ak imaj ak ak ba, lajan, kalandriye ak lè.

strings.text: Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, Joseph, Moses, Israel and the Promised Land, then Judges and Ruth, Samuel and Saul, David and Solomon, the divided kingdom, exile and return, Psalms and Proverbs.
strings.t: Abraram, Izarak ak Jakòb, Jozèf, Moyiz, Izrayèl ak Tè Pwomiz la, apre sa Jij yo ak Rit, Samyèl ak Sayil, David ak Salomon, wayòm ki divize a, egzil ak retou, Sòm ak Pwovèb.

strings.text: Seasonal patterns, plants, light and sound waves, animal behaviors and habitats.
strings.t: Modèl sezon yo, plant, onn limyè ak son, ak konpòtman ak abita bèt yo.

strings.text: Safety, laws and responsible citizenship, with units on home, school and community, map skills, and past, present and future events.
strings.t: Sekirite, lwa ak sitwayènte responsab, ak inite sou kay, lekòl ak kominote, ladrès kat jeyografik, ak evènman pase, prezan ak fiti.
Grad 2
Gr 2

strings.text: Decoding and encoding short, long-vowel and multi-syllabic words; grammar through contractions and sentence types; comprehension including sequencing and verbal reasoning; and expanded narrative and informational writing in print and cursive.
strings.t: Dekode ak enkode mo kout, ak vwayèl long ak plizyè silab; gramè rive nan kontraksyon ak kalite fraz; konpreyansyon ki gen ladan mete an sekans ak rezònman vèbal; ak ekriti naratif ak enfòmatif elaji, nan lèt kare ak nan kursif.

strings.text: Fact families to 20, mental math and estimation, place value to 1,000, 2- and 3-digit addition and subtraction, an introduction to fractions, multiplication and division, time, money, customary and metric measurement, and bar-model problem solving.
strings.t: Fanmi operasyon jiska 20, kalkil mantal ak estimasyon, valè pozisyon jiska 1,000, adisyon ak soustraksyon 2 ak 3 chif, yon entwodiksyon nan fraksyon, miltiplikasyon ak divizyon, lè, lajan, mezi ameriken ak metrik, ak rezoud pwoblèm ak modèl ba.

strings.text: An Old Testament review via the Jesse Tree and the intertestamental period, then the New Testament — Jesus’ birth, ministry, miracles, parables, crucifixion and resurrection — closing with the early church and Paul’s journeys.
strings.t: Yon revizyon Ansyen Testaman an atravè Pyebwa Jese a ak peryòd ant de Testaman yo, apre sa Nouvo Testaman an — nesans Jezi, ministè li, mirak li, parabòl li, krisifiksyon ak rezirèksyon li — pou fini ak legliz premye jou yo ak vwayaj Pòl yo.

strings.text: The human body, life cycles, insects, oceanography, animal behaviors and interactions with matter.
strings.t: Kò moun, sik lavi, ensèk, oseyanografi, ak konpòtman bèt yo ak jan yo entèraji ak matyè.

strings.text: Immigration, geography’s influence on communities, community helpers and resources, globes and map skills, holidays and world culture, plus how officials are elected and how history shapes a community’s heritage.
strings.t: Imigrasyon, jan jeyografi enfliyanse kominote, moun k ap sèvi kominote a ak resous li, glòb ak ladrès kat jeyografik, fèt ak kilti mondyal, plis kijan yo eli ofisyèl yo ak kijan istwa fòme eritaj yon kominote.
Grad 3
Gr 3

strings.text: Spelling patterns, rules and syllable division; grammar across synonyms, antonyms, homonyms, prepositions and irregular verbs; comprehension through inference and author’s purpose; and simple, compound and four sentence types in composition.
strings.t: Modèl òtograf, règ ak divizyon silab; gramè ak sinonim, antonim, omonim, prepozisyon ak vèb iregilye; konpreyansyon atravè enferans ak entansyon otè a; ak fraz senp, konpoze ak kat kalite fraz nan konpozisyon.

strings.text: Place value to 10,000, rounding, mental math and estimation, bar models for word problems, multiplication facts 0–12, 1- and 2-digit multiplication and division, fractions and decimals, angles and lines, area and perimeter, and measurement conversions.
strings.t: Valè pozisyon jiska 10,000, awondi, kalkil mantal ak estimasyon, modèl ba pou pwoblèm, tab miltiplikasyon 0 rive 12, miltiplikasyon ak divizyon 1 ak 2 chif, fraksyon ak desimal, ang ak dwat, sifas ak perimèt, ak konvèsyon mezi.

strings.text: Creation, the fall, Noah, the Tower of Babel, Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Joseph, the Exodus, the ten commandments, the wilderness and the Promised Land, closing with a book study of Ephesians.
strings.t: Kreyasyon an, chit la, Noye, Tou Babèl la, Abraram, Izarak, Jakòb, Jozèf, Egzòd la, dis kòmandman yo, dezè a ak Tè Pwomiz la, pou fini ak yon etid liv Efezyen an.

strings.text: Forces and magnetism, the earth and the activity on it, plants, animals and fossils.
strings.t: Fòs ak mayetis, tè a ak aktivite ki fèt sou li, plant, bèt ak fosil.

strings.text: How events, individuals and ideas have shaped communities — especially Charlotte, NC — plus major landforms and their impact on people, industry and the economy, and the 13 American colonies.
strings.t: Kijan evènman, moun ak lide fòme kominote — sitou Charlotte, nan Kawolin di Nò — plis gwo fòm relyèf yo ak enpak yo sou popilasyon, endistri ak ekonomi, ak 13 koloni ameriken yo.
Grad 4

strings.text: Word analysis, fluency and vocabulary using glossaries, dictionaries and thesauruses; morphology and spelling rules with sentence parts and subject-verb agreement; comprehension through inference and author’s viewpoint; and writing for different purposes and audiences.
strings.t: Analiz mo, fasilite ak vokabilè ak glosè, diksyonè ak diksyonè sinonim; mòfoloji ak règ òtograf ak pati fraz ak akò sijè-vèb; konpreyansyon atravè enferans ak pwendvi otè a; ak ekri pou diferan objektif ak diferan piblik.

strings.text: Multi-digit operations, common multiples and factors, mean, median, mode and range, fractions and decimals across all four operations, customary and metric measurement, perimeter and area, lines and angles, quadrilaterals, congruence and symmetry, and multi-step bar models.
strings.t: Operasyon ak plizyè chif, miltip ak divizè komen, mwayèn, medyàn, mòd ak etandi, fraksyon ak desimal nan kat operasyon yo, mezi ameriken ak metrik, perimèt ak sifas, dwat ak ang, kadrilatè, kongriyans ak simetri, ak modèl ba ak plizyè etap.

strings.text: Philippians, Judges, Joshua, Kings Saul, David and Solomon, Ruth, Samuel, the divided kingdom, the feast of trumpets, the day of atonement, and the fruit of the spirit.
strings.t: Filipyen, Jij yo, Jozye, wa Sayil, David ak Salomon, Rit, Samyèl, wayòm ki divize a, fèt twonpèt yo, jou padon an, ak fwi lespri a.

strings.text: Energy, speed and moving objects, waves, the earth’s features, natural hazards, and structures and functions.
strings.t: Enèji, vitès ak objè k ap deplase, onn, karakteristik tè a, danje natirèl, ak estrikti ak fonksyon yo.

strings.text: North Carolina — its regions, history and government, and the environmental and technological factors shaping the state’s growth.
strings.t: Kawolin di Nò — rejyon li, istwa li ak gouvènman li, ak faktè anviwònmantal ak teknolojik k ap fòme kwasans eta a.
Grad 5

strings.text: Parts of speech, analogies, subjects and predicates, prepositional phrases and clauses; comprehension across fiction, fantasy, biography, historical fiction, non-fiction and poetry; and descriptive, narrative, expository and persuasive writing plus literary analysis.
strings.t: Klas mo, analoji, sijè ak predika, gwoup prepozisyonèl ak pwopozisyon; konpreyansyon nan fiksyon, fantezi, biyografi, fiksyon istorik, non-fiksyon ak pwezi; ak ekriti deskriptif, naratif, ekspozitif ak pèsyazif plis analiz literè.

strings.text: Place value to 10,000,000, mental math and estimation, multi-digit multiplication and division, fractions, bar-graph problem-solving models, algebraic thinking, area and perimeter, ratios, decimals and percents, graphs, probability and types of angles.
strings.t: Valè pozisyon jiska 10,000,000, kalkil mantal ak estimasyon, miltiplikasyon ak divizyon plizyè chif, fraksyon, modèl ba pou rezoud pwoblèm, panse aljebrik, sifas ak perimèt, rapò, desimal ak pousantaj, graf, pwobabilite ak kalite ang.

strings.text: 1 Peter, Old Testament covenants, Judah’s return, the writers of the Gospels, Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur, Hannukah, Passover, and Jesus’ birth, ministry, parables, death and resurrection.
strings.t: 1 Pyè, alyans Ansyen Testaman yo, retou Jida a, moun ki ekri Levanjil yo, Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippour, Hanoukka, Pak jwif la, ak nesans Jezi, ministè li, parabòl li, lanmò ak rezirèksyon li.

strings.text: Chemical and physical property change, gravity, energy, photosynthesis and plant decomposition, and earth systems.
strings.t: Chanjman pwopriyete chimik ak fizik, gravite, enèji, fotosentèz ak dekonpozisyon plant, ak sistèm tè yo.

strings.text: World and state geography, ancient Mesopotamia, Greece and Rome, Vikings, Medieval Europe, the Renaissance and Reformation, the Age of Exploration, and the Mayas, Incas and Aztecs.
strings.t: Jeyografi mondyal ak jeyografi eta a, ansyen Mezopotami, Grès ak Wòm, Viking yo, Ewòp Mwayennaj la, Renesans ak Refòm, Epòk Eksplorasyon an, ak Maya, Enka ak Aztèk yo.
Specials
JK–Gr 5

strings.text: Skill, craftsmanship, beauty, clarity and balance practiced through painting, sketching, ceramics, printmaking, landscapes and portraits, shown at the annual spring Art Walk.
strings.t: Ladrès, bèl travay men, bote, klète ak ekilib yo pratike atravè penti, desen, seramik, gravi, peyizaj ak pòtrè, epi yo ekspoze nan Art Walk anyèl prentan an.

strings.text: Vocal, instrumental and percussion music across classical and modern composers; 4th grade learns recorder and 5th grade band instruments, with a children’s choir and private piano, vocal and guitar lessons available.
strings.t: Mizik vokal, enstrimantal ak pèkisyon nan konpozitè klasik ak modèn; grad 4 aprann flit dous epi grad 5 aprann enstriman fanfa, ak yon koral timoun ak leson prive pyano, chan ak gita ki disponib.
CREATE Junior

strings.text: Integrates technology and critical thinking with each grade’s content areas through science, technology, math and engineering — the precursor to the Middle School’s CREATE.
strings.t: Entegre teknoloji ak panse kritik ak kontni chak grad atravè syans, teknoloji, matematik ak enjenyeri — sa ki vin anvan CREATE Middle School la.

strings.text: Teaches the language alongside the culture, studying the holidays, geography and traditions of Spanish communities.
strings.t: Anseye lang lan ansanm ak kilti a, nan etidye fèt, jeyografi ak tradisyon kominote ki pale Panyòl yo.

strings.text: Weekly athletic skills and endurance work built on developmentally appropriate lessons, with the Turkey Trot and Field Day as highlights.
strings.t: Travay chak semèn sou ladrès atletik ak andirans bati sou leson ki adapte ak devlopman timoun, ak Turkey Trot ak Field Day kòm gwo moman yo.

strings.text: Finding books and developing research skills in print and online, with the Readers Are Leaders program encouraging reading for pleasure with a purpose.
strings.t: Jwenn liv ak devlope ladrès rechèch sou papye ak sou entènèt, ak pwogram Readers Are Leaders la ki ankouraje moun li pou plezi men ak yon objektif.
Laj 2 – Grad 4

strings.text: No published course or subject list — Davidson Day describes Early Childhood and Lower School in prose only.
strings.t: Pa gen lis kou oswa matyè ki pibliye — Davidson Day dekri Early Childhood ak Lower School an pwoz sèlman.

strings.text: Davidson Day publishes no course lists, subject lists, or named curriculum programs for Early Childhood or Lower School. Verified against the live pages, their October 2025 Wayback captures, and the school’s full Issuu publication index. The Lower School runs an 8:1 student-to-faculty ratio.
strings.t: Davidson Day pa pibliye okenn lis kou, lis matyè, oswa pwogram kourikoulòm ki gen non pou Early Childhood oswa Lower School. Verifye kont paj ki an dirèk yo, kaptè Wayback oktòb 2025 yo, ak endèks piblikasyon Issuu konplè lekòl la. Lower School la fonksyone ak yon rapò elèv-a-pwofesè 8:1.
Sa ki pibliye
Laj 2 – JK

strings.text: Early Preschool (2s/3s), Preschool (3s/4s), and Junior Kindergarten (4s/5s) target cognitive skills, language development, motor skills, executive functioning, and social-emotional wellness.
strings.t: Early Preschool (2 an/3 an), Preschool (3 an/4 an), ak Junior Kindergarten (4 an/5 an) vize konpetans kognitif, devlopman lang, konpetans motè, fonksyon egzekitif, ak byennèt sosyo-emosyonèl.
K–Gr 4

strings.text: Art, world language, library, physical education, and music, plus Lower School science and technology labs for hands-on experimentation.
strings.t: Atizay, lang etranje, bibliyotèk, edikasyon fizik, ak mizik, plis laboratwa syans ak teknoloji Lower School pou eksperimantasyon pratik.

strings.text: 10 named math courses plus Study Skills — the only Middle School courses Davidson Day publishes, via the Upper School catalog’s progression chart.
strings.t: 10 kou matematik ki gen non plis Study Skills — sèl kou Middle School Davidson Day pibliye, atravè tablo pwogresyon katalòg Upper School la.

strings.text: No Middle School course catalog or curriculum guide exists. The math courses below come from the Upper School catalog’s progression chart; everything else on the Middle School page is marketing prose.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn katalòg kou oswa gid kourikoulòm Middle School ki egziste. Kou matematik ki anba yo soti nan tablo pwogresyon katalòg Upper School la; tout lòt bagay sou paj Middle School la se pwoz maketing.
5th Grade Math

strings.text: The entry point of the standard middle-school math sequence.
strings.t: Pwen antre sekans matematik middle school estanda a.
Accelerated Math 1

strings.text: The accelerated entry track, taken in Grade 5 or 6.
strings.t: Pis antre akselere a, ke yo pran nan Grad 5 oswa 6.
Math 1

strings.text: The standard sixth-grade course following 5th Grade Math.
strings.t: Kou sizyèm ane estanda a ki swiv 5th Grade Math.
Accelerated Math 2

strings.text: The accelerated course following Accelerated Math 1.
strings.t: Kou akselere a ki swiv Accelerated Math 1.
Accelerated Math 2/3

strings.text: A compressed combined course on the fastest track.
strings.t: Yon kou konbine konprese sou pis ki pi rapid la.
Math 2

strings.text: The standard seventh-grade course following Math 1.
strings.t: Kou setyèm ane estanda a ki swiv Math 1.
Accelerated Math 3

strings.text: The accelerated course preceding Honors Algebra 1.
strings.t: Kou akselere a ki vin anvan Honors Algebra 1.
Math 3

strings.text: The standard eighth-grade course leading to Algebra 1.
strings.t: Kou uityèm ane estanda a ki mennen nan Algebra 1.

strings.text: Upper-School-credit algebra taken as early as Grade 7 on the fastest track.
strings.t: Aljèb ak kredi Upper School ke yo ka pran depi Grad 7 sou pis ki pi rapid la.
Jeyometri ak kredi Upper School ki disponib nan Grad 8.
Lòt detay ki pibliye
Study Skills

strings.text: Every Middle School student takes a study-skills course each year — "four years of building the tools for success."
strings.t: Chak elèv Middle School pran yon kou konpetans etid chak ane — “kat ane ap bati zouti pou siksè.”
Aksè a kou Upper School

strings.text: Middle School students may take Upper School world language and mathematics courses; those credits count toward graduation but are excluded from Upper School GPA.
strings.t: Elèv Middle School ka pran kou lang etranje ak matematik Upper School; kredi sa yo konte pou gradyasyon men yo eskli nan GPA Upper School la.
AFAR International Research
Gr 7+

strings.text: Accredited archaeological fieldwork opens in Grade 7, at Maya, medieval Spanish, and Roman Portuguese sites.
strings.t: Travay teren akeyolojik akredite louvri nan Grad 7, nan sit Maya, Espay medyeval, ak Pòtigal women.

strings.text: ~75 catalogued courses across 9 departments — 26 AP courses, post-AP Calculus III, and three Diploma Distinction tracks.
strings.t: ~75 kou nan katalòg atravè 9 depatman — 26 kou AP, Calculus III pòs-AP, ak twa pis Diploma Distinction.

strings.text: A survey of literary genres built on The Crucible, Romeo and Juliet, and Of Mice and Men, with sustained academic-writing practice.
strings.t: Yon survey jan literè bati sou The Crucible, Romeo and Juliet, ak Of Mice and Men, ak pratik ekri akademik soutni.
English I Honors

strings.text: The English I sequence at an accelerated, more intensive pace, entered by recommendation of eighth-grade teachers.
strings.t: Sekans English I la nan yon vitès akselere ak pi entans, kote ou antre pa rekòmandasyon pwofesè uityèm ane.

strings.text: Study of Beowulf, Othello, and Animal Farm alongside short-story and poetry units, emphasizing deeper meaning and implication in texts.
strings.t: Etid Beowulf, Othello, ak Animal Farm ansanm ak inite istwa kout ak pwezi, ak aksan sou sans pi pwofon ak sa tèks yo sijere.
English II Honors

strings.text: Reads A Long Way Gone, Much Ado About Nothing, and Predictably Irrational, extending English II skills through scaffolded responses.
strings.t: Li A Long Way Gone, Much Ado About Nothing, ak Predictably Irrational, ki pwolonje konpetans English II atravè repons etaje.
English III Honors

strings.text: A literature-based course on 1984, The Stranger, The Great Gatsby, and Frankenstein, building literary analysis and argument construction.
strings.t: Yon kou ki baze sou literati sou 1984, The Stranger, The Great Gatsby, ak Frankenstein, ki bati analiz literè ak konstriksyon agiman.
English IV Honors

strings.text: First semester explores the literary voice of the American South; second semester is a seminar on Shakespeare’s comedies.
strings.t: Premye semès eksplore vwa literè Sid Ameriken an; dezyèm semès se yon seminè sou komedi Shakespeare yo.

strings.text: A writing- and reading-intensive study of rhetoric in which students learn to analyze and construct effective arguments.
strings.t: Yon etid retorik ki entans nan ekri ak li kote elèv yo aprann analize epi konstwi agiman efikas.

strings.text: Composition and literary analysis across genres, examining representative British and American novels and plays from the sixteenth century on.
strings.t: Konpozisyon ak analiz literè atravè jan, k ap egzamine woman ak pyès britanik ak ameriken reprezantatif apati sèzyèm syèk la.
Creative Writing Honors

strings.text: An honors elective workshop in poetry, life writing, and fiction, culminating in portfolios and a self-designed final project.
strings.t: Yon atelye elektif honors nan pwezi, ekri sou lavi, ak fiksyon, ki fini nan pòtfèy ak yon pwojè final elèv la konsevwa.
Introduction to Yearbook

strings.text: Students produce the Revolution yearbook while learning journalistic writing, photography, interviewing, and ad sales.
strings.t: Elèv yo pwodui ane-liv Revolution lan pandan y ap aprann ekri jounalistik, fotografi, entèvyou, ak vann piblisite.

strings.text: Advanced yearbook students take leadership roles in theme, layout, staff training, and business campaigns.
strings.t: Elèv ane-liv avanse pran wòl lidèchip nan tèm, mizanpaj, fòmasyon estaf, ak kanpay biznis.

strings.text: Introduces the fundamental concepts of algebra and their multiple representations, including linear and quadratic equations and polynomials.
strings.t: Entwodui konsèp fondamantal aljèb ak plizyè reprezantasyon yo, ki enkli ekwasyon lineyè ak kadratik ak polinòm.
Algebra I Honors

strings.text: The Algebra I curriculum at an accelerated pace, entered from Accelerated Math 3 or Honors Prealgebra.
strings.t: Kourikoulòm Algebra I la nan yon vitès akselere, kote ou antre soti nan Accelerated Math 3 oswa Honors Prealgebra.

strings.text: Classical Euclidean geometry — congruence, similarity, solid and analytic geometry, and right-triangle trigonometry — with emphasis on proof.
strings.t: Jeyometri Euklidyen klasik — kongriyans, similarite, jeyometri solid ak analitik, ak trigonometri triyang rektang — ak aksan sou prèv.

strings.text: Geometry covered at a faster pace and greater depth, requiring Honors Algebra I and departmental approval.
strings.t: Jeyometri kouvri nan yon vitès pi rapid ak plis pwofondè, ki egzije Honors Algebra I ak apwobasyon depatman an.

strings.text: Polynomial functions in depth plus rational, square-root, logarithmic, and exponential models, with graphing-calculator work integral.
strings.t: Fonksyon polinòm an pwofondè plis modèl rasyonèl, rasin kare, logaritmik, ak eksponansyèl, ak travay ak kalkilatris grafik ki entegral.
Algebra II/Trigonometry Honors

strings.text: The Algebra II curriculum with trigonometric functions added, requiring Geometry Honors and summer work.
strings.t: Kourikoulòm Algebra II la ak fonksyon trigonometrik ajoute, ki egzije Geometry Honors ak travay ete.

strings.text: Combines trigonometry, geometry, and algebra concepts needed for calculus, strengthening understanding of algebraic and transcendental functions.
strings.t: Konbine konsèp trigonometri, jeyometri, ak aljèb ki nesesè pou kalkil, ki ranfòse konpreyansyon fonksyon aljebrik ak transandantal.
AP Precalculus

strings.text: College Board–aligned study of polynomial, rational, exponential, logarithmic, and trigonometric functions emphasizing modeling.
strings.t: Etid aliyen ak College Board sou fonksyon polinòm, rasyonèl, eksponansyèl, logaritmik, ak trigonometrik ak aksan sou modèl.

strings.text: An advanced course covering limits, continuity, derivatives, the Fundamental Theorems, and integration techniques.
strings.t: Yon kou avanse ki kouvri limit, kontinwite, derive, Teyorèm Fondamantal yo, ak teknik entegrasyon.

strings.text: A college-level introduction to differential and integral calculus applied to change, motion, and accumulation.
strings.t: Yon entwodiksyon nan nivo inivèsite nan kalkil diferansyèl ak entegral aplike a chanjman, mouvman, ak akimilasyon.

strings.text: Extends Calculus AB with parametric, polar, and vector functions plus sequences and series.
strings.t: Pwolonje Calculus AB ak fonksyon paramtetrik, polè, ak vektoryèl plis sekans ak seri.

strings.text: Calculus III Honors: Multivariable Calculus and Linear Algebra
strings.t: Calculus III Honors: Multivariable Calculus and Linear Algebra

strings.text: Semester courses extending calculus into higher dimensions plus linear algebra topics; weighted 1.0 like an AP.
strings.t: Kou semès ki pwolonje kalkil nan dimansyon pi wo plis sijè aljèb lineyè; ak yon pwa 1.0 tankou yon AP.

strings.text: Major concepts and tools for collecting, analyzing, and drawing conclusions from data, spanning sampling, probability, and inference.
strings.t: Gwo konsèp ak zouti pou ranmase, analize, ak tire konklizyon nan done, ki kouvri echantiyonaj, pwobabilite, ak enferans.
Istwa ak Syans Sosyal
Civics and Deliberative Democracy

strings.text: A foundational humanities course rooted in constitutional principles, using research, position papers, and structured debate.
strings.t: Yon kou syans imèn fondasyonèl ki ankre nan prensip konstitisyonèl, ak rechèch, papye pozisyon, ak deba estriktire.
Civics Honors

strings.text: The Civics course with added analytical rigor, primary-source interpretation, and AP-style writing prompts.
strings.t: Kou Civics la ak plis rigè analitik, entèpretasyon sous prensipal, ak kesyon ekri nan style AP.
Survey istwa mondyal obligatwa dezyèm ane a.
AP World History (Modern)

strings.text: A college-level survey from roughly 1200 CE forward, covering global integration, industrialization, colonialism, and ideological conflict.
strings.t: Yon survey nan nivo inivèsite apati apeprè 1200 EK, ki kouvri entegrasyon mondyal, endistriyalizasyon, kolonyalis, ak konfli ideyolojik.

strings.text: Surveys United States history from the peopling of North America to the present through diverse viewpoints and primary-source argumentation.
strings.t: Fè yon survey sou istwa Etazini soti nan peple Amerik di Nò rive jodi a atravè pwendevi divès ak agimantasyon ak sous prensipal.

strings.text: A college-level survey with substantially greater reading — primary documents, cartoons, maps, data sets — pushing students to work like historians.
strings.t: Yon survey nan nivo inivèsite ak siyifikativman plis lekti — dokiman prensipal, karikati, kat, ansanm done — ki pouse elèv yo travay tankou istoryen.

strings.text: Investigates significant European events and processes from about 1450 to the present.
strings.t: Envestige evènman ak pwosesis Ewopeyen enpòtan soti apeprè 1450 rive jodi a.

strings.text: Principles of economics applied to individual producers and consumers; offered 2026-2027 on an alternate-year rotation.
strings.t: Prensip ekonomi aplike a pwodiktè ak konsomatè endividyèl; ofri an 2026-2027 nan yon wotasyon chak lòt ane.

strings.text: Principles of economics applied to the economic system as a whole; offered 2027-2028 on an alternate-year rotation.
strings.t: Prensip ekonomi aplike a sistèm ekonomik la an antye; ofri an 2027-2028 nan yon wotasyon chak lòt ane.

strings.text: The systematic, scientific study of human behavior and thought — learning, motivation, memory, neuroanatomy — with experimental design work.
strings.t: Etid sistematik ak syantifik konpòtman ak panse moun — aprantisaj, motivasyon, memwa, neroanatomi — ak travay konsepsyon eksperimantal.

strings.text: Cultivates understanding of U.S. government through data and text analysis of constitutionalism, liberty and order, and civic participation.
strings.t: Kiltive konpreyansyon gouvènman Etazini atravè analiz done ak tèks sou konstitisyonalis, libète ak lòd, ak patisipasyon sivik.
Anthropology Honors

strings.text: A systematic overview of anthropology’s four subfields — cultural, physical, archaeology, and linguistics.
strings.t: Yon gade sistematik sou kat sou-domèn antwopoloji yo — kiltirèl, fizik, akeyoloji, ak lengwistik.

strings.text: Waves, sound, and light, then mechanics and electric circuits, with mathematical models limited to Algebra I concepts.
strings.t: Vag, son, ak limyè, apre sa mekanik ak sikwi elektrik, ak modèl matematik limite a konsèp Algebra I.

strings.text: The same physics sequence adding Geometry-level mathematical modeling.
strings.t: Menm sekans fizik la ak modèl matematik nan nivo Geometry ajoute.

strings.text: Algebra-based introductory college physics covering kinematics, dynamics, energy, momentum, torque, gravitation, and fluids.
strings.t: Fizik inivèsitè entwodiksyon ki baze sou aljèb ki kouvri sinematik, dinamik, enèji, momantòm, kouraj, gravitasyon, ak fliyid.
AP Physics 2

strings.text: Algebra-based second-semester college physics covering fluids, thermodynamics, electricity and magnetism, optics, and modern physics.
strings.t: Fizik inivèsitè dezyèm semès ki baze sou aljèb ki kouvri fliyid, tèmodinamik, elektrisite ak mayetis, optik, ak fizik modèn.

strings.text: Fundamental principles of chemistry — matter, atomic structure, reactions, stoichiometry, bonding, kinetics and equilibrium — with quantitative labs.
strings.t: Prensip fondamantal chimi — matyè, estrikti atomik, reyaksyon, estekyometri, lyezon, sinetik ak ekilib — ak laboratwa kantitatif.

strings.text: Chemistry with strong emphasis on critical thinking, independent lab investigation, and writing.
strings.t: Chimi ak gwo aksan sou panse kritik, envestigasyon laboratwa endepandan, ak ekri.

strings.text: A college-level chemistry foundation covering atomic structure, intermolecular forces, kinetics, thermodynamics, and equilibrium.
strings.t: Yon fondasyon chimi nan nivo inivèsite ki kouvri estrikti atomik, fòs entèmolekilè, sinetik, tèmodinamik, ak ekilib.

strings.text: Major principles of modern biology — organization of life, cell structure and division, DNA, genetics, evolution, and ecology.
strings.t: Gwo prensip byoloji modèn — òganizasyon lavi, estrikti ak divizyon selil, ADN, jenetik, evolisyon, ak ekoloji.

strings.text: Biology with greater depth and rigor, adding inquiry learning with current research data and independent experiment design.

strings.text: College-level biology organized around molecules and cells, individual organisms, and populations, with significant independent work.

strings.text: Foundational number sense in Kindergarten building through Grade 5 fraction operations, volume, measurement, decimals, geometry and coordinate planes — visual models, hands-on activities and word-problem reasoning throughout.
strings.t: Sans nonm fondamantal nan Kindergarten k ap bati atravè operasyon fraksyon, volim, mezi, desimal, jeyometri ak plan kowòdone nan Grade 5 — modèl vizyèl, aktivite ak men ak rezònman pwoblèm-mo toupatou.

strings.text: A multisensory literacy block rooted in the Science of Reading with Orton-Gillingham phonics; strands span phonemic awareness, phonics and morphology, reading (Accelerated Reader from Grade 1), grammar (Analytical Grammar by Grade 5), composition and handwriting.
strings.t: Yon blòk alfabetizasyon miltisansoryèl ki chita nan Science of Reading ak fonik Orton-Gillingham; branch yo kouvri konsyans fonemik, fonik ak mòfoloji, lekti (Accelerated Reader depi Grade 1), gramè (Analytical Grammar rive Grade 5), konpozisyon ak ekri alamen.

strings.text: Inquiry-based, hands-on study of God’s creation across life, physical and earth/space science, advancing by grade from plants and matter to water and climate, energy and environments, and living systems.
strings.t: Etid ak men, ki baze sou envestigasyon, sou kreyasyon Bondye atravè syans lavi, fizik ak latè/espas, k ap avanse pa klas depi plant ak matyè rive dlo ak klima, enèji ak anviwònman, ak sistèm vivan.

strings.text: Civics, culture, economics, geography and history from a biblical worldview, progressing from community themes through US history, North Carolina history (Grade 4) and early American history to the 1880s (Grade 5).
strings.t: Sivik, kilti, ekonomi, jeyografi ak istwa nan yon vizyon-monn biblik, k ap avanse depi tèm kominote atravè istwa US, istwa North Carolina (Grade 4) ak premye istwa ameriken rive 1880 yo (Grade 5).
Special Areas (Tout Klas)

strings.text: Foundational construction skills — painting, drawing, cutting, collage — with the elements of art, art vocabulary and self-assessment, framing creativity as an expression of God’s design.
strings.t: Ladrès konstriksyon fondamantal — penti, desen, koupe, kolaj — ak eleman atizay, vokabilè atizay ak oto-evalyasyon, ki prezante kreyativite kòm yon ekspresyon design Bondye.

strings.text: Language development through songs, games, literature, art and technology across the three modes of communication — interpretive, interpersonal and presentational.
strings.t: Devlopman lang atravè chante, jwèt, literati, atizay ak teknoloji atravè twa mòd kominikasyon — enteprетatif, entèpèsonèl ak prezantasyonèl.
Media / Technology

strings.text: Digital resources, Google Classroom and Chrome, and basic keyboarding and coding, taught with the Media Specialist and Technology Specialist.
strings.t: Resous dijital, Google Classroom ak Chrome, ak dactilografi ak kodaj debaz, anseye ak Media Specialist ak Technology Specialist.

strings.text: Music literacy, response and relevance as a form of worship — the elements of music and foundational skills on hand drums, kazoos and boomwhackers, with interdisciplinary connections.
strings.t: Alfabetizasyon mizik, repons ak enpòtans kòm yon fòm adorasyon — eleman mizik ak ladrès fondamantal sou tanbou men, kazou ak boomwhacker, ak koneksyon entèdisiplinè.

strings.text: Spatial awareness, games, fitness challenges, fine- and large-motor development, teamwork and the foundations of personal and social responsibility.
strings.t: Konsyans espasyal, jwèt, defi fòm fizik, devlopman motè fen ak gwo, travay an ekip ak fondasyon responsablite pèsonèl ak sosyal.

strings.text: The STEM Lab — engineering builds, Dash-robot coding, codable Lego kits and 3D-printer designs, often tied directly to the classroom science curriculum.
strings.t: STEM Lab la — konstriksyon enjenyri, kodaj robo Dash, kit Lego ki ka kode ak design enprimant 3D, souvan lye dirèkteman ak kourikoulòm syans salklas la.

strings.text: 112 courses across 12 departments — 17 Advanced Placement including the full AP Capstone track, a four-year Bible sequence taught at CP and Honors levels, and an aquaponics internship run on the school’s own working system.
strings.t: 112 kou nan 12 depatman — 17 Advanced Placement, ki gen ladan tout wout AP Capstone la, yon sekans biblik kat lane yo bay nan nivo CP ak Honors, ak yon estaj akwaponik sou sistèm k ap fonksyone lekòl la genyen.
Old Testament Survey - College Preparatory

strings.text: The ninth-grade entry course, surveying the whole Bible as one story through the themes that trace God’s redemptive plan.
strings.t: Kou antre nevyèm ane a, ki travèse tout Bib la kòm yon sèl istwa atravè tèm ki trase plan redanmsyon Bondye a.
Old Testament Survey - Honors

strings.text: The same survey with an in-depth look at the covenants of Scripture; offered for dual enrollment through Judson College.
strings.t: Menm travèse a ak yon etid apwofondi sou alyans yo nan Ekriti a; yo ofri l ak doub enskripsyon atravè Judson College.
New Testament Survey - College Preparatory

strings.text: An introduction to the New Testament books, world and life of Christ, taught alongside the hermeneutical skills to interpret and apply them.
strings.t: Yon entwodiksyon ak liv Nouvo Testaman an, mond li ak lavi Kris la, ansanm ak zouti èrmenetik pou entèprete epi aplike yo.
New Testament Survey - Honors

strings.text: The honors New Testament year, also offered for dual enrollment through Judson College.
strings.t: Ane Nouvo Testaman an nan nivo Honors, yo ofri l tou ak doub enskripsyon atravè Judson College.
Christian Apologetics - College Preparatory

strings.text: The logical, philosophical, historical and scientific evidences for the Christian faith, and how to respond to contemporary ethical questions from a biblical perspective.
strings.t: Prèv lojik, filozofik, istorik ak syantifik lafwa kretyen an, ak fason pou reponn kesyon etik kontanporen yo nan yon pèspektiv biblik.
Apologetics - Honors

strings.text: The honors track, adding three projects — service with a Christian organization, apologetics practice with a non-Christian, and independent research.
strings.t: Wout Honors la, ki ajoute twa pwojè: sèvis ak yon òganizasyon kretyen, pratik apolojetik ak yon moun ki pa kretyen, ak rechèch endepandan.
Introduction to Philosophy - Honors

strings.text: Metaphysics, epistemology and axiology through the major philosophers, building toward worldview discernment.
strings.t: Metafizik, epistemoloji ak aksyoloji atravè gwo filozòf yo, jouk rive nan disènman vizyon-mond.
Introduction to Ethics - Honors

strings.text: Classical ethical thought from Plato to Aquinas, developed into a biblically grounded framework for contemporary questions.
strings.t: Panse etik klasik depi Platon rive Toma d'Aken, devlope nan yon kad ki chita sou Bib la pou kesyon kontanporen yo.
Systematic Theology

strings.text: The doctrines essential to orthodox Christian faith, and how worldviews shape belief.
strings.t: Doktrin ki esansyèl pou lafwa kretyen òtodòks la, ak fason vizyon-mond yo bay kwayans fòm.
Systematic Theology - Honors

strings.text: The honors senior theology course, adding analysis of theologians through history; offered for dual enrollment through Judson College.
strings.t: Kou teyoloji dènye ane a nan nivo Honors, ki ajoute analiz teyolojyen yo atravè istwa a; yo ofri l ak doub enskripsyon atravè Judson College.
Introduction to Bible

strings.text: A general introduction to the Bible’s authorship, structure and storyline, recommended for students new to Christian schooling.
strings.t: Yon entwodiksyon jeneral sou ki moun ki ekri Bib la, estrikti l ak fil istwa l, yo rekòmande l pou elèv ki fèk ap antre nan lekòl kretyen.
English I - College Preparatory

strings.text: The ninth-grade course in reading comprehension, literary analysis and expository writing, with MLA instruction and a PSAT/SAT vocabulary program.
strings.t: Kou nevyèm ane a nan konpreyansyon lekti, analiz literè ak ekriti ekspozitif, ak ansèyman MLA epi yon pwogram vokabilè pou PSAT/SAT.
English I - Honors

strings.text: The honors ninth-grade course, adding quarterly independent reading assignments and projects.
strings.t: Kou nevyèm ane a nan nivo Honors, ki ajoute lekti endepandan ak pwojè chak trimès.
English II - College Preparatory

strings.text: World literature focused on one geographic region, with literary archetypes and continued vocabulary and grammar work.
strings.t: Literati mondyal ki konsantre sou yon sèl rejyon jeyografik, ak achetip literè epi travay kontinyèl sou vokabilè ak gramè.
English II - Honors

strings.text: The honors sophomore year, expecting quarterly independent reading and writing projects.
strings.t: Dezyèm ane a nan nivo Honors, ak lekti ak pwojè ekriti endepandan chak trimès.
English III - College Preparatory

strings.text: A survey of American texts and ideas, with analytical, argumentative, informative and narrative writing plus MLA research.
strings.t: Yon travèse tèks ak lide ameriken yo, ak ekriti analitik, agimantatif, enfòmatif ak naratif ansanm ak rechèch MLA.
English III - Honors

strings.text: The honors American-literature year, requiring more independent analysis than the standard course.
strings.t: Ane literati ameriken an nan nivo Honors, ki mande plis analiz endepandan pase kou estanda a.
English IV - College Preparatory

strings.text: College-level freshman writing alongside novels, plays and poems, introducing the literary theories students meet in college.
strings.t: Ekriti nivo inivèsite premye ane ansanm ak woman, pyès teyat ak powèm, ki entwodui teyori literè elèv yo pral rankontre nan inivèsite.
English IV - Honors

strings.text: The honors senior year, focused on personal narrative and argumentation to prepare for college writing.
strings.t: Dènye ane a nan nivo Honors, ki konsantre sou naratif pèsonèl ak agimantasyon pou prepare ekriti nivo inivèsite.

strings.text: Rhetorical analysis across mostly nonfiction genres, at the pace of a semester of college English.
strings.t: Analiz retorik sou jan ki sitou pa fiksyon, nan ritm yon semès angle inivèsite.

strings.text: In-depth literary analysis of fiction, poetry, drama and full-length novels, with an extensive summer reading assignment.
strings.t: Analiz literè apwofondi sou fiksyon, powezi, teyat ak woman konplè, ak yon gwo devwa lekti pou ete a.

strings.text: The in-depth study of variables, expressions and equations that prepares students for upper-level high school mathematics.
strings.t: Etid apwofondi varyab, ekspresyon ak ekwasyon ki prepare elèv yo pou matematik nivo siperyè lekòl segondè a.
Geometry - College Preparatory

strings.text: Plane and solid Euclidean geometry with inductive and deductive reasoning, including an Algebra I review.
strings.t: Jeyometri elidyen plàn ak solid ak rezònman endiktif epi dediktif, ki gen ladan yon revizyon Algebra I.
Geometry - Honors

strings.text: The honors geometry course; eighth-graders must pass a proficiency exam and score at grade level on the Terra Nova to enter.
strings.t: Kou jeyometri nan nivo Honors la; elèv uityèm ane yo dwe pase yon egzamen konpetans epi rive nan nivo klas yo nan tès Terra Nova a pou yo antre.
Algebra II - College Preparatory

strings.text: Problem-solving methods across applications — systems, polynomials, radicals, quadratics, sequences and probability.
strings.t: Metòd rezolisyon pwoblèm nan aplikasyon — sistèm, polinòm, radikal, ekwasyon dezyèm degre, swit ak pwobabilite.
Algebra II - Honors

strings.text: The honors track, introducing functions as preparation for Precalculus and Calculus at a rigorous pace.
strings.t: Wout Honors la, ki entwodui fonksyon yo kòm preparasyon pou Precalculus ak Calculus nan yon ritm egzijan.
Advanced Functions & Trigonometry

strings.text: Further skill development for Precalculus or college mathematics; deliberately not a path directly into Calculus.
strings.t: Yon devlopman konpetans anplis pou Precalculus oswa matematik inivèsite; espre li pa yon wout dirèk pou Calculus.
Precalculus - Honors

strings.text: Detailed analysis of functions and a unit-circle approach to trigonometry, with a heavy and essential homework load.
strings.t: Analiz detaye fonksyon yo ak yon apwòch sèk trigonometrik pou trigonometri, ak yon chaj devwa lou epi endispansab.
Calculus  - Honors

strings.text: Differential and integral calculus building the foundation for AP Calculus, and a prerequisite for it.
strings.t: Kalkil diferansyèl ak entegral ki bati baz pou AP Calculus, epi ki se kondisyon anvan pou li.

strings.text: College-level limits, differentiation and integration; double-blocked with Honors Calculus, with the AP exam required.
strings.t: Limit, derivasyon ak entegrasyon nivo inivèsite; nan blòk doub ak Honors Calculus, epi egzamen AP la obligatwa.

strings.text: The faster track through series, power series, Taylor polynomials and parametric, vector and polar calculus; offered second semester only.
strings.t: Wout ki pi rapid la, jouk nan seri, seri pisans, polinòm Taylor ak kalkil paramétrik, vektoryèl epi polè; yo ofri l sèlman nan dezyèm semès la.

strings.text: Collecting, analyzing and drawing conclusions from data — exploration, probability, inference and regression.
strings.t: Ranmase, analize epi tire konklizyon nan done: eksplorasyon, pwobabilite, enferans ak regresyon.
Biology - College Preparatory

strings.text: The introductory life-science course, from biochemistry and cellular physiology through genetics, Creation, evolution and ecology.
strings.t: Kou entwodiksyon syans lavi a, depi byochimi ak fizyoloji selilè rive nan jenetik, Kreyasyon, evolisyon ak ekoloji.
Biology - Honors

strings.text: The honors ninth-grade biology course, moving faster and adding research writing and analysis.
strings.t: Kou byoloji nevyèm ane a nan nivo Honors, ak yon ritm pi rapid epi plis travay ekriti ak rechèch.
Biology II - Honors

strings.text: Organic chemistry, cellular energetics, photosynthesis and DNA — the prerequisite that makes a student eligible for AP Biology.
strings.t: Chimi òganik, enèjetik selilè, fotosentèz ak ADN: kondisyon anvan ki fè yon elèv kalifye pou AP Biology.

strings.text: Principles of Chemistry and Physics - College Preparatory
strings.t: Principles of Chemistry and Physics - College Preparatory

strings.text: The introductory core science split between physics and chemistry; replaces College Preparatory Chemistry.
strings.t: Kou syans debaz entwodiktif la, separe ant fizik ak chimi; li ranplase College Preparatory Chemistry.
Chemistry - Honors

strings.text: Applications rather than memorization — atomic structure, the periodic table, reactions, gas laws and solutions, with extensive lab work.
strings.t: Aplikasyon olye memorizasyon: estrikti atomik, tablo periyodik, reyaksyon, lwa gaz yo ak solisyon, ak anpil travay laboratwa.
Chemistry II - Honors

strings.text: Covers the first half of the AP Chemistry curriculum; students who do well may enroll in AP Chemistry the same spring.
strings.t: Li kouvri premye mwatye pwogram AP Chemistry a; elèv ki byen reyisi kapab enskri nan AP Chemistry menm prentan an.
Anatomy and Physiology I - Honors

strings.text: An in-depth study of the body’s major systems and their disorders, with labs and dissections.
strings.t: Yon etid apwofondi sou gwo sistèm kò a ak twoub yo, ak laboratwa epi diseksyon.
Anatomy & Physiology II - Honors

strings.text: The remaining body systems — digestive, excretory, special senses, endocrine, lymphatic and reproductive — concluding with a fetal pig dissection.
strings.t: Rès sistèm kò yo — dijestif, ekskretè, sans espesyal, andokrin, lenfatik ak repwodiktif — ki fini ak yon diseksyon fetis kochon.
Human Anatomy & Wellness

strings.text: Body systems paired with the principles of wellness — nutrition, physical activity, sleep and stress management.
strings.t: Sistèm kò a ansanm ak prensip byennèt yo: nitrisyon, aktivite fizik, dòmi ak jesyon estrès.
Health Sciences

strings.text: For students interested in the medical field: healthcare careers, medical terminology, CPR certification, first aid and hands-on labs.
strings.t: Pou elèv ki enterese nan domèn medikal la: karyè swen sante, tèminoloji medikal, sètifikasyon CPR, premye swen ak laboratwa pratik.

strings.text: A lab-based course centered on weather and climate — the atmosphere, severe storms, plate tectonics and space exploration.
strings.t: Yon kou laboratwa ki konsantre sou tan ak klima: atmosfè a, gwo tanpèt, tektonik plak ak eksplorasyon espasyal.
Horticulture

strings.text: Renewable and nonrenewable energy, food sustainability and water distribution, with hands-on work in the campus aquaponics facility.
strings.t: Enèji renouvlab ak ki pa renouvlab, dirabilite alimantè ak distribisyon dlo, ak travay pratik nan enstalasyon akwaponik kanpis la.
Aquaponics Internship

strings.text: Hands-on work in a functioning aquaponics system — water quality, fish care and crop production — integrating biology, chemistry and engineering.
strings.t: Travay pratik sou yon sistèm akwaponik k ap fonksyone — kalite dlo, swen pwason ak pwodiksyon rekòt — k ap entegre byoloji, chimi ak enjenyeri.

strings.text: College-level biology, double-blocked with Honors Biology II to accommodate the mandated College Board labs.
strings.t: Byoloji nivo inivèsite, nan blòk doub ak Honors Biology II pou fè plas pou laboratwa College Board egzije yo.

strings.text: College-level chemistry with required summer review exercises; double-blocked with Honors Chemistry II.
strings.t: Chimi nivo inivèsite ak egzèsis revizyon obligatwa pou ete a; nan blòk doub ak Honors Chemistry II.

strings.text: The scientific principles behind environmental problems and the alternatives for resolving them, across multiple labs.
strings.t: Prensip syantifik ki dèyè pwoblèm anviwonmantal yo ak altènativ pou rezoud yo, atravè plizyè laboratwa.
World History - College Preparatory

strings.text: The required ninth-grade survey from the Neolithic Revolution through the twentieth century, read through biblical principles.
strings.t: Travèse obligatwa nevyèm ane a depi Revolisyon Neyolitik la rive nan ventyèm syèk la, li atravè prensip biblik.
World History - Honors

strings.text: The honors world-history year, at a higher academic level with more independent work.
strings.t: Ane istwa mondyal la nan nivo Honors, nan yon nivo akademik pi wo ak plis travay endepandan.
U.S. History I - College Preparatory

strings.text: Required American history from exploration through Reconstruction, examining political, social, economic and cultural issues.
strings.t: Istwa ameriken obligatwa depi eksplorasyon an rive nan Rekonstriksyon an, k ap egzamine kesyon politik, sosyal, ekonomik ak kiltirèl.
U.S. History I - Honors

strings.text: The honors course, running from exploration through the Progressive Era with an emphasis on critical and analytical thinking.
strings.t: Kou nan nivo Honors la, depi eksplorasyon an rive nan Epòk Pwogresis la, ak aksan sou panse kritik epi analitik.
U.S. History II - College Preparatory

strings.text: Required American history from World War I to the present.
strings.t: Istwa ameriken obligatwa depi Premye Gè Mondyal la rive jounen jodi a.
U.S. History II - Honors

strings.text: The honors second American-history year, going deeper on the same period.
strings.t: Dezyèm ane istwa ameriken an nan nivo Honors, ki fouye pi fon nan menm peryòd la.
Government/Economics - College Preparatory

strings.text: The required senior civics course — the Constitution and three branches — paired with microeconomics from biblical principles.
strings.t: Kou sivik obligatwa dènye ane a — Konstitisyon an ak twa branch yo — ansanm ak mikwoekonomi apati prensip biblik.
Government/Economics - Honors

strings.text: The honors senior civics-and-economics course, with more depth and analytical work.
strings.t: Kou sivik ak ekonomi dènye ane a nan nivo Honors, ak plis pwofondè epi travay analitik.

strings.text: A college-level survey from the colonial period to the present, built on document-based and free-response essay writing.
strings.t: Yon travèse nivo inivèsite depi peryòd kolonyal la rive jodi a, ki chita sou disètasyon ak dokiman epi ak repons lib.
Advanced Placement Government and Politics

strings.text: College-level American national government — institutions, political behavior, public policy, civil liberties and civil rights. Recommended for seniors.
strings.t: Gouvènman nasyonal ameriken nan nivo inivèsite: enstitisyon, konpòtman politik, politik piblik, libète sivil ak dwa sivil. Yo rekòmande l pou elèv dènye ane.

strings.text: Advanced Placement Human Geography and Environment
strings.t: Advanced Placement Human Geography and Environment

strings.text: Population, cultural patterns, political organization of space, land use and economic development, themed on globalization versus cultural diversity.
strings.t: Popilasyon, modèl kiltirèl, òganizasyon politik espas la, itilizasyon tè ak devlopman ekonomik, ak globalizasyon kont divèsite kiltirèl kòm fil kondiktè.
Lang Etranje

strings.text: A comprehension-first entry course: most class time is spent listening to and reading Spanish, with minimal explicit grammar.
strings.t: Yon kou antre ki konsantre sou konpreyansyon anvan tou: pi fò tan klas la se koute ak li panyòl, ak trè piti gramè eksplisit.

strings.text: More grammar than level I, but still built on maximum exposure to the language through authentic texts.
strings.t: Plis gramè pase nivo I, men li toujou bati sou pi gwo ekspozisyon posib ak lang lan atravè tèks otantik.
Spanish III - Honors

strings.text: An accelerated year of new tenses and vocabulary across all three modes of communication, themed toward the AP exam.
strings.t: Yon ane akselere ak nouvo tan vèb epi vokabilè nan tou twa mòd kominikasyon yo, ki vize egzamen AP la.
Spanish IV - Honors

strings.text: Continued study through novels and authentic cultural resources, expressing feelings, emotions and personal opinions.
strings.t: Etid ki kontinye atravè woman ak resous kiltirèl otantik, k ap eksprime santiman, emosyon ak opinyon pèsonèl.

strings.text: Taught almost exclusively in Spanish, exploring cultural products, practices and perspectives; the AP exam is required.
strings.t: Yo anseye l prèske nèt an panyòl, k ap eksplore pwodwi, pratik ak pèspektiv kiltirèl; egzamen AP la obligatwa.
American Sign Language I

strings.text: Basic conversational ASL through finger-spelling, vocabulary and grammatical structure, with cultural awareness of the D/deaf community.
strings.t: ASL konvèsasyonèl debaz atravè daktiloloji, vokabilè ak estrikti gramatikal, ak konsyans kiltirèl kominote soud la.
American Sign Language II

strings.text: Intermediate conversational ASL, developing expressive and receptive language skills.
strings.t: ASL konvèsasyonèl nivo entèmedyè, k ap devlope konpetans ekspresif ak reseptif.

strings.text: The fundamentals of art and essential skills in drawing, painting and image-making, plus how to discuss and evaluate artwork.
strings.t: Fondasyon atizay la ak konpetans esansyèl nan desen, penti ak kreyasyon imaj, ansanm ak fason pou diskite epi evalye yon zèv.

strings.text: Applying Art I skills to complete compositions using the principles of design, and introducing new media.
strings.t: Aplike konpetans Art I yo nan konpozisyon konplè atravè prensip design yo, epi entwodui nouvo medya.

strings.text: Preparation for the AP portfolio, culminating in a sustained investigation series on the student’s own artistic interests.
strings.t: Preparasyon pou pòtfolyo AP la, ki fini ak yon seri envestigasyon soutni sou pwòp enterè atistik elèv la.
Art IV

strings.text: Built around a personal portfolio; the school prefers it be completed in the fall with AP 2D in the spring.
strings.t: Bati otou yon pòtfolyo pèsonèl; lekòl la prefere pou yo fè l nan otòn epi AP 2D nan prentan.
Art Appreciation

strings.text: Awareness and appreciation of art through study, discussion, written critique and creation — no prior art background assumed.
strings.t: Konesans ak apresyasyon atizay atravè etid, diskisyon, kritik ekri ak kreyasyon — yo pa sipoze okenn fòmasyon atistik anvan.

strings.text: The fundamentals of 3D art and handbuilding with clay — pinch, slab and coil construction, plus decorative techniques and glazing.
strings.t: Fondasyon atizay twa dimansyon ak modelaj ajil ak men — pens, plak ak bouden — ansanm ak teknik dekoratif epi emayaj.

strings.text: Project-based work building on handbuilding technique, and may include an introduction to wheel throwing.
strings.t: Travay ki chita sou pwojè epi ki bati sou teknik modelaj ak men, epi ki ka gen yon entwodiksyon ak tou a.
Fiber Crafts I

strings.text: Needle crafts — crochet and cross stitch — alongside hand sewing, machine sewing and quilting, taught project by project.
strings.t: Travay zegwi — kwochè ak pwen kwaze — ansanm ak koud ak men, koud ak machin epi quilting, yo anseye yo pwojè pa pwojè.
Fiber Crafts II

strings.text: More advanced crocheting and quilting, including a small quilt inspired by a study of the women of the Bible.
strings.t: Kwochè ak quilting pi avanse, ki gen ladan yon ti kouvèti ki enspire de yon etid sou fanm nan Bib la.
Advanced Placement 2D Studio Art

strings.text: A 15-piece sustained investigation driven by an essential question, plus five selected works and a written artist’s statement.
strings.t: Yon envestigasyon soutni ak 15 zèv ki gide pa yon kesyon esansyèl, plis senk zèv chwazi ak yon deklarasyon ekri atis la.
Choir/Ensemble I & II

strings.text: An introduction to choral singing in two to four parts, with two to three performances a semester counting toward the grade.
strings.t: Yon entwodiksyon ak chan koral de a kat vwa, ak de a twa pèfòmans pa semès ki konte nan nòt la.
Choir/Ensemble III & IV

strings.text: Advanced choral technique and leadership, with duet and solo performance and participation in every choral performance.
strings.t: Teknik koral avanse ak lidèchip, ak chan an dyo epi an solo, epi patisipasyon nan tout konsè koral yo.
Concert Band (I-IV)

strings.text: Concert band repertoire with formal music theory and history, and auditions for NCBA All-District, All-State and the Solo & Ensemble Festival.
strings.t: Repètwa fanfa ak teyori epi istwa mizik fòmèl, ak odisyon pou NCBA All-District, All-State ak Solo & Ensemble Festival la.
Theatre I & II

strings.text: Theatre history and acting technique, with audition skills, confidence and stage presence, and critical response to performance.
strings.t: Istwa teyat ak teknik jwe, ak konpetans odisyon, konfyans epi prezans sou sèn, epi repons kritik sou pèfòmans.
Theatre III & IV

strings.text: Deeper theatre history, Shakespearean and advanced acting, playwriting and student directing; Theatre IV may include a theatre-for-missions project.
strings.t: Istwa teyat pi apwofondi, jwe Shakespearyen epi avanse, ekriti pyès ak mizansèn pa elèv; Theatre IV ka gen yon pwojè teyat pou misyon.
Musical Theatre I & II

strings.text: An introduction rotating through jazz, tap, singing and acting, with end-of-semester performance opportunities by audition.
strings.t: Yon entwodiksyon ki altène jaz, klaket, chante ak jwe, ak okazyon pou pèfòme nan fen semès la apre odisyon.
Musical Theater III & IV

strings.text: Intermediate and advanced tap alongside advancing acting and singing, with solo work and individual advanced projects.
strings.t: Klaket nivo entèmedyè epi avanse ansanm ak pèfeksyònman jwe ak chante, ak travay an solo epi pwojè avanse endividyèl.

strings.text: Individual, duo and small-group speech preparation plus formal debate, building research, logic and communication skills.
strings.t: Preparasyon diskou endividyèl, an de moun ak an ti gwoup, plis deba fòmèl, k ap devlope rechèch, lojik ak kominikasyon.
Medya Elèv
Introduction to Photography and Design

strings.text: Camera functions, composition and lighting alongside graphic-design fundamentals — layout, color theory and typography.
strings.t: Fonksyon kamera, konpozisyon ak ekleraj ansanm ak fondasyon design grafik: mizanpaj, teyori koulè ak tipografi.
Yearbook I

strings.text: Staff of the student-produced TK–12 yearbook, Exodus — photography, journalism, spread design and deadline production.
strings.t: Fè pati ekip albòm ane TK–12 elèv yo pwodui a, Exodus: fotografi, jounalis, design paj doub ak pwodiksyon anba delè.
Yearbook II

strings.text: Advanced design, feature writing and photography, with students beginning to specialize in one of those areas.
strings.t: Design avanse, ekriti repòtaj ak fotografi, ak elèv ki kòmanse espesyalize nan youn nan domèn sa yo.
Yearbook III - Honors

strings.text: An editor-and-leader role over the yearbook staff — content development, design consistency, mentoring and project management.
strings.t: Yon wòl editè epi lidè sou ekip albòm nan: devlopman kontni, koyerans design, mentora ak jesyon pwojè.

strings.text: Video production and broadcast journalism anchored by the weekly school broadcast, rotating through filming, editing, on-camera and segment writing.
strings.t: Pwodiksyon videyo ak jounalis odyovizyèl otou emisyon semanyèl lekòl la, k ap wotasyon ant filmaj, montaj, prezantasyon devan kamera ak ekriti segman.
Digital Media II

strings.text: Lead editor or producer of the weekly broadcast, plus podcast production, documentary features and promotional campaigns.
strings.t: Editè an chèf oswa pwodiktè emisyon semanyèl la, plis pwodiksyon podcast, repòtaj dokimantè ak kanpay pwomosyonèl.
Communications Internship

strings.text: An application-based capstone working alongside the Director of Media & Communications on real school-wide content and live events.
strings.t: Yon pwojè final sou kandidati, k ap travay ansanm ak Director of Media & Communications la sou kontni reyèl tout lekòl la ak evènman an dirèk.
Coding

strings.text: Building interactive web pages from scratch in HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript, including accessibility, performance and debugging.
strings.t: Bati paj wèb entèaktif depi zewo an HTML5, CSS3 ak JavaScript, ki gen ladan aksesibilite, pèfòmans ak debogaj.
Tech Production and Photoshop

strings.text: Project-based Photoshop alongside chapel production — camera operation, lighting, imaging controls and video editing.
strings.t: Photoshop sou baz pwojè ansanm ak pwodiksyon chapèl la: manyen kamera, ekleraj, kontwòl imaj ak montaj videyo.

strings.text: Object-oriented programming, algorithm development and data structures, equivalent to a first-semester college course.
strings.t: Pwogramasyon oryante objè, devlopman algoritm ak estrikti done, ekivalan a yon premye semès inivèsite.
Lifetime Fitness/Health

strings.text: The graduation-requirement course — health topics from nutrition to mental health, paired with daily aerobic, flexibility and strength work.
strings.t: Kou ki obligatwa pou diplòm nan: sijè sante depi nitrisyon rive sante mantal, ansanm ak travay ayewobik, souplès ak fòs chak jou.

strings.text: Intermediate skill in selected team sports, with leadership development and athletics as a platform to share the Gospel.
strings.t: Konpetans nivo entèmedyè nan kèk espò ann ekip, ak devlopman lidèchip epi espò kòm yon platfòm pou pataje Levanjil la.
Strength Training/Conditioning

strings.text: Weight training for major muscle groups plus conditioning routines; varsity athletes get priority for class spots.
strings.t: Antrènman ak pwa pou gwo gwoup miskilè yo plis routin kondisyònman; atlèt ekip prensipal la gen priyorite pou plas yo.
In-Season Weight Training

strings.text: Lifting during a student’s designated sport season to gain strength, size and speed.
strings.t: Leve pwa pandan sezon espò elèv la asiyen an, pou pran fòs, volim ak vitès.
Speed and Agility Training, Beginning/Intermediate

strings.text: Targeted work on foot speed, leg turnover, sprint endurance and competitive balance for athletes.
strings.t: Travay sible sou vitès pye, frekans pa, andirans nan espren ak ekilib konpetitif pou atlèt.
Flexibility Training

strings.text: Students design their own flexibility program across static, isometric and dynamic stretching, with yoga and Pilates elements.
strings.t: Elèv yo konsevwa pwòp pwogram souplès yo ant etiraj estatik, izometrik ak dinamik, ak eleman yoga epi Pilates.
Advanced Placement Seminar

strings.text: The first AP Capstone course — cross-curricular inquiry, synthesis from multiple sources, and written and oral argument.
strings.t: Premye kou AP Capstone la: rechèch entèdisiplinè, sentèz plizyè sous ak agimantasyon alekri epi alwal.
Advanced Placement Research

strings.text: The second AP Capstone course — a year-long investigation culminating in a 4,000–5,000-word paper and oral defense.
strings.t: Dezyèm kou AP Capstone la: yon envestigasyon yon lane ki fini ak yon memwa 4,000–5,000 mo epi yon soutnans alwal.

strings.text: The systematic, scientific study of behavior and mental processes across the major subfields of psychology.
strings.t: Etid sistematik epi syantifik konpòtman ak pwosesis mantal nan gwo sou-domèn sikoloji yo.

strings.text: A survey of the major principles — human development, learning and memory, personality, stress, and abnormal behavior and treatment.
strings.t: Yon travèse gwo prensip yo: devlopman imen, aprantisaj ak memwa, pèsonalite, estrès, ak konpòtman anòmal epi tretman li.
Personal Finance and Accounting

strings.text: A graduation requirement covering income, budgeting, credit, saving and investing, insurance and taxes.
strings.t: Yon kondisyon pou diplòm nan ki kouvri revni, bidjè, kredi, epay ak envestisman, asirans ak taks.

strings.text: Expressive writing across poetry, short stories, plays and comic strips, with strategies for getting past writer’s block.
strings.t: Ekriti ekspresif nan powezi, istwa kout, teyat ak bann desine, ak estrateji pou depase blokaj ekriven an.

strings.text: Critical Thinking and Reasoning through Current Affairs
strings.t: Critical Thinking and Reasoning through Current Affairs

strings.text: Analysis of the political, economic, social and cultural issues shaping the United States and the world, through a biblical perspective.
strings.t: Analiz kesyon politik, ekonomik, sosyal ak kiltirèl k ap bay Etazini ak mond lan fòm, nan yon pèspektiv biblik.
Biblical Manhood

strings.text: The biblical understanding of masculinity and the role of men in family, church and society, open to young men.
strings.t: Konpreyansyon biblik maskilinite a ak wòl gason nan fanmi, legliz ak sosyete; li louvri pou jenn gason.
Biblical Womanhood

strings.text: The biblical understanding of femininity and the role of women in family, church and society, open to young women.
strings.t: Konpreyansyon biblik feminite a ak wòl fanm nan fanmi, legliz ak sosyete; li louvri pou jenn fi.
SOAR

strings.text: Critical thinking, organization, time management and career exploration — aimed at students transitioning into high school.
strings.t: Panse kritik, òganizasyon, jesyon tan ak eksplorasyon karyè — li vize elèv k ap antre nan lekòl segondè.
Student Intern

strings.text: A graded, application-based internship serving others through direct observation, hands-on work and reflection.
strings.t: Yon estaj ki gen nòt epi sou kandidati, k ap sèvi lòt moun atravè obsèvasyon dirèk, travay pratik ak refleksyon.
Work Release

strings.text: For seniors with a 3.0 GPA and an employer letter who leave school early for work; not available in a sport’s season.
strings.t: Pou elèv dènye ane ki gen yon mwayèn 3.0 ak yon lèt anplwayè epi k ap kite lekòl bonè pou travay; li pa disponib pandan sezon espò yo a.

strings.text: Five subject strands by grade, plus required LEAD courses and arts electives. (The Early/Lower School, PS–4, publishes no named courses or subject list at all.)
strings.t: Senk branch matyè pa nivo, plis kou LEAD obligatwa yo ak elektif atizay. (Early/Lower School la, PS–4, pa pibliye okenn kou ki gen non ni okenn lis matyè menm.)

strings.text: Gaston Day publishes Middle School curriculum as per-grade subject strands rather than as named, individually-described courses. The rows below are those strands as the school states them.
strings.t: Gaston Day pibliye kourikoulòm Middle School la kòm branch matyè pa nivo olye ke kòm kou ki gen non epi ki dekri youn pa youn. Liy ki anba yo se branch sa yo jan lekòl la deklare yo.
Debaz

strings.text: Literature, grammar and written composition across all four Middle School years.
strings.t: Literati, gramè ak konpozisyon ekri atravè tout kat ane Middle School yo.

strings.text: Earth and Space Science in 5th, Life Science in 6th, Earth Systems in 7th and Physical Science in 8th.
strings.t: Earth and Space Science nan 5yèm, Life Science nan 6yèm, Earth Systems nan 7yèm ak Physical Science nan 8yèm.

strings.text: Grade-level mathematics with honors options, including Honors Algebra I available in 7th and 8th grade.
strings.t: Matematik nan nivo klas la ak opsyon Honors, ki enkli Honors Algebra I disponib nan 7yèm ak 8yèm grad.

strings.text: Human Geography in 5th and 6th, U.S. History in 7th and World History I in 8th.
strings.t: Human Geography nan 5yèm ak 6yèm, U.S. History nan 7yèm ak World History I nan 8yèm.

strings.text: Language acquisition in 5th and 6th, then Conversational Spanish and Spanish I in 7th and 8th.
strings.t: Akizisyon lang nan 5yèm ak 6yèm, apre sa Conversational Spanish ak Spanish I nan 7yèm ak 8yèm.
Elektif ak LEAD
LEAD

strings.text: A required course sequence carrying digital citizenship and life-skills instruction alongside advisory.
strings.t: Yon sekans kou obligatwa ki pote ansèyman sou sitwayènte dijital ak konpetans lavi ansanm ak advisory.

strings.text: One of four fine-arts electives Middle School students choose between.
strings.t: Youn nan kat elektif bozar elèv Middle School yo chwazi ant yo.

strings.text: Continues the drama sequence that begins in second grade in the Lower School.
strings.t: Li kontinye sekans dram ki kòmanse nan dezyèm grad nan Lower School la.

strings.text: The Middle School Chorus, which performs alongside the instrumental ensemble.
strings.t: Middle School Chorus la, ki fè pèfòmans ansanm ak ansanm enstrimantal la.

strings.text: Feeds the MS Instrumental Ensemble — woodwinds, brass, percussion, piano and guitar.
strings.t: Li nouri MS Instrumental Ensemble la — enstriman a van an bwa, kwiv, pèkisyon, pyano ak gita.

strings.text: 46 named courses across eight departments, including 10 AP courses and one dual-enrollment course taught by Gaston Day faculty.
strings.t: 46 kou ki gen non atravè uit depatman, ki enkli 10 kou AP ak yon kou dual-enrollment pwofesè Gaston Day ap anseye.

strings.text: First of the four required years of English.
strings.t: Premye nan kat ane Angle obligatwa yo.

strings.text: Second-year English, offered at the Honors level.
strings.t: Angle dezyèm ane, ki ofri nan nivo Honors.

strings.text: Upper-level survey offered at the Honors level.
strings.t: Yon panorama nivo siperyè ki ofri nan nivo Honors.
English Literature & Composition

strings.text: College-level literary analysis; all AP students must sit the exam.
strings.t: Analiz literè nan nivo inivèsite; tout elèv AP dwe pase egzamen an.
English Language & Composition

strings.text: College-level rhetoric and composition; all AP students must sit the exam.
strings.t: Retorik ak konpozisyon nan nivo inivèsite; tout elèv AP dwe pase egzamen an.

strings.text: Required for graduation; also available in Middle School at the Honors level.
strings.t: Obligatwa pou gradyasyon; disponib nan Middle School tou nan nivo Honors.

strings.text: Required for graduation, offered at the Honors level.
strings.t: Obligatwa pou gradyasyon, ki ofri nan nivo Honors.
PreCalculus

strings.text: Bridge course into the calculus sequence.
strings.t: Kou pon ki mennen nan sekans kalkil la.
Advanced Functions and Models

strings.text: A fourth-year mathematics option for students not continuing to calculus.
strings.t: Yon opsyon matematik katriyèm ane pou elèv ki pa kontinye nan kalkil.

strings.text: Honors calculus, offered alongside the two AP calculus courses.
strings.t: Kalkil Honors, ki ofri ansanm ak de kou kalkil AP yo.

strings.text: Honors statistics as a fourth-year mathematics option.
strings.t: Estatistik Honors kòm yon opsyon matematik katriyèm ane.
Calculus AB

strings.text: First-semester college calculus; all AP students must sit the exam.
strings.t: Kalkil inivèsitè premye semès; tout elèv AP dwe pase egzamen an.
Calculus BC

strings.text: Extends AB through series and further integration techniques.
strings.t: Li pwolonje AB atravè seri ak lòt teknik entegrasyon.
Honors / AP

strings.text: Required lab science, offered at both Honors and AP level.
strings.t: Syans laboratwa obligatwa, ki ofri nan nivo Honors ak AP tou de.

strings.text: A third-year lab science option at the Honors level.
strings.t: Yon opsyon syans laboratwa twazyèm ane nan nivo Honors.

strings.text: Honors physics, the prerequisite tier beneath AP Physics II.
strings.t: Fizik Honors, nivo kondisyon anvan an anba AP Physics II.
Physics II

strings.text: The AP physics offering, implying a two-year physics sequence.
strings.t: Ofrann fizik AP a, ki vle di gen yon sekans fizik de ane.

strings.text: Required for graduation, offered at both Honors and AP level.
strings.t: Obligatwa pou gradyasyon, ki ofri nan nivo Honors ak AP tou de.
Spanish I, II, III

strings.text: Completion through Level III is required for graduation; the requirement may also be met in French.
strings.t: Konplete jiska Nivo III obligatwa pou gradyasyon; yo ka satisfè egzijans lan an franse tou.
Spanish IV

strings.text: The terminal Spanish course, beyond the graduation requirement.
strings.t: Dènye kou Spanish la, pi lwen pase egzijans gradyasyon an.

strings.text: One of four fine-arts courses counting toward the two-year requirement.
strings.t: Youn nan kat kou bozar ki konte pou egzijans de ane a.
Ansanm vokal ki pote kredi bozar.

strings.text: Theatre course; the school stages two major productions a year including a spring musical.
strings.t: Kou teyat; lekòl la monte de gwo pwodiksyon pa ane ki enkli yon mizikal nan prentan.
Visual Art I, II, III

strings.text: A three-step sequence covering drawing, painting, ceramics, printmaking and portfolio development.
strings.t: Yon sekans twa etap ki kouvri desen, penti, seramik, gravi ak devlopman pòtfolyo.
Visual Art IV

strings.text: The terminal visual-arts course — there is no AP Studio Art.
strings.t: Dènye kou atizay vizyèl la — pa gen AP Studio Art.
PE / Sante

strings.text: Counts toward the one-year PE/Health graduation requirement.
strings.t: Li konte pou egzijans gradyasyon PE/Sante yon ane a.
Sante ak byennèt
AP Computer Science

strings.text: The tenth AP course, supported by a makerspace with 3-D printers, laser cutters and CNC machines.
strings.t: Dizyèm kou AP a, ki sipòte pa yon makerspace ak enprimant 3-D, koupè lazè ak machin CNC.

strings.text: Honors engineering, taught alongside the makerspace facilities.
strings.t: Enjenyri Honors, ki anseye ansanm ak enstalasyon makerspace yo.

strings.text: Feeds the VEX Robotics team that reached TSA VEX Nationals in 2023.
strings.t: Li nouri ekip VEX Robotics ki te rive nan TSA VEX Nationals an 2023.
Intro to Business
Honors / DE

strings.text: The one dual-enrollment course taught by Gaston Day faculty; DE credit is not calculated into the GPA.
strings.t: Sèl kou dual-enrollment pwofesè Gaston Day ap anseye; kredi DE a pa antre nan kalkil GPA a.

strings.text: Feeds Blutopia, the student literary and art magazine.
strings.t: Li nouri Blutopia, magazin literè ak atistik elèv yo.
Speech & Debate

strings.text: Supports the Public Debate Club and Mock Trial.
strings.t: Li sipòte Public Debate Club la ak Mock Trial.
Elektif nan syans sosyal.
Human Geography

strings.text: Social-science elective; also taught in Middle School at grade level.
strings.t: Elektif nan syans sosyal; li anseye nan Middle School tou nan nivo klas la.
Human Health and Medicine
Elektif pre-sante.
World Views
Elektif ki egzamine diferan fason wè lemonn.
Music Appreciation
Elektif ki pre atizay.
Cinema Studies
Elektif ki pre atizay nan analiz sinema.
Piblikasyon elèv ki pote kredi kou.
Strength & Conditioning I, II, III
Yon sekans elektif twa nivo sou pèfòmans atletik.
